General Motors.description:
About the Role
We are looking for a Staff Software Engineer to join our team.
This role reports directly to the Director of Software Engineering and is a senior technical leadership position for someone who is exceptionally strong in hands-on software engineering and can also drive meaningful change across multiple teams, domains, and technical layers.
This person will operate across Android, RTOS, embedded systems, platform integration, and product delivery boundaries, helping shape direction, solve critical problems, and raise engineering execution across the organization.
The right candidate has the technical depth to go deep into architecture and implementation, the judgment to navigate ambiguity, and the credibility to work directly with senior managers, directors, architects, and cross-functional leaders. They should be comfortable switching between senior technical leadership and direct hands-on work in code, debugging, design reviews, integration, and problem solving.
What will YOU do?
Lead technically complex efforts across Android, RTOS, and embedded software domains within the vehicle camera organization.
Drive architecture, design, and implementation decisions for critical software systems and cross-domain integrations.
Stay close to the code and work hands-on in ambiguous, high-risk, or high-impact areas.
Identify and resolve systemic technical issues that span components, teams, or organizational boundaries.
Influence software direction across platform, application, integration, and vehicle-level concerns.
Partner closely with engineering leaders, architects, systems engineering, program teams, and global stakeholders to align technical strategy with execution reality.
Translate broad product or organizational needs into practical technical plans, engineering improvements, and measurable outcomes.
Raise the technical bar through design reviews, code quality expectations, engineering rigor, and strong technical judgment.
Drive improvements in development practices, integration approaches, debugging efficiency, and delivery predictability.
Mentor and influence engineers across the organization through technical excellence, clarity, and execution.
Help the organization make sound tradeoffs across speed, quality, scalability, maintainability, and vehicle/program constraints.
Contribute to software that ultimately runs in production vehicles and supports critical customer-facing and safety-relevant functionality.
Your Skills & Abilities (Required Qualifications)
B.Sc. in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field.
Over 10 years of hands-on software engineering experience building complex production systems.
Strong experience in embedded software development, including low-level debugging, performance analysis, and system integration.
Significant experience with Android and/or RTOS-based systems in production environments.
Strong proficiency in C++ and/or C in complex software systems.
Proven track record of driving technical outcomes across multiple teams or domains through influence, ownership, and execution.
Demonstrated ability to operate effectively in a senior technical leadership capacity, working directly with directors, senior managers, architects, and cross-functional leaders.
Strong software engineering fundamentals in system design, architecture, concurrency, debugging, performance, and maintainability.
Experience working in large-scale, cross-site, cross-functional software organizations.
What Can Give You a Competitive Edge (Preferred Qualifications)
Experience in automotive, camera systems, computer vision pipelines, or safety-relevant embedded platforms.
Strong background in multi-domain systems that combine platform software, application logic, hardware-aware constraints, and vehicle integration.
Experience with software running on resource-constrained or real-time environments.
Familiarity with Android platform internals, middleware, BSP/system bring-up, or similar platform-level work.
Experience improving engineering effectiveness across organizations through better architecture, technical decision-making, tooling, development workflows, or integration practices.
M.Sc. or other advanced technical degree.
Why this role matters
This role is central to how we scale technical excellence in a growing and increasingly complex organization. It is an opportunity to shape both product and engineering direction, work on real systems that ship to vehicles, and have broad impact across critical camera and embedded software domains.
This is the right role for someone who wants to stay deeply hands-on, operate at high scope, and lead through expertise, judgment, and execution.

Gong.io.description:
Gong harnesses the power of AI to transform how revenue teams win. The Gong Revenue AI Operating System unifies data, insights, and workflows into a single, trusted system that observes, guides, and acts alongside the world’s most successful revenue teams. Powered by the Gong Revenue Graph, AI-powered intelligence, specialized agents, and trusted applications, Gong helps more than 5,000 companies around the world deeply understand their teams and customers, automate critical sales workflows, and close more deals with less effort. For more information, visit www.gong.io.
At Gong, you will join a company built on innovative products, ambitious goals, and passionate people. We are shaping the future of revenue intelligence and we want people who are excited to build what comes next. You will work with a team that dreams big, moves fast, and cares deeply about the craft and about each other. Here, transparency and trust are core to how we operate, and every person has the opportunity to make a visible impact. If you want to grow, stretch, and do work that truly matters, Gong is the place to do the best work of your career.
As a Developer Experience (DevEx) Team Lead, you'll lead the team responsible for the platforms, tooling, and workflows that power Gong's engineering organization. You'll help hundreds of engineers build, test, deploy, and operate software more efficiently by removing friction from the software development lifecycle. This is a leadership role where you'll shape technical direction, grow a high-performing team, and drive initiatives that improve engineering productivity across the company.
You'll Own
Developer Experience Platform - Drive the evolution of Gong's internal developer platform, enabling self-service capabilities across local development, CI/CD, testing, deployment, and observability.
Team Leadership & AI Adoption - Lead, mentor, and grow a team of platform and software engineers while driving the adoption of AI-powered development tools that accelerate engineering productivity at scale.
Engineering Productivity - Own the reliability and scalability of CI/CD systems, improve software delivery workflows, and partner with Infrastructure, Security, AI Enablement, and R&D leadership to continuously raise engineering effectiveness.
You'll Solve
Remove bottlenecks across the software development lifecycle by building scalable platforms, automation, and self-service solutions that enable engineers to move faster with confidence.
Evaluate, operationalize, and scale emerging AI capabilities while ensuring they are adopted safely, effectively, and in ways that create measurable impact across R&D.
You'll Impact
Increase engineering productivity and developer satisfaction by delivering reliable internal platforms and workflows that support hundreds of engineers across the organization.
Shape how software is built at Gong by influencing engineering standards, improving delivery speed and quality, and enabling teams to innovate more efficiently.
How You'll Succeed Here
You bring 5+ years of engineering management experience leading highly technical teams in Developer Experience, Platform Engineering, or Infrastructure, with a strong track record of balancing strategic leadership with hands-on technical execution.
You bring a strong software engineering background with experience building cloud-native, distributed systems, ideally using Java and/or Python.
You embrace an AI-first mindset and have hands-on experience evaluating and integrating AI-powered developer tools into engineering workflows.
You have deep expertise in modern software delivery, CI/CD ecosystems, developer platforms, automation, observability, and GitOps practices.
You build strong partnerships across engineering organizations and influence technical direction through collaboration, communication, and a customer-first approach to developer experience.
*We operate in a flexible hybrid work model.
What makes Engineering at Gong unique?
Here at Gong, we trust and empower our employees with ownership to solve complex problems, make the right decisions, and build the best products that create radical impact. We call this “Own. Solve. Impact.” For our engineers, it means being involved and able to influence the entire process to create the best product. If you are curious to discover Gong's wonderful and challenging world, what are you waiting for? Don’t delay - fill in your application details. Who knows, maybe there’s a Gongster in you!
About us
We encourage our employees to express their personality and identity (whether gender, ethnic, religious, or sexual), and we ensure fairness and equal opportunities. We follow a hybrid working model that combines working from home, on the go, or at the office. This allows us: flexibility, autonomy, positive work relationships, and effective work habits. If these considerations are important to you when choosing a workplace, we'd love to see you with us. To review Gong's privacy policy, visit www.gong.io/privacy-policy/ for more details.

חברה טכנולוגית מובילה ומבוססת בתחום פתרונות המידע בעולמות ה- FinTech וה-LegalTech. כבר למעלה משני עשורים, חשבים מספקת מגוון מוצרים ושירותי מידע אינטרנטיים בתחומים של מיסוי, דיני עבודה, פיננסים, פנסיה טפסים, דוחות חשבונאים, ומחשבונים פיננסיים לטובת הגרסה הדיגיטלית של מוצרי החברה. הכרות עם תוכנות ייעודיות לביצוע חישובים פיננסיים וכלכליים לאנשי מקצוע בתחום המיסים והכלכלה- יתרון. זיקה טכנולוגית או Harmonya Technologies.description:
About the position
What You'll Do
We're looking for a Platform Team Leader to own the foundational systems that power Harmonya's R&D organization. The Platform team is a horizontal, internal-facing team — its customers are the engineers, data scientists, and analysts on our application teams, and its mission is to make them faster, safer, and more productive.
You will lead a team responsible for our production-critical data ingestion (scraping system, data normalization platform), our developer experience surface (Python mono repo, packages and services framework, CI/CD, shared images), our Airflow base layer, and our backoffice. These systems sit on the critical path for production — every other team depends on them, and uptime, incident response, and reliability are core to the role.
This role is for a hands-on technical leader who enjoys both shipping code and growing engineers. You'll spend roughly 50% of your time hands-on writing code, reviewing designs, and the rest leading the team, partnering with peer team leads, and shaping the technical direction of our platform with the VP R&D and CTO.
Responsibilities
Lead and grow a team of strong backend engineers, owning hiring, mentorship, performance, and personal growth
Own the team's roadmap end-to-end: scoping, prioritization, delivery, and quality
Drive the architecture and evolution of the platform layers your team owns — both the data plumbing that feeds Harmonya and the developer-experience surface other R&D teams build on
Contribute hands-on (~50%) to design, code, code reviews, and production debugging

About The Role
As Commission Analyst at HiBob, you’ll own one of our most visible and business-critical functions — ensuring that all commission-based people across our GTM and CS organizations are rewarded accurately, transparently, and on time.
You’ll own end-to-end commission operations for a global population of 400+ Sales and CS employees, partnering closely with Sales, Finance, People, and Revenue Operations teams. This is a high-impact role focused on commission calculations, plan implementation, reporting, dispute resolution, and continuous process improvement, where accuracy, analytical thinking, and cross-functional collaboration are essential.
This is your opportunity to elevate how HiBob scales its variable compensation processes globally — ensuring fairness, clarity, and operational excellence at every step.
responsibilities
Own Commission Calculations Calculate and validate commissions for 400+ employees across Sales and CS, applying approved plans and rules and catching cases where results don't match what's expected.
Analyze Commission Plan Performance Review quota attainment and payouts against plan definitions to confirm calculations are correct, then go a layer deeper to assess whether plans are driving the intended behavior. Surface outliers and recommend design changes where plans aren't performing as intended.
Manage Quota Assignments
Track assigned versus unassigned quota across the organization, spot coverage gaps or misalignments, and partner with Sales Ops and HR to keep assignments current as headcount and territories shift.
Reconcile Source Data Check and align data across CRM, HR, and the commission system.
Implement Compensation Rules Configure and maintain compensation plans, crediting rules, and calculations in the commission system, and assess the downstream impact of changes before they go live.
Maintain Core Reporting Produce and refine reporting on attainment, payouts, adjustments, and exceptions, watching for trends that need attention.
Manage Adjustments & Corrections Process approved manual adjustments, retro changes, and exception cases, and keep an eye on patterns across them that point to a bigger fix needed elsewhere.
Investigate Discrepancies & Disputes Analyze payout issues and employee inquiries using data and how the system is built to calculate them, and feed common themes back into plan or process improvements.
Support System Changes & Testing Test and validate changes to plans, calculation rules, and integrations before release, including their impact on affected employees.
Manage & Investigate Commission Disputes Own the end to end process when sellers or other employees dispute their commission payouts, from intake through resolution. Dig into the data and system logic to determine whether the payout is correct, communicate the outcome clearly back to the employee.
requirements

Bachelor’s degree required
4+ years of experience in commissions, revenue operations, FP&A, accounting, payroll, or a related function
Technical Expertise:
Proven success in leveraging systems and automation to drive process efficiency and accuracy
Experience managing large-scale commission programs in high-growth environments
Strong proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets
Preferred: Experience with NetSuite , CIQ , and Salesforce
Skills & Qualities:
Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy
Excellent communication and collaboration skills
Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset
Highly organized, adaptable, and comfortable managing multiple priorities in a dynamic environment
Ability to work effectively with both remote and in-person teams

About The Role
As Commission Analyst at HiBob, you’ll own one of our most visible and business-critical functions — ensuring that all commission-based people across our GTM and CS organizations are rewarded accurately, transparently, and on time.
You’ll own end-to-end commission operations for a global population of 400+ Sales and CS employees, partnering closely with Sales, Finance, People, and Revenue Operations teams. This is a high-impact role focused on commission calculations, plan implementation, reporting, dispute resolution, and continuous process improvement, where accuracy, analytical thinking, and cross-functional collaboration are essential.

responsibilities
Own Commission Calculations Calculate and validate commissions for 400+ employees across Sales and CS, applying approved plans and rules and catching cases where results don't match what's expected.

Surface outliers and recommend design changes where plans aren't performing as intended.
Manage Quota Assignments
Track assigned versus unassigned quota across the organization, spot coverage gaps or misalignments, and partner with Sales Ops and HR to keep assignments current as headcount and territories shift.
Reconcile Source Data Check and align data across CRM, HR, and the commission system.
Implement Compensation Rules Configure and maintain compensation plans, crediting rules, and calculations in the commission system, and assess the downstream impact of changes before they go live.
Maintain Core Reporting Produce and refine reporting on attainment, payouts, adjustments, and exceptions, watching for trends that need attention.
Manage Adjustments & Corrections Process approved manual adjustments, retro changes, and exception cases, and keep an eye on patterns across them that point to a bigger fix needed elsewhere.
Investigate Discrepancies & Disputes Analyze payout issues and employee inquiries using data and how the system is built to calculate them, and feed common themes back into plan or process improvements.
Support System Changes & Testing Test and validate changes to plans, calculation rules, and integrations before release, including their impact on affected employees.
Manage & Investigate Commission Disputes Own the end to end process when sellers or other employees dispute their commission payouts, from intake through resolution. Dig into the data and system logic to determine whether the payout is correct, communicate the outcome clearly back to the employee.

Excellent communication and collaboration skills

HiBob helps modern, mid-size businesses transform the way they manage people, giving HR and managers all they need to connect, engage, develop, and retain top talent. Our HR platform is intuitive, data-driven, and built for the way people work today: globally, remotely, and collaboratively.
About The Role
HiBob is building a scalable data platform that powers our product, analytics, and AI capabilities. We’re looking for an Architect to shape the technical direction of the Data Platform group - helping teams make high-quality architectural decisions faster and turning complex, cross-cutting challenges into clear, pragmatic paths forward.
Reporting to the Data Platform Group Director and working alongside Team Leads, you’ll be the group’s senior individual-contributor architect. You will guide architecture across our Data Infrastructure, Data Engine, and Data Framework teams, with particular emphasis on data-intensive application architecture.
You’ll stay close to technical design, delivery, and production - not only to define direction, but to ensure it works in practice.
responsibilities
What you’ll do Set and evolve the architectural direction for the Data Platform group, balancing long-term platform strategy with pragmatic, executable decisions.
Lead cross-team design reviews and drive alignment on significant technical decisions, including the trade-offs behind them.
Create clear design documents, reference architectures, standards, and reusable patterns that enable teams to make high-quality decisions independently.
Partner with engineers and Team Leads through critical stages of delivery to preserve architectural intent, resolve emerging trade-offs, and ensure designs work in production.
Guide the evolution of data-intensive applications and platform capabilities across data access, query and application frameworks, streaming, storage, reliability, scalability, and security.
Drive incremental modernization of existing systems - including migrations, simplification, and architectural improvements - without compromising customer reliability or delivery momentum.
Build foundations that enable product teams to access and operate on data safely and efficiently, including permission-aware access to sensitive HR data.
Ensure the platform is ready for trusted analytics and AI use cases through robust data contracts, governance, observability, lineage, and secure access patterns.
Identify systemic technical risks, architectural gaps, and recurring friction - and turn them into durable capabilities rather than one-off solutions.
Mentor engineers and raise the bar for technical thinking, system design, and execution across the group.
requirements
What you bring Extensive experience as a Software Architect, Principal Engineer, or Staff engineer in data-intensive, distributed applications.
A proven ability to independently make sound technical decisions and solve complex, ambiguous problems across multiple teams and systems.
Deep expertise in distributed systems, including the trade-offs among consistency, reliability, performance, scalability, and operability.
Hands-on experience designing and evolving application-facing data platforms, APIs, frameworks, or query and data-access layers.
Strong knowledge of technologies such as PostgreSQL, Kafka, Redis, Cloud Infrastructure, and complex data systems.
Experience evolving complex production systems through migration, decomposition, or modernization - not only designing greenfield systems.
A practical architecture mindset: able to balance long-term direction with delivery needs and make trade-offs explicit.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, particularly for architecture reviews, technical decision records, and cross-team alignment.
Experience with sensitive data, security, privacy, permissions, or multi-tenant systems is a strong advantage.
Experience enabling analytics, semantic data access, or AI-ready data platforms is a strong advantage.

מרכזי ספורט ותרבות לכל המשפחה! המכון הבינלאומי למנהיגות המכון היהודי-ערבי חברת העובדים המדריך לצרכן הישראלי מכון אבשלום לידיעת הארץ מכון לבון פורום ארלוזורוב רשת דיור מוגן משען רשת חינוך הרב תחומי עמל המדריך לתביעות קטנות כלים לוועדים חוזרי יו"ר ההסתדרות תקנון ועדי עובדים מדריך לניהול כספי וועדי עובדים שירותים והטבות חוקת ההסתדרות צרו קשר דף הבית דרושים דרוש/ה עורך/ת דין לדיני עבודה בנתניה דרוש/ה עורך/ת דין לדיני עבודה בנתניה הגשת מועמדות למשרה שיתוף על התפקיד קוד משרה: 001 תחום עיסוק: איגוד מקצועי יחידה ארגונית: מרחב נתניה אזור גיאוגרפי: נתניה היקף משרה: מלא (100%) תיאור התפקיד: דרוש/ה עורך/ת דין לדיני עבודה בתחום הפרט והקיבוצי למחלקה המשפטית של האגף לאיגוד מקצועי בהסתדרות העובדים הכללית החדשה למשרה מיידית. המשרה כוללת ליווי ויעוץ משפטי בתחום דיני העבודה עבור האיגודים המקצועיים בהסתדרות ועבור חברי הסתדרות, לרבות ייצוג בתיקים משפטיים ובהליכי משא ומתן לחתימה על הסכמים קיבוציים. דרישות התפקיד: ניסיון בדיני עבודה -חובה ניסיון בתחום משפט העבודה הקיבוצי- יתרון משמעותי ניסיון בליטיגציה - יתרון משמעותי כישורים בניהול מו"מ יכולת בעבודת צוות יכולת התבטאות רהוטה בכתב ובעל פה ידע בסביבת עבודה ממוחשבת שליטה בשפה העברית כתיבה קריאה ברמת שפת א

This is a hybrid role combining hands-on software engineering, deep production debugging, and direct customer engagement.
You will work directly inside customer production systems, integrating Hud’s SDK, solving real-world issues, and shaping how our product is used in practice. At the same time, you will translate field learnings into scalable product improvements and reusable systems.
We’re building a runtime code sensor that operates where most tools don’t: inside running applications. Our goal is to give engineers and AI agents real-time, high-fidelity visibility into how code behaves in production—under real load, real traffic, and real failures.
This role blends deep systems engineering with applied, real-world problem solving. You’ll navigate complex production environments, explore runtime behavior, and design low-overhead solutions that are safe, reliable, and production-ready.
If you enjoy breaking (and fixing) complex systems, working closely with customers, and building tools that engineers trust in their most critical services—this role is for you.

Hud.description:
About the Role
We’re building a runtime code sensor that operates where most tools don’t: inside running applications. Our goal is to give engineers and AI agents real-time, high-fidelity visibility into how code actually behaves in production – under real load, real traffic, and real failures.
This role blends deep systems engineering with applied research . You’ll dive into runtime internals, explore undocumented behavior, design low-overhead instrumentation, and turn research insights into production-grade components that safely run in customer environments. One day you might analyze GC or JIT behavior; the next, design tracing mechanisms that survive real-world distributed systems.
If you get excited about runtime internals, enjoy breaking (and fixing) complex systems, think like both a researcher and a production engineer, and care deeply about performance, safety, and correctness – you’ll feel right at home here. This is a hands-on, high-impact role for engineers who want to ship technology that engineers actually trust to run in their most critical services.
Engineering Excellence / Mindset
Ability to anticipate technical risks, identify bottlenecks, and drive long-term engineering improvements.
Takes ownership of code quality, documentation, reliability, and observability.
Comfortable working with product teams to balance technical trade-offs with user and business needs.
Autonomous and proactive; capable of mentoring others or leading technical initiatives.
Bonus Points
Background in security agents, observability tools, or other components deployed directly into customer environments.
Experience with APM agents, JVM agents, Python tracing, V8 internals, or other instrumentation/profiling frameworks.

Immunai.description:
Description
About Immunai:
Immunai is an AI-driven platform company focused on improving drug discovery and development by decoding the human immune system.
We combine large-scale single cell immune data, advanced machine learning, and strong engineering to help pharmaceutical and research partners make better, more informed decisions throughout the drug development process.
Our long-term goal is to reduce drug development failure rates and help more effective medicines reach patients. We’re building this platform thoughtfully and collaboratively, bringing together expertise across biology, AI, engineering, and business.
Immunai is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.
About the role:
We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced LLM/ML Agentic AI Researcher to lead the technical development of our agentic AI interpretation framework. This hands-on role involves designing, building, and evaluating AI agents that interpret complex biological data.
You will be at the forefront of developing a sophisticated scientific reasoning system that leverages Large Language Models (LLMs) to provide structured, biologically-grounded explanations. Collaborating closely with immunologists, machine learning researchers, and technical leadership, you'll shape how we derive insights at a systems level, pushing the boundaries of AI in biology.
Location: Ramat Gan, Israel (Hybrid role)
What will you do?
Design, prototype, and build LLM-based agentic systems that reason over biological data, scientific literature, model outputs, and internal tools.
Develop agents capable of structured reasoning, hypothesis generation, explanation, planning, tool use, and iterative scientific analysis.
Build robust evaluation frameworks for agentic systems, including automated and human-in-the-loop evaluation pipelines.
Define and implement benchmarks, metrics, and test suites for measuring agent performance, including reasoning quality, biological grounding, factuality, robustness, reproducibility, and usefulness.
Work closely with AI researchers, computational biologists, immunologists, and product teams to translate scientific needs into measurable AI capabilities.
Create evaluation datasets and benchmark tasks that reflect real-world biological and therapeutic reasoning problems.
Analyze agent behavior, failure modes, hallucinations, tool-use errors, reasoning gaps, and grounding issues.
Contribute to the architecture of production-grade AI systems, including agent orchestration, retrieval, tool calling, memory, planning, and monitoring.
Stay up to date with the latest developments in LLMs, agentic AI, evaluation methodologies, and scientific AI systems.
Help turn research prototypes into reliable products used by internal teams and external partners.
Requirements
Required qualifications:
MSc or PhD in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computational Biology, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field.
Strong background in machine learning, data science, statistics, or computational modeling.
Hands-on experience building with LLMs and agentic AI systems.
Proven ability to design evaluation methodologies for AI systems, especially LLM-based or agent-based systems.
Experience working with LLM APIs such as OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, or open-source LLMs.
Experience with agent frameworks or orchestration tools such as LangGraph, LangChain, or similar systems.
Experience defining benchmarks, metrics, validation sets, scoring methods, or automated evaluation pipelines.
Strong Python skills and ability to write clean, production-aware research code.
Ability to work with complex, noisy, high-dimensional data.
Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate with experts from different disciplines.
Desired personal traits:
You want to make an impact on humankind
You prioritize “We” over “I”
You enjoy getting things done and striving for excellence
You collaborate effectively with people of diverse backgrounds and cultures
You have a growth mindset
You are candid, authentic, and transparent
When you apply for a role at Immunai, we process your personal data (such as CV, contact details, and professional background) to assess your suitability for current and future roles. Your information may be shared internally with relevant employees and stored or processed by trusted service providers, some of whom may be located outside your country of residence. You can read more about how we process data here: https://www.immunai.com/privacy-policy/ .
Immunai.title: AI Researcher – Agentic AI

Immunai.description:
Description
About Immunai:
Immunai is an AI-driven platform company focused on improving drug discovery and development by decoding the human immune system.
We combine large-scale single cell immune data, advanced machine learning, and strong engineering to help pharmaceutical and research partners make better, more informed decisions throughout the drug development process.
Our long-term goal is to reduce drug development failure rates and help more effective medicines reach patients. We’re building this platform thoughtfully and collaboratively, bringing together expertise across biology, AI, engineering, and business.
Immunai is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.
About the role:
We are looking for a Clinical Data Operations Manager to own the end-to-end process of bringing clinical data into our data platform .
The clinical data operations manager will be responsible for ensuring that clinical data received is properly understood, structured, harmonized, quality-controlled, and ingested into our database in a way that supports downstream scientific, clinical, and computational use cases , and is aligned with all regulatory and contractual requirements.
The ideal candidate has hands-on experience working with clinical trial data, clinical databases, and data harmonization processes , combined with strong technical curiosity and practical experience using AI tools to improve workflows, increase efficiency, and scale operational processes .
Location: Ramat Gan , Israel or Prague , Czech Republic - Hybrid model
What will you do?
Help defining data needs for each project
Own the ingestion process for clinical data received from initial data review through database integration.
Work closely with partners to understand available data, data structure, terminology, documentation, and gaps.
Translate clinical trial data into structured, standardized, and usable data formats for internal systems.
Ensure data quality, consistency, completeness, traceability, accesability and compliance across projects and collaborations.
Partner with data, R&D, product, and engineering teams to define ingestion requirements and improve internal workflows.
Identify opportunities to automate and streamline data review, mapping, harmonization, and QC processes using AI tools and other technical solutions.
Support the development of scalable standards, templates, SOPs, and best practices for clinical data ingestion.
Troubleshoot data issues, resolve inconsistencies, and support continuous improvement of the clinical data platform.
Serve as a key bridge between clinical/scientific stakeholders and technical/data teams.
Requirements
Required qualifications:
Prior experience working with clinical trials metadata, clinical datasets, or patient-level clinical information.

Intuit Israel.description:
In this role you will define, design, and build groundbreaking AI solutions that understand, reason, and act across complex financial and business contexts.
You will collaborate closely with cross-functional experts across AI research, data science, engineering, and product to create intelligent agents that help SMBs automate financial tasks, make smarter decisions, and operate more efficiently. Your work will combine scientific rigor with visionary execution, balancing theoretical innovation with large-scale practical impact.
As a Staff Scientist you set technical direction beyond your own projects. You are a builder-scientist — a creative thinker who develops novel model architectures and training paradigms and also drives their implementation and validation in real-world applications — and you raise the scientific bar for the teams around you. You will help shape the AI foundation that powers transformative products serving millions of customers.
Responsibilities
Set technical direction. Define the technical strategy and roadmap for next-generation agentic and foundation-model systems, and drive innovation and scientific excellence across the organization.
Build foundational models and agents. Design and develop foundational language models and agentic architectures that power intelligent decision-making for small and medium businesses.
Advance the science. Explore novel approaches in large-scale pretraining, fine-tuning (SFT and RLFT/GRPO), retrieval-augmented generation, and reasoning to improve factuality, adaptability, and alignment.
Solve real financial work. Build intelligent agents that understand financial data, customer context, and business workflows — from bookkeeping and autonomous accounting to planning, communication, and insight generation.
Leverage Intuit’s data moat. Turn Intuit’s unique ecosystem signals — counterparty behavior, two-sided transaction visibility, and business twins — into defensible modeling advantages.
Ship end-to-end. Take work from experimentation to production, owning evaluation frameworks and metrics that prove real-world impact.
Elevate others. Mentor scientists and engineers, review technical designs, and grow the craft of the wider team — a core expectation at the Staff level.
Collaborate across functions. Partner with AI research, engineering, product, and design to translate breakthrough science into scalable products used by millions.
Share knowledge. Publish and present research findings, internal innovations, or contributions to open-source frameworks where appropriate.
Qualifications
Qualifications
Ph.D. or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Math, Machine Learning, AI, or a related field, with a track record of technical leadership on complex AI systems.
Proven experience with LLMs, multimodal, or foundation models — including pretraining, fine-tuning, and deployment.
Deep understanding of transformer architectures, reinforcement learning, reasoning models, and agentic systems.
Strong proficiency in Python and modern ML and agentic frameworks .
Demonstrated ability to build end-to-end AI pipelines, from experimentation to production at scale.
Experience influencing technical direction across multiple teams and mentoring other scientists and engineers.
Excellent problem-solving, collaboration, and communication skills.
A passion for creating AI that augments human potential and simplifies complex business workflows.
Nice to have
Experience applying RL fine-tuning (GRPO, RLHF/RLFT) or model-based RL to language or decision-making systems.
Background in financial, accounting, or business-domain AI, or in probabilistic forecasting and world models is a major advantage.
Publications at top ML venues or meaningful open-source contributions.

Israaid.description:
ABOUT ISRAAID
IsraAID is an international non-governmental humanitarian aid organization headquartered in Israel, with humanitarian missions around the world. Our mission is to support people affected by humanitarian crises, and we have responded to more than 115 emergencies in 65+ countries since we were founded in 2001. Wherever floods, droughts, hurricanes, earthquakes, wildfires, conflicts, and other hazards strike, we are side-by-side with communities on the ground. We provide immediate relief, support recovery, and reduce the risks of future emergencies.
ABOUT DEVCOMMS
IsraAID’s DevComms department – comprising the development and communications teams – is responsible for securing IsraAID’s financial stability and growth. We lead IsraAID's global fundraising strategy, uphold the global fundraising infrastructure, and promote the organization’s visibility, brand, storytelling, and messaging to diverse audiences.
As a Senior Development Officer, you will be part of our fundraising arm – mostly producing and coordinating funding requests, compliance, and other donor-facing literature, for a range of philanthropic and humanitarian institutional donors. You’ll also own several strategic portfolios within the development stream. These responsibilities will bring you into regular contact with IsraAID’s global humanitarian missions; fundraising offices in the US, Canada, and Australia; and other departments at HQ.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
Write grant applications, proposals, reports, and other materials for charitable foundations, federations, individual donors, and humanitarian institutions.
Lead the development of complex funding proposal packages, in close coordination with humanitarian missions worldwide and HQ-based colleagues.
Support IsraAID's global fundraising teams and humanitarian missions, including help with proposals, reports, and digital tools.
Research, map, and identify new donor audiences and funding opportunities.
Hold key portfolios, likely to include 1-2 donor groups and 1-2 projects/workstreams.
Support logistics, operations, and follow-up for donor visits to humanitarian missions.
Input data into Salesforce, IsraAID's donor CRM system.
Present to visiting groups and at relevant events/conferences.
IDEAL CANDIDATE
Native or as-native English speaker.
Strong, ideally professional-level spoken and written Hebrew.
Outstanding written communication skills, including writing, proofing, and editing.
4-6 years grant writing experience, with a proven record of writing grant applications, proposals, and reports in English at a very high level.
Experience in project/portfolio management.
Ability to translate program data into stories that donors/supporters can connect to.
Ability to read program budgets. This role does not include budget management, but you will need to understand budgets and financial reports for donors.
Experience in using CRM/donor database systems, preferably Salesforce.
Knowledge of the philanthropic field – charitable foundations, institutional and governmental donors, Jewish Federations and individual donors.
Flexibility and ability to work under pressure, prioritize, and meet deadlines, both independently and as part of an extremely busy team. This includes readiness to operate when IsraAID deploys to an emergency setting and workloads increase temporarily but significantly.
ADVANTAGES
Experience in humanitarian aid, international development, or human rights.
Experience working as part of a resource development team.
Basic design skills (Canva).
ETHICAL STANDARDS
IsraAID has zero tolerance towards any acts of misconduct and Sexual Exploitation and Abuse (SEA). The recruitment process will include all candidates’ declarations and reference checks focused on misconduct and SEA.
EQUAL OPPORTUNITIES
IsraAID is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or disability status.
* Seniority level will be determined based on the successful candidate's relevant experience.
Israaid.title: Senior Development Officer

Israaid.description:
About IsraAID
IsraAID is an international humanitarian NGO headquartered in Israel, operating strictly on humanitarian principles in a complex political environment. This identity affords a distinct operational role: facilitating coordination between international humanitarian actors and Israeli authorities while maintaining impartiality, neutrality, and an unconditional commitment to vulnerable populations regardless of race, nationality, religion, or politics. In practice, this has enabled IsraAID to support the delivery of essential aid into Gaza while helping international organizations navigate access, shipment, procurement, and customs processes.
IsraAID’s teams have worked in over 65 countries since 2001. Current programs include supporting long-term displaced populations in Uganda, South Sudan, and Colombia, and responding to emergencies most recently in Myanmar, Jamaica and Sri Lanka IsraAID's approach is community-centered and long-term, spanning relief, recovery, and resilience across mental health and psychosocial support, child protection, education, WASH, health, and livelihoods. All programming is developed in partnership with local actors, drawing on their expertise and resources to build lasting community ownership.
The Projects
Over the past two years, IsraAID has provided humanitarian assistance to nearly 500,000 individuals in Gaza, primarily through capacity building and support for local partners. Building on this ongoing response, we are now expanding our Middle East portfolio to assist affected communities across the wider region. Our core focus areas include Public Health, Mental Health and Psychosocial Support (MHPSS), Child Protection, and Water, Sanitation, and Hygiene (WASH). The particular details of IsraAID’s involvement in Gaza and the rest of the Middle East remain extremely confidential due to the sensitivity.
What we are looking for?
Arabic-speaking humanitarian program/projects officers – with experience in project design, tracking, and implementation
Arabic-speaking Public Health, Mental Health and Psychosocial Support (MHPSS) or Water, Sanitation, and Hygiene (WASH) specialists
Preference for candidates who can work from IsraAID’s HQ in Tel Aviv at least three times a week.
Israaid.title: Call for Arabic-speaking Humanitarian Professionals

In this role, you will support the delivery of complex semiconductor projects, working across planning, engineering, architectural design, construction management and design-build project delivery.

Jacobs.description:
As a Senior Piping Designer , you will develop piping layouts, 3D models, and construction deliverables for complex facilities while working closely with engineers and multidisciplinary design teams. You will support the successful execution of projects through quality design, discipline coordination, constructability awareness, and field verification.
Key responsibilities:
• Develop piping layouts, routing, and 3D models using CADWorx for semiconductor and advanced manufacturing facilities.
• Produce piping deliverables including plans, sections, isometrics, details, material take-offs, sketches, and construction drawings.
• Interpret P&IDs, piping specifications, vendor documentation, and engineering requirements.
• Model piping systems and supports in accordance with project standards, client requirements, and industry practices.
• Coordinate with Process, Mechanical, Structural, Architectural, and Electrical disciplines to resolve design issues and support integrated project delivery.
• Support the design of semiconductor utility and process piping systems, including systems such as UPW, PCW, CDA, process gas, chemical distribution, and waste collection.
• Perform model reviews and self-checks to ensure accurate, complete, and coordinated deliverables.
• Conduct field walkdowns, site surveys, and design verification activities as required.
• Identify constructability concerns, scope changes, and design impacts and communicate them proactively.
• Provide technical support to engineers, project teams, and construction support activities.
• Collaborate effectively with geographically distributed teams supporting global project execution.
Here's what you'll need
• 5+ years of piping design experience in industrial facilities.
• Minimum 3 years of recent CADWorx piping design and modeling experience.
• Experience producing piping models, drawings, and construction deliverables.
• Understanding of piping specifications, materials, equipment interfaces, pipe supports, and piping layout fundamentals.
• Ability to read and interpret P&IDs, vendor drawings, and engineering documentation.
• Experience working within a multidisciplinary design environment.
• Strong organizational, problem-solving, and coordination skills.
• Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications.
• Excellent English communication skills, both written and spoken, with the ability to effectively collaborate with global engineering and project teams.
• Ability and willingness to work on-site five days per week at our Kiryat Gat office.
Ideally, You'll Also Have:
• Experience supporting semiconductor facility projects.
• Knowledge of semiconductor utility and process piping systems.
• Experience using Navisworks for model review and coordination.
• Familiarity with brownfield modifications, tie-ins, and field verification activities.
• Experience supporting global or multi-office project teams.
• Experience performing model quality reviews and deliverable coordination.
• Technical education, engineering studies, practical engineering certification, or equivalent industry experience.

This challenging position involves working as part of a multi-discipline, highly interactive and coordinated team focused on projects including semiconductor manufacturing, data centre facilities, and other state of the art manufacturing facilities. Come be a part of a vibrant, dynamic team that delivers world class designs for industry leading clients around the world. We design of some of the most complex and specialized facilities being constructed today. This team is a fantastic place for an early to mid-level Engineer to take their career to new heights—you name the practice; we’ve got an expert to learn from!
Projects for our clients include feasibility studies, long-range planning studies, and full design services including programming, schematic design, design development, construction documents, and services during construction for design/bid/build and design/build projects.
The ideal candidate will be a self-motivated individual with strong communication skills. They will exhibit a passion and desire to apply their technical experience and knowledge in a team environment on technically challenging and professionally rewarding projects. Our team is seeking a person who understands the importance of meeting their targeted commitments while being flexible to the ever-changing and fast paced environment of our clients’ sites.
Responsibilities:
• Organize, assign, and delegate necessary engineering and design tasks to produce construction documents in conjunction with a team of engineers and designers.
• Manage scope, budget and schedule to meet project goals.

• The right to work in Israel.

scenarios.

Justt.description:
Description
Justt is looking for a hands-on, highly operational Director of Support & Operations to lead and scale our global Support and Chargeback Operations organization.
This is a player-coach role for someone who is equally comfortable defining a long-term strategy and diving into queues, tickets, escalations, quality issues, and day-to-day execution.
You will own our global Support model across Tier 0, Tier 1, and Tier 2, managing a combination of internal teams, offshore resources, and outsourced partners. A key part of the role will be strengthening Tier 2 capabilities, reducing unnecessary escalations, and enabling our Solution Engineering team to focus on the most complex technical challenges.
What You’ll Own
Lead the daily performance of Support and Chargeback Operations.
Manage queues, escalations, backlog, SLAs, quality, and customer communication.
Build a scalable Tier 0, Tier 1, and Tier 2 operating model.
Establish clear ownership, workflows, escalation paths, and quality standards.
Coach team members and develop future team leads and managers.
Manage offshore teams, outsourced partners, vendors, and operational budgets.
Build capacity and workforce plans based on growth, volume, and service levels.
Develop knowledge management, training, and self-service capabilities.
Use AI and automation to improve speed, quality, consistency, and efficiency.
Define and track operational KPIs, identify root causes, and drive continuous improvement.
The Person We’re Looking For
You are a builder-operator who takes personal ownership when something isn’t working. You measure performance, investigate the details, solve root causes, and build the people, processes, technology, and management structure required to scale.
If your instinct when Support is struggling is “Show me the tickets,” we should talk.
An empty job that is used for creating requisitions 'from scratch'
Requirements
What We’re Looking For
7+ years of experience in Enterprise Technical Support, Customer Support, Customer Operations, or a similar B2B SaaS function.
Significant hands-on experience running and transforming Support operations.
Proven success as a player-coach in a growing organization.
Experience building Tier 1 and Tier 2 models, workflows, and escalation processes.
Experience managing offshore or outsourced Support teams and vendors.
Strong workforce planning, capacity management, budgeting, and analytical skills.
Technical orientation and comfort with APIs, integrations, data, and complex SaaS products.
Experience using AI, automation, and modern Support tools.
Excellent communication and leadership skills.
Fintech, payments, or complex B2B technology experience is strongly preferred.

Description
We're looking for an Enterprise Customer Success Manager to join our team in Tel Aviv. This is a revenue-driving role with a project management core: you'll own retention, upsell, and cross-sell targets for a portfolio of top-tier EMEA accounts, and you'll hit them by running tight, structured execution across every function that touches the account. You'll represent both the voice of Justt and the voice of the customer - partnering with diverse payment stakeholders externally and orchestrating multiple internal teams to deliver measurable revenue growth.
What you'll do
Identify and execute upsell and cross-sell opportunities end-to-end, from opportunity to signed revenue
Build and run structured account plans that protect and grow revenue against clear retention goals
Analyze portfolio performance, combining data and customer feedback to build the commercial case for growth
Lead business review meetings and manage senior stakeholders to strengthen multi-level relationships and open new revenue conversations
Project-manage account issues end-to-end - coordinating Solutions Engineering, Product, Data, Legal, and Support to close gaps fast and keep deals and renewals on track
Collect and communicate client feedback to Product and R&D teams to influence roadmap priorities
Requirements
5+ years of experience as a Customer Success Manager or Account Manager, carrying and hitting revenue KPIs (retention, upsell, cross-sell) for enterprise accounts
Strong project management skills - proven ability to run complex, multi-stakeholder workstreams to a deadline
Strong analytical mindset with the ability to interpret data and translate it into insights and actions
Demonstrated success in building and growing long-term, value-driven customer relationships that convert into expansion revenue
Comfortable operating in fast-paced, dynamic environments
Willingness to travel at least once per quarter
Fluent English; Hebrew a plus, but not a must.
Experience in the payments industry - an advantage

Justt.description:
Description
Justt helps many of the world's largest and most recognizable brands turn chargebacks from a constant headache into a managed, predictable part of doing business. Our AI-driven platform powers chargeback operations at scale, automating disputes end to end, recovering revenue that would otherwise be lost, and removing a major operational burden from finance, risk, and operations teams across multiple regions and verticals.
We're a global company with teams across markets and disciplines, working closely with leading players in the payments ecosystem. Our culture is built on clear thinking, collaboration, and a strong sense of ownership. At Justt, you'll partner with product, engineering, data, success and go-to-market teams to build technology that sits at the core of modern payments, and has a direct, measurable impact on the bottom line for some of the biggest companies in the world.
Role Overview
The Payments Analyst plays a critical role in ensuring the accuracy, consistency, and integrity of chargeback-related data across multiple platforms and internal systems. This position combines strong research, analytical and technical skills with cross-functional collaboration to support efficient chargeback management operations and enhance data-driven decision-making.
This role also acts as a connective layer between Operations and Engineering — translating operational issues into technical investigations, and technical findings back into clear operational context.
What You'll Do
Research payment service providers (PSPs) and acquire knowledge of their data structures, workflows, and reporting standards
Map, normalize, and validate data from external systems to align with internal data
Monitor key operational systems, dashboards, and application logs to identify data anomalies, errors, or breakdowns in the chargeback lifecycle
Serve as a bridge between Operations and Engineering — triage incoming issues, investigate them technically, and escalate with clear, reproducible context when developer involvement is needed
Conduct root-cause analysis to resolve data discrepancies and ensure accurate case handling and reporting outcomes
Query internal databases using SQL to analyze trends and troubleshoot issues
Collaborate with multiple teams — including product, operations, and engineering — to resolve edge cases, maintain data integrity, and support system enhancement
Communicate with PSP representatives as needed to clarify data formats, investigate issues, and ensure proper integration
Leverage AI tools to enhance data processing, research, and workflow efficiency (or demonstrate willingness to adopt new technologies)
Contribute to internal process documentation and best practices
Requirements
What You Bring
At least 2–3 years of experience in a tech company or fintech startup
Strong analytical mindset with the ability to detect and resolve data irregularities
Technically hands-on — comfortable reading application logs and navigating monitoring/observability tools to investigate issues independently
Comfort working with data and dashboards
Proficiency in SQL for querying and data validation
Excellent attention to detail with strong organizational and problem-solving abilities, ownership mentality and a bias for action
Strong communication and documentation skills
Fluency in English
Nice to Have
Familiarity with payments, disputes, and/or chargeback workflows — Big Advantage
Experience working with PSP portals, merchant reporting dashboards, or chargeback platforms — Big Advantage
Familiarity with observability/monitoring tools (e.g. Groundcover, Datadog, Kibana) — Advantage
Interest in and potential to grow into a Scrum Master / process-owner role — comfortable driving cadence, coordinating across teams, and improving workflows
Comfort learning new systems, tools, and automation technologies

חזור
תיאור המשרה
פלנר/ית לתחום הפלסמה - תפקיד ראשון עם השפעה בסביבה גלובלית מתפתחת
קמהדע מגייסת מהנדס/ת תעשייה וניהול לתפקיד חדש בתחום הפלסמה – חומר גלם ביולוגי המשמש לייצור תרופות ייחודיות.
התפקיד משלב תכנון שרשרת אספקה, ניתוח נתונים, בניית תהליכים ועבודה מול מרכזי פעילות בארה״ב וממשקים מקצועיים בישראל.
מה כולל התפקיד?
בניית תוכניות עבודה ותחזיות בהתאם לצורכי הפעילות והייצור.
תכנון ובקרת מלאים ותנועת חומרים בין אתרים שונים.
חיבור בין נתונים, ביקושים ואילוצים לצורך יצירת תמונת תכנון כוללת.
בניית תהליכי עבודה, כלי בקרה ומדדי ביצוע.
מעקב אחר התכנון מול הביצוע, זיהוי פערים וקידום פתרונות מול הממשקים הרלוונטיים.
השתלבות בפרויקטים מתפתחים בתחום הפלסמה.
עבודה שוטפת עם מרכזי פעילות וממשקים מקצועיים בארץ ובארה״ב.
מה אנחנו מחפשים?
מהנדס/ת תעשייה וניהול – חובה.
אנגלית ברמה גבוהה.
יכולת אנליטית־טכנולוגית גבוהה, ראייה מערכתית ויכולת עבודה מול ממשקים.
למה כדאי להצטרף?
זהו תפקיד חדש המאפשר להשתלב בתחום עסקי מתפתח ולהיות שותפים בבניית תהליכי העבודה ויכולות התכנון שלו. התפקיד מתאים למהנדס/ת בתחילת הדרך המחפש/ת שילוב בין אנליטיקה, טכנולוגיה, שרשרת אספקה ועבודה גלובלית, עם אפשרות ללמוד, להשפיע ולצמוח יחד עם הפעילות.
לא נדרשת היכרות מוקדמת עם תחום הפלסמה.

אנחנו מחפשים יועץ/ת משפטי/ת בכיר/ה ומנוסה להובלת ההיבטים המשפטיים של התחום המסחרי בארגון, תוך שותפות מקצועית עם הנהלת החברה ועם כלל היחידות העסקיות. התפקיד כולל מתן ליווי משפטי שוטף לתהליכים העסקיים בחברה, ועבודה עם כלל מחלקות הארגון, לרבות: רכש, פיתוח עסקי שיווק ומכירות, תפעול ועוד – בישראל, בארה"ב, ובמדינות הנוספות בהן פועלת החברה. בנוסף, במסגרת תפקידך תהיה/י שותף/ה בקידום פרויקטים אסטרטגיים חוצי ארגון בסביבה דינמית וגלובלית.
תחומי אחריות
ליווי משפטי וניהול מטריציוני של תהליכי התקשרויות מסחריות בארגון.
מתן ייעוץ משפטי שוטף למחלקות השונות בארגון ותמיכה בקבלת החלטות עסקיות.
עבודה שוטפת מול יועצים משפטיים חיצוניים וניהול הקשר עמם.
שיפור, ייעול והטמעת תהליכי התקשרות ונהלים בארגון.
הובלה והשתתפות בפרויקטים חוצי מחלקות וביוזמות אסטרטגיות.
השתתפות בפורומים ניהוליים של הארגון.
דיווח ל : סמנכ"ל, היועץ המשפטי הראשי
דרישות התפקיד
חובה
לפחות 8 שנות ניסיון כעו"ד, כולל ניסיון משמעותי בארגון עסקי.
תואר ראשון במשפטים ותואר שני בתחומים קשורים.
רישיון ישראלי תקף לעריכת דין.
אנגלית ברמה גבוהה מאוד, בכתב ובעל פה.
יתרון משמעותי
ניסיון כעו"ד בתחום הפארמה.
ניסיון בעבודה בסביבה גלובלית.
ידע בתחומי קניין רוחני, פרטיות וניסויים קליניים.
שימוש שוטף ומתקדם בכלי AI.
מי מתאים לתפקיד ?
אנחנו מחפשים יועץ/ת משפטי/ת מעולה בעל/ת ראייה עסקית רחבה לצד יכולת ירידה לפרטים, יכולות ניהול מוכחות ותודעת שירות גבוהה, יכולת הובלה והנעה לצד מוסר עבודה גבוה ויכולת עבודה עצמאית בסביבה מורכבת ומרובת משימות.
אם אתם מחפשים תפקיד משמעותי המשלב השפעה עסקית, הובלה מקצועית ואתגר משפטי בסביבה מתקדמת וגלובלית - נשמח להכיר אתכם .

הובלת תהליכי פיתוח ארגוני, שינוי, שיפור ממשקים ופיתוח צוותים.
הובלת תוכניות ותהליכי פיתוח מנהיגות, מנהלים וטאלנטים.
פיתוח והטמעת תפיסות, תהליכים וכלים בתחום הפיתוח הארגוני, לרבות הערכת עובדים, תפיסת ניהול, מצוינות ארגונית ושיפור תהליכים .
אחריות על תהליכי למידה, הכשרה, הסמכה ופיתוח מקצועי .

בניית פעילות הלמידה וההכשרה בחברות הבנות ובממשקים גלובליים .
אחריות על מדיניות הדרכה והסמכה בהתאם לדרישות רגולציה ותקני איכות .
ניהול מערכת ,LMS ספקים, תקציב ותוכניות למידה דיגיטליות .
ייעוץ וליווי הנהלה בתהליכים ארגוניים וניהוליים .
ניהול מקצועי וישיר של צוות ההדרכה.

לפחות 10 שנות ניסיון בתחומי פיתוח ארגוני, למידה, פיתוח מנהלים והדרכה.
ניסיון בארגון גלובלי או רב־לאומי, הכולל הובלת תהליכים חוצי ארגון .
לפחות 4 שנות ניסיון בבנייה ובהובלה של תוכניות פיתוח מנהלים ומנהיגות .
ניסיון בהובלת תהליכי שינוי ופיתוח ארגוני .
ניסיון בבניית תוכניות עבודה, ניהול תקציב וניהול ספקים .
ניסיון בעבודה עם מערכת LMS .
ניסיון בחברת פארמה, ביוטכנולוגיה, מכשור רפואי או סביבה רגולטורית – יתרון.

הבנה עסקית ויכולת לתרגם צרכים ארגוניים לפתרונות מעשיים .

Kardome.description:
Jobs Archive - Kardome Voice AI
Join Kardome
Build the Voice AI
Voice is the interface of the future. That’s why we developed Voice UI that hears and understands like people do. It makes voice UI work as it should, providing frustration-free voice experiences anywhere, anytime for smart devices that people love to use.
Kardome gives smart devices the ability to hear and localize sound sources, identify who’s speaking, and understand what they mean in context, for natural, intuitive voice interactions that perform reliably in the most complex environments: Powered by our Spatial Hearing AI and Cognition AI technologies.
Where Every Voice Shapes the Signal
Together, we’re building the intelligence that makes Voice UI truly listen, understand, and connect.
Impact First
Every team member contributes directly to the intelligence behind our AI.
From concept to deployment, your work shapes how millions will interact with technology. We move quickly, learn constantly, and deliver results that redefine what AI can do.
Own the Clarity
At Kardome, ownership means taking full responsibility for the entire chain of communication, from our first line of code to the final customer experience.
Every team member at Kardome acts on behalf of the whole company and is empowered to identify a problem, bridge a gap, or fix a bug, even when it's outside their direct scope. We never say, "that's not my job."
Open Collaboration
We keep hierarchy light and communication open.
You’ll have direct access to leadership, visibility into decision-making, and the freedom to experiment.
We believe great ideas thrive where transparency and trust are the norm.
Growth Mindset
AI doesn’t stand still — and neither do we.
We invest in your growth through ongoing learning, mentorship, and the opportunity to explore new frontiers in spatial hearing and cognitive AI.
Here, mastery is never final — it’s a journey we take together.
Shape the Future of Voice AI.

Kenes Group.description:
In this role you will support the Officers and Council and manage the secretariat, activities, and operations of the association in accordance with guidelines and objectives.
Responsibilities :
Responsibilities:
The Association Manager is responsible for the overall administration and smooth operation of the society, supporting its strategic, operational, and business objectives.
Key Areas of Responsibility:
Administration & Operations:
Manage the association’s day-to-day activities, stakeholder communication, documentation, and internal processes.
Meeting & Board Management:
Coordinate and manage virtual and in-person meetings (Board, committees, General Assembly), including logistics, materials, minutes, and follow-ups.
Executive & Governance Support:
Support the Board and Officers, implement strategic plans and policies, manage elections, governance processes, and key programs (e.g., grants, endorsements).
Project & Event Management:
Plan and deliver key projects, awards, grants, and support congress coordination with relevant stakeholders.
Communications & Marketing:
Manage member communications, newsletters, website, and social media; support branding, visibility, and promotional activities.
Financial Coordination:
Support financial operations including budgeting, invoicing, payments, reporting, and coordination with finance teams.
Membership Management:
Oversee membership processes, database management, renewals, engagement, and growth initiatives.
Stakeholder Management:
Work closely with Board members, partners, suppliers, and internal teams to ensure effective collaboration.
Qualifications:
University degree, or equivalent
Excellent English (written/spoken)
Excellent computer skills (Microsoft Office – Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook)
Working knowledge of online systems such as WordPress, CRM system.
Experience:
3–5 years of experience in an administrative, Project Managment, coordination role
Experience working with non-profit associations / NGOs – an advantage
The following skills and attributes are essential:
Strong administrative and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously
Tech-savvy, with hands-on experience using a variety of digital tools (e.g., Canva, Mailchimp, Elementor, and similar platforms)
High level of commercial and financial awareness
Well-developed communication and interpersonal skills
Good judgment, with the ability to work independently, proactively, and creatively
Ability to build effective working relationships with a wide range of stakeholders, including international counterparts
Discretion, diplomacy, and strong attention to detail
WHAT WE OFFER: 
Competitive salary and full-time labor contract.
Flexible benefits program: food vouchers, optional additional health insurance, corporate discounts, etc.
Fixed working hours (Monday-Friday).
Hybrid working mode, excellent office location, and free shuttle bus from the metro station to the office.
Gifts for special occasions, fruits, massages, and yoga classes in the office once per week.
Real opportunities for professional development in a leading international company.
Friendly team culture that promotes initial and continual professional education and team collaboration.
Regular team events.
Refer a friend program.
In case you are interested in this position, please submit your  CV in English.  
Only short-listed candidates will be contacted. 
All documents will be treated with the strictest confidentiality!

Why Kenes:
With more than 60 years of experience, Kenes Group is a global PCO leader and association management. Our team of 250 employees works together to create impactful professional events. We foster a family-like work environment within our global company, where collaboration and support are at the heart of what we do. We believe in empowering our employees by equipping them with knowledge and skills that help them grow and advance in their careers. We understand the significance of work-life balance and strive to create an atmosphere that supports personal well-being, to meet the diverse needs of our employees.
Job Summary:
We are seeking a motivated, proactive, and detail-oriented Controller to join our Finance Department. Reporting to the Director of Finance, you will play a key role in supporting financial operations, budgeting, and reporting, collaborating closely with our global bookkeeping team, international subsidiaries, and advisors. The ideal candidate is analytical, hands-on, and thrives in a dynamic, global environment.
Key Responsibilities:
• Support day-to-day finance activities and accounting operations.
• Perform monthly budget vs. actual analysis and prepare financial reports.
• Assist in annual budget preparation and ongoing monitoring.
• Prepare and review financial statements, tax reports, and statutory filings.
• Collaborate with international subsidiaries to ensure standardized reporting.
• Work closely with external auditors and advisors, both in Israel and abroad.
• Partner with the global bookkeeping team to ensure accurate and timely reporting.
• Provide management with financial insights and flag issues when necessary.
• Participate in financial projects, system implementations, and process improvements.
• Manage accounting operations processes as needed.
Requirements & Qualifications:
• Bachelor’s degree in Accounting – required.
• Certified Public Accountant (CPA) – required.
• 1–3 years of relevant experience after an accounting firm or as a manager in a firm, including preparation of financial statements – required.
• Experience working in a global environment – required.
• Big 4 background – advantage.
• NetSuite experience – advantage.
• Full professional proficiency in English (written and spoken) – required.
• Excellent Excel and analytical skills.
• Strong accounting and financial process knowledge.
• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills; able to collaborate across global teams.
• Proactive, solution-oriented with strong attention to detail.
• Ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic environment.

Keter.description: מנהל.ת איכות ארגונית אסטרטגית – כתר | חיפוש קריירה | משרות בכתר דלג לתוכן חזרה לחיפוש עבודה שיתוף מנהל.ת איכות ארגונית אסטרטגית משרה מלאה כרמיאל איכות תיאור התפקיד אנחנו מגייסים מנהל.ת איכות ליחידה עסקית ניהול כולל של מערך האיכות ביחידה העסקית ואיכות המוצרים באופן גלובאלי משלבי הפיתוח דרך ייצורם ועד הגעתם ללקוח - חבר.ת הנהלה כפיפות למנכ"ל מה כולל התפקיד? ניהול אסטרטגית האיכות של היחידה- בנית מערך האיכות והטמעת תהליכים לתרבות לאיכות. הבנה עסקית כוללת וראיה אסטרטגית בעבודה מול ממשקים עם מנהלי מחלקות בארגון התוויה וניהול של תוכניות האיכות בכל אתרי הייצור של היחידה כולל ייצור בחו''ל. כתיבת תוכניות העבודה של המחלקה בהתאם לדרישות האיכות של החברה כולל תוכניות רב שנתיות. אחריות להסמכת המפעלים ביחידה לכל דרישות התקינה של הלקוחות ועמידה בהם. ניתוח נתונים ועלויות איכות ואי איכות הנעת תהליכי שיפור מתמיד. אחריות למבדקים חיצוניים טיפול בתלונות לקוחות וכן אחריות לביצוע פעולות מתקנות במפעל קביעת מדדי KPI בתחום איכות וניהול חבר.ת הנהלת היחידה ניהול ישיר של מנכ"ל היחידה. מה אנחנו מחפשים? השכלה רלוונטית בתחומי מערכות איכות ניסיון משמעותי קודם בניהול והובלת איכות במפעל תעשייתי-חובה ניסיון בעבודה מרובת ממשקים בישראל ובחו"ל ניסיון בניהול צוותי ניהול ישירים אנגלית ברמה גבוהה מאוד שליטה במבדקים חיצוניים ופנימיים הגשת מועמדות כל השדות הם חובה שם פרטי שם משפחה אימייל נייד ת.ז. קורות חיים העלאת קורות חיים הגשת מועמדות משרות דומות כתר פותחת לך דלת משרה מלאה אלון תבור בלתי מקצועי / כללי מחפש.ת להשתלב בתעשייה? אולי כתר תהיה המקום בשבילך! אם הגעת עד לכאן ולא מצאת משרה מתאימה, באפשרותך לצרף בתחתית העמוד… הגשת מועמדות שיתוף מפעיל.ת מכונת הדפסה משרה מלאה כרמיאל מכונות אנחנו מגייסים מפעיל.ת מכונת הדפסה במסגרת התפקיד: הכנת קו ייצור להדפסה פיקוח על הרכב חומרי גלם ודרישות צבע שמירה על תחזוקת… הגשת מועמדות שיתוף כוון.ית משרה מלאה כרמיאל מכונות אנחנו מגייסים כוונ.ית למחלקת הזרקה במסגרת התפקיד: תפעול מכונות ההזרקה בהתאם להוראות הפעלה ונהלים ידע בהחלפת תבניות והכנה לייצור בהתאם… הגשת מועמדות שיתוף מבלטן.ית לבית מלאכה משרה מלאה כרמיאל מכונות אנחנו מגייסים מבלטן.ית לבית מלאכה במסגרת התפקיד: הפעלת מערך תחזוקת התבניות (שבר או מונעת) תוך מתן מענה לתוכנית היצור /… הגשת מועמדות שיתוף מעצב.ת מוצר למחלקת פיתוח משרה מלאה יקנעם פיתוח אנחנו מגייסים מעצב.ת מוצר למחלקת פיתוח לסביבת עבודה דינמית, מאתגרת ומלאת יצירתיות. אנחנו מחפשים מעצבים ומעצבות עם תשוקה לחדשנות, סקרנות… הגשת מועמדות שיתוף כלכלנ.ית מפעל משרה מלאה אלון תבור פיננסי אנחנו מגייסים כלכלנ.ית מפעל לניתוח והתייעלות כל ההיבטים העסקיים של המפעל מה כולל התפקיד? בניית תקציב תפעולי מעקב אחר מלאים התייעלות… הגשת מועמדות שיתוף מנהל.ת תיקי לקוחות פרטיים משרה מלאה צפון מכירות אנחנו מגייסים מנהל.ת תיקי לקוחות פרטיים לניהול קשרי לקוחות, הרחבת סל המוצרים , ליווי אישי משלב קבלת ההזמנה ועד אספקת… הגשת מועמדות שיתוף מבלטן.ית לבית מלאכה משרה מלאה אלון תבור מכונות אנחנו מגייסים מבלטן.ית לבית מלאכה במסגרת התפקיד: הפעלת מערך תחזוקת התבניות (שבר או מונעת) תוך מתן מענה לתוכנית היצור /… הגשת מועמדות שיתוף מוביל.ת צוות עיצוב ופיתוח מוצרים משרה מלאה כרמיאל עיצוב מוצר אנחנו מגייסים מוביל.ת צוות עיצוב ופיתוח מוצרים התפקיד כולל הובלה וניהול של צוות פיתוח המוצר, והובלת פרויקטים, משלב הרעיון ועד… הגשת מועמדות שיתוף מחסנאי.ת עם רישיון מלגזה משרה מלאה אלון תבור לוגיסטיקה ומחסנאות אנחנו מגייסים מחסנאי.ת עם רישיון מלגזה במסגרת התפקיד: שינוע סחורה באמצעות מלגזה. קבלה, העמסה ופריקה של סחורה. טיפול בהזמנות, ליקוט… הגשת מועמדות שיתוף טכנאי.ת מכונת הדפסה משרה מלאה אלון תבור מכונות אנחנו מגייסים טכנאי.ת מכונת הדפסה במסגרת התפקיד: איתור, אבחון וטיפול בתקלות טכניות במכונות ההדפסה בהתאם לנהלי העבודה והנחיות היצרן. שמירה… הגשת מועמדות שיתוף מנהל.ת מפעל בכיר.ה משרה מלאה אלון תבור תפעול מנהל.ת מפעל להובלת מצוינות תפעולית וטרנספורמציה ארגונית בסביבה יצרנית מורכבת אנחנו מגייסים מנהל.ת מפעל מנוסה, שצמח.ה מתוך עולם הייצור ומביא.ה… הגשת מועמדות שיתוף מנהל.ת לוגיסטיקה משרה מלאה כרמיאל לוגיסטיקה ומחסנאות אנחנו מגייסים מנהל.ת לוגיסטיקה ניהול כולל של מערך הלוגיסטיקה, המחסן וההפצה במפעל, תוך הקפדה על בטיחות, יעילות תפעולית ואיכות השירות. במסגרת… הגשת מועמד

בניית תקציב תפעולי מעקב אחר מלאים התייעלות… הגשת מועמדות שיתוף מנהל.ת תיקי לקוחות פרטיים משרה מלאה צפון מכירות אנחנו מגייסים מנהל.ת תיקי לקוחות פרטיים לניהול קשרי לקוחות, הרחבת סל המוצרים , ליווי אישי משלב קבלת ההזמנה ועד אספקת… הגשת מועמדות שיתוף מבלטן.ית לבית מלאכה משרה מלאה אלון תבור מכונות אנחנו מגייסים מבלטן.ית לבית מלאכה במסגרת התפקיד: הפעלת מערך תחזוקת התבניות (שבר או מונעת) תוך מתן מענה לתוכנית היצור /… הגשת מועמדות שיתוף מוביל.ת צוות עיצוב ופיתוח מוצרים משרה מלאה כרמיאל עיצוב מוצר אנחנו מגייסים מוביל.ת צוות עיצוב ופיתוח מוצרים התפקיד כולל הובלה וניהול של צוות פיתוח המוצר, והובלת פרויקטים, משלב הרעיון ועד… הגשת מועמדות שיתוף מחסנאי.ת עם רישיון מלגזה משרה מלאה אלון תבור לוגיסטיקה ומחסנאות אנחנו מגייסים מחסנאי.ת עם רישיון מלגזה במסגרת התפקיד: שינוע סחורה באמצעות מלגזה. קבלה, העמסה ופריקה של סחורה. טיפול בהזמנות, ליקוט… הגשת מועמדות שיתוף טכנאי.ת מכונת הדפסה משרה מלאה אלון תבור מכונות אנחנו מגייסים טכנאי.ת מכונת הדפסה במסגרת התפקיד: איתור, אבחון וטיפול בתקלות טכניות במכונות ההדפסה בהתאם לנהלי העבודה והנחיות היצרן. שמירה… הגשת מועמדות שיתוף מנהל.ת מפעל בכיר.ה משרה מלאה אלון תבור תפעול מנהל.ת מפעל להובלת מצוינות תפעולית וטרנספורמציה ארגונית בסביבה יצרנית מורכבת אנחנו מגייסים מנהל.ת מפעל מנוסה, שצמח.ה מתוך עולם הייצור ומביא.ה… הגשת מועמדות שיתוף מנהל.ת לוגיסטיקה משרה מלאה כרמיאל לוגיסטיקה ומחסנאות אנחנו מגייסים מנהל.ת לוגיסטיקה ניהול כולל של מערך הלוגיסטיקה, המחסן וההפצה במפעל, תוך הקפדה על בטיחות, יעילות תפעולית ואיכות השירות. במסגרת… הגשת מועמדות שיתוף מנהל.ת איכות ארגונית אסטרטגית משרה מלאה כרמיאל איכות אנחנו מגייסים מנהל.ת איכות ליחידה עסקית ניהול כולל של מערך האיכות ביחידה העסקית ואיכות המוצרים באופן גלובאלי משלבי הפיתוח דרך… הגשת מועמדות שיתוף HRBP משרה מלאה אלון תבור משאבי אנוש HRBP Senior ליחידה עסקית יצרנית כתר, חברה גלובלית מובילה, מחפשת HR Business Partner בכיר.ה לשותפות אסטרטגית עם הנהלת יחיד

Keter.description:
Job Description
Global Internal Control Manager
About the Role
The Global Internal Control Manager is responsible for strengthening Keter's internal control framework across global operations, with a strong focus on business and operational processes. The role partners with Manufacturing, Procurement, Supply Chain, Logistics, IT, and Finance teams to identify risks, improve processes, and enhance operational effectiveness.
Key Responsibilities
Assess end-to-end business and operational processes across Manufacturing, Procurement, Supply Chain, Logistics, and Finance.
Identify control gaps, process inefficiencies, and opportunities for improvement.
Conduct risk assessments and support the design and implementation of effective controls.
Perform on-site reviews and audits at manufacturing facilities.
Support IT General Controls (ITGCs) and other cross-functional control initiatives.
Present findings and recommendations to management and drive continuous improvement efforts.
Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders across global operations.
Travel regularly to Keter manufacturing sites, including facilities located in Northern Israel.
Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, Industrial Engineering, or a related field.
5+ years of experience in Internal Audit, Internal Controls, Risk Management, Process Improvement, Operational Excellence, or Business Consulting.
Experience reviewing and improving operational processes in manufacturing, supply chain, procurement, logistics, or related environments.
Strong knowledge of internal control frameworks (COSO, SOX).
Hands-on approach and ability to work closely with operational teams in the field.
Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
Fluency in Hebrew and English.
Willingness to travel regularly to manufacturing sites across Northern Israel.
Experience in a global manufacturing organization or operational audit / consulting environment.
Apply Now
All fields are required

Keter.description:
Job Description
Sales Operations Specialist
​About the Role
We are looking for a Sales Operations Specialist to bridge commercial insights, supply chain, and global market execution.
In this role, you will analyze business performance, streamline order fulfillment processes, and partner with cross-functional teams worldwide to support business growth.
​What You’ll Do
​Commercial Analytics: Track, analyze, and report on sales performance, identifying trends, operational gaps, and growth opportunities.
​Planning & Forecasting: Support demand forecasting, commercial planning, and budget control processes.
​Operational Execution: Coordinate end-to-end order fulfillment, aligning customer priorities with Supply Chain and Operations teams.
​Cross-Functional Interface: Act as a focal point between global Sales teams, Product Management, Customer Service, and Operations.
​Data-Driven Insights: Build structured reports, presentations, and dashboards to support business decision-making.
​What We’re Looking For
​1–3 years of experience in Sales Operations, Business Analysis, Commercial Operations, or Supply Chain / Planning.
​High analytical capabilities with strong attention to detail and business orientation.
​Advanced MS Excel (pivot tables, complex formulas, data manipulation) and PowerPoint skills.
​High level of agility with strong communication, multitasking, and problem-solving skills.
​Fluent English (written and verbal) – daily communication with global interfaces.
​Experience with ERP systems (e.g., SAP) or CRM/BI platforms – Advantage.
​Background in a global industrial, manufacturing, or consumer goods (FMCG) company – Advantage.
Apply Now
All fields are required
