Product Manager | Komodor
Home
Careers
product manager
Product Manager
Product • Tel Aviv-Yafo • Full Time
Apply now
Share:
Description
Who are we?
Komodor is building the AI SRE platform for cloud-native engineering teams. Our AI agent, Klaudia, autonomously investigates incidents and remediates failures across Kubernetes and the full cloud-native stack. We're not just helping engineers manage infrastructure and optimize costs; we're replacing the toil that slows them down with an AI that acts, learns, and improves over time. With $67M in funding and deep roots in Kubernetes operations, we're now leading the shift toward truly autonomous infrastructure.
Core mission
We're looking for a technical Product Manager to join Komodor's AI product team and own the roadmap for Klaudia - our autonomous AI SRE agent. You'll work directly with customers, solution architects and R&D leads to define how Klaudia senses, investigates, decides, acts, and validates across availability issues and reliability risks. It's a role for someone who can translate complex AI/infra tradeoffs into a sharp product strategy.
What you will do
Work on the product roadmap execution, aligned with Komodor's mission and customer needs
Collaborate with engineering and design teams to drive Komodor’s AI to success
Conduct thorough market research, close work with sales teams and customer calls to identify trends, customer pain points, and opportunities for AI integrations
Effectively communicate product vision, progress, and outcomes to internal stakeholders and customers
Define KPIs around AI capabilities and utilize data-driven insights to make decisions and product iterations
Requirements
3+ years of experience as a Product Manager in B2B SaaS, with a proven background as a Software Engineer / Developer prior to transitioning into product management.
Significant hands-on software development experience , ideally within cloud-native architectures, Kubernetes, microservices, or AI-driven solutions.
A data-driven mindset with the ability to approach challenges strategically and identify impactful solutions.
You know to operate independently, move quickly, and keep work organized.
Excellent verbal and written communication abilities, capable of translating complex technical concepts for various audiences, including non-technical stakeholders.
Proven ability to work effectively across diverse teams, managing multiple stakeholders and aligning priorities to drive product success.
Why Join Komodor?
Be part of a team that's at the forefront of Kubernetes and AI technology
Great culture and perks
Options & benefits
Growth opportunities!
Wellness and Employee experience events
Dog friendly (well, we love animals in total!)
Contribution to local communities by hosting, participating and encouraging our employees to be our ambassadors!
If you're passionate about AI and eager to drive innovation in the Kubernetes ecosystem, we'd love to hear from you!
We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.
Why People Love Working Here
We invest in our team's growth, wellbeing, and happiness with
comprehensive benefits and perks
Start-Up Spirit
Fast-moving, collaborative, and ownership-driven. Ideas matter, initiative is rewarded, and the energy is always high.
Learning & Development
Curiosity thrives here. We invest in courses, conferences, mentorship, and hands-on learning so you keep growing, always.
Founders Mindset
Everyone gets meaningful equity. Real ownership, real upside—yes, the life-changing kind.
Employee Experience
From off-sites and team days to global meetups and conferences—we make time to connect, learn, and have fun together.
Impact From Day One
No sidelines. You’re involved from day one, shaping decisions and building things that matter. Your voice is heard.
Our Secret Sauce
Hybrid in Israel, flexible globally. Office for collaboration, home for focus—trust, balance, and zero guilt.
The hiring team tips
What are we looking for in a candidate? We are looking for proactive people that have the ability to smoothly get into our fast paced rhythm, learn and adapt quickly, be communicative as we believe in collaboration and continuous learning. We are looking for experienced people that have the willingness to have an impact.
What should you expect in the interview process? Some of the interviews will focus more on your skills and knowledge, and some would be to assess your fit to our company’s culture. We believe that setting and matching expectations are important not just in the recruitment process – but also in general! We strongly believe that meeting your direct manager & colleagues is an important phase in our recruitment process that could give you more transparency and information about us. And if it is a match – it is a match!
How do you evaluate success in any role? At Komodor, we believe in data. We are a data-driven company with goals to achieve and make impact and value to our customers.
Are there any growth opportunities within the company? Yes! There are many opportunities at Komodor for everyone to evolve and move forward in their careers. In startups you tend to learn fast, have different touch points within your role and responsibilities and also you will collaborate with different people from different departments. This leads to 360 exposure in any of our work processes. Also, we are growing from year to year so as we grow – you will grow with us!
Still open questions?

Programs and initiatives to help you thrive
Flexible workplace policy
Kyndryl's Flexible Workplace Policy promotes a balanced work-life experience by allowing employees to choose their preferred work arrangements, such as remote work, mobile work, or customer site assignments.
While some jobs must be in office or customer locations, due to customer requirements, many can be remote. We believe that our global Flexible Workplace Policy helps Kyndryls achieve business results and work-life balance. The policy enables managers and Kyndryls to have open dialogue and agree upon what work location works best for each employee, the team and the customer.
Kyndryl Be Well
The Kyndryl Be Well program is a key part of Kyndryl's commitment to fostering a culture of wellness and inclusivity within the company. This initiative focuses on promoting the physical, mental, and emotional well-being of employees. It includes various programs and resources designed to support employees in maintaining a healthy work-life balance, managing stress, and accessing mental health services. The program also emphasizes the importance of creating a supportive and inclusive work environment where all employees feel valued and empowered to bring their best selves to work.
Kyndryl Inclusion Networks (KINs)
Kyndryl Inclusion Networks (KINs) are company-sponsored, employee-led resource groups open to all Kyndryls and dedicated to creating safe spaces where employees can find and provide support and advice. We want to create an environment that empowers Kyndryls to bring their whole selves to work and to support the activation of our culture, The Kyndryl Way. Participation is voluntary, and all Kyndryls may join KINs either as members of these communities or as allies.
At all levels, KINs play a vital role in contributing to an environment where employees feel valued and empowered to succeed. Local KIN chapters exist in over 30+ countries, and additional KINs have been formed based on unique local business and employee needs, such as the Veteran KIN in the U.S.
Environmental sustainability
Kyndryl is committed to environmental sustainability and aims for net zero greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions by 2040. By 2030, Kyndryl plans to reduce global scope 1, 2, and 3 emissions by 50%, and scope 1 and 2 emissions by 75%, while adopting 100% renewable energy. Our sustainability strategy aligns with the UN Sustainable Development Goals, focusing on climate change risk management, operational efficiency, and sustainable practices. The Kyndryl Sustainability Advisor helps customers measure and reduce energy usage and GHG emissions in hybrid IT environments us

Legit Security.description:
Description
About Legit Security
We are a well-funded cybersecurity startup backed by top-tier VCs, on a mission to solve some of the most challenging problems in software security — how to make AI-first organizations release applications securely, leveraging AI agents to create secure code from the start, and fix vulnerabilities automatically. In a world where attackers leverage AI to exploit software in minutes, this becomes a must-have capability for every organization.
We're looking for a Senior Product Manager who doesn't just manage- they lead, own, and win. Someone who thrives at the intersection of deep technical understanding and sharp strategic thinking, and who knows how to turn customer pain into product that matters.
What you'll own
Take full ownership of product domains, from strategy to feature definition to delivery, driving growth and ensuring impactful results.
Engage directly with customers to deeply understand their needs and pain points and translate to actionable tasks
Define product features, backlogs, and roadmaps, collaborating closely with UX, design, and R&D with the power to build some of it yourself.
Communicate effectively and create alignment across sales, marketing, customer success, support, and R&D.
Requirements
What you’ll bring
A high-performing leader who owns their domain and gets things done
3–4 years of experience as a software developer or engineering team lead — experience in both is a significant advantage.
2–3 years of proven product management experience, particularly with enterprise B2B products.
Strong software engineering or DevOps background.
“Builder” mindset – come to build the product with us. Leverage AI to bypass blockers and lead with example.
Fluent English with outstanding communication and presentation skills.
Core product skills we value
Leader / Founder mindset
Hungry to win- energetic and pushing with ambition to make things happen
Strategic and first principal thinking
Presentation skills

Legit Security.description:
Description
About Legit Security
Legit Security is a well-funded cybersecurity company backed by top-tier VCs, on a mission to solve some of the most challenging problems in application security. We help AI-first organizations release software fast, without security slowing them down, by leveraging AI agents to secure code and remediate vulnerabilities automatically. We're leading a new era of AppSec, built for a world where AI writes the code.
﻿About the Role
We're looking for a driven, enterprise-focused Account Executive who knows how to create opportunities, not just close them. You'll own the full sales cycle from prospecting to close, targeting security and development leaders at enterprise accounts across the US. If you thrive in fast-moving environments and know how to navigate a technical buyer, we'd love to meet you.
﻿ You Are
A pipeline builder. You proactively create opportunities through outbound, your network, and market knowledge.
A solution seller. You understand customer challenges and know how to map our platform to real business outcomes.
A strong communicator at the C-level- CISOs, VPs of AppSec, and DevSecOps leaders are your primary targets.
Persistent and process-driven. You can find, navigate, and close complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles.
A team player. Comfortable collaborating across sales, marketing, and customer success in a fast-moving startup.
Proficient with tools like ZoomInfo, LinkedIn Navigator, Salesforce, SalesLoft, and Clari.
Requirements
10+ years of sales experience, predominantly in SaaS solution selling to enterprise and larger mid-market accounts.
Strong background in cybersecurity sales- AppSec or DevSecOps experience is a significant advantage.
A network of CISOs, Directors of Application Security, DevOps, or DevSecOps.
Proven track record of overachievement in previous roles.
﻿Work Model
Remote - West Coast - USA
Sound like you? Give us a ping 🤙
Legit Security.title: Head of Engineering

Legit Security.description:
Description
Head of Engineering
We are a well-funded cybersecurity startup backed by top-tier VCs. Our mission is to solve some of the most challenging problems in the security of software– how to make AI-first organizations release applications fast and not be bothered by security, leveraging AI agents to create secure code and fix vulnerabilities.
We are in a fast-growing, new space and looking to lead this new era of application security where AI write code.
The Role
We are looking for a Head of Engineering to lead and scale our engineering organization as we continue to grow.
This role is ideal for a hands-on engineering leader who grew through software development roles and has experience building teams in startup environments. You will be responsible for shaping the engineering culture, scaling the organization, and ensuring the successful delivery of our platform.
Responsibilities
Lead and grow the engineering organization, including team leads and individual contributors
Define and execute the engineering strategy aligned with company goals
Build scalable engineering processes and development practices
Work closely with product, security, and executive leadership on roadmap and strategy
Ensure high standards for system architecture, reliability, and security
Recruit, mentor, and develop top engineering talent
Drive a culture of ownership, innovation, and execution
Requirements
8+ years of software engineering experience, including a proven track record of leading engineering teams in startup and high-growth environments.
Experience managing multiple teams or team leads
Strong system architecture and cloud-native platform experience
Experience with microservices architectures and large-scale systems
Strong leadership, communication, and organizational skills
Nice to have
Experience in cybersecurity, DevSecOps, or developer tooling
Experience scaling engineering teams from early-stage to growth-stage companies
Familiarity with AI-driven platforms or data-intensive systems
Legit Security.title: Security Team Analyst Lead

Legit Security.description:
Description
Legit Security is looking for an experienced security leader to build and lead our Security Analyst team — the people who turn the latest threats, frameworks, and data into detections, fixes, content, and insights inside our product and for the industry
About Us
We are a well-funded cybersecurity startup backed by top-tier VCs. Our mission is to solve some of the most challenging problems in software security – how to make organizations build with AI fast, and stay secure, especially against the rising threats from supply chain attacks. Our solution provides full management from AI-generated code to deployment – helping customers analyze their software risk, fix it with agents and secure code during generation.
We are in a fast-growing new space and work hard to become the leader.
What you'll own
Own the business of security analysis in Legit – owning the quality and content of our risk detection, threat intelligence feed and security-matter-expertise.
Manage the team — set the bar for the work, coach analysts day-to-day, and own their development and performance.
Own the team's roadmap together with engineering, product and marketing: prioritize and bring initiatives to promote your business.
Be the focal point to lead Legit's response to global incidents in supply chain and application security — decide how the team reacts, what ships into the product, and what we publish externally.
Own the quality and voice of the team's security content — guides, remediation steps, in-product insights, blogs and social publications — and represent Legit as a thought leader in the space.
Partner with customers and field teams on high-stakes analyses of customer data and environments; present findings to security leaders and use those engagements to sharpen the team's focus.
Requirements
﻿What you’ll bring
﻿ Has experience leading a security research, detection or analyst team
Has deep hands-on background in cybersecurity or application security or supply chain security or a closely related domain.
Has some development experience (can be AI-based), and is comfortable with modern development workflows.
Knows how to balance speed and rigor — and how to make that trade-off legible to a team under incident pressure.
Writing and speaking skills in English enough to represent Legit publicly: customer executives, webcasts, blogs and social platforms.

Lema AI.description:
Description
We are
Lema AI is a fast-growing, venture-backed B2B SaaS company on a mission to ensure modern businesses never fail because of a third-party incident. We’re reimagining the stagnant Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM) and cyber resilience space by moving companies from reactive compliance to proactive, real-time risk prevention powered by advanced AI.
Already trusted by industry-leading enterprises, Lema is entering a phase of hypergrowth. We’re tripling our team as we build a category-defining platform, guided by a culture of radical ownership, transparency, and fast, cross-functional execution. If you thrive in high-context, high-impact environments, you’ll feel at home here.
More about Lema:
Lema.ai website
Business Insider - Cybersecurity startup Lema has come out of stealth to raise $24 million
Team8 - Why We Invested In Lema
About the TPRM market:
McKinsey - nearly one-third of recent cyber breaches originated from third parties
Hitch Partners - Third-party risk dominates security priorities, with AI-enhanced attacks and cloud misconfigurations completing the top three concerns.
About The Role
We’re looking for a a senior backend engineer with 6+ years of experience, playing a key role in building impactful, user-centric products from the ground up. As part of the company’s early engineering team, you’ll help shape both the product and the engineering culture, own backend architecture, lead end-to-end feature development, and drive technical excellence while collaborating closely with product, design, and infrastructure in a fast-growing environment.
What You’ll Do
Be one of our first 10 engineers, shaping both our product and our engineering culture.
Define and evolve the backend architecture, infrastructure and development best practices for a fast-growing team.
Own features end-to-end - from concept and design discussions to implementation, deployment and observability.
Solve complex challenges in distributed systems, event-driven architectures and real-time data pipelines.
Continuously improve developer workflows - identify friction, integrate new tools, automate repetitive tasks and champion engineering excellence.
Lead and mentor a small team of engineers: drive planning, break down work, ensure quality delivery and help hire exceptional talent.
Collaborate with experienced peers - engineers, PMs and designers - who’ve built large-scale systems at top-tier companies.
Here are some of the technologies we work with: Golang, Python, Protobuf, React, Typescript, Kafka, Postgresql, Redis, Kubernetes, Terraform and AWS
Requirements
What You Bring
A seasoned backend engineer (6+ years) who thrives on building impactful, user-centric products from the ground up.
Experienced in designing and scaling modern microservices architectures (both BE and FE integration).
Capable of taking complex features from design to deployment, owning every stage of the backend lifecycle - while guiding others to do the same.
Pragmatic about code quality: confident refactoring, simplifying and deleting code when needed.
Comfortable leading code reviews, defining engineering standards and collaborating across product, design and infrastructure.
Why Join Lema AI
Impact: Build a category-defining platform that safeguards how modern businesses operate.
Ownership: Join a culture that gives you full context, autonomy, and trust to drive outcomes.
Compensation & Benefits: Competitive salary, equity package, and additional perks
Velocity: Work with exceptional peers in a high-energy, low-bureaucracy environment.
Growth: Shape a company that’s scaling rapidly, backed by Tier 1 investors and visionary customers.
Lema AI.title: Senior Backend Engineer

Lightbits Labs.description:
In this role, you will work at the intersection of CUDA, GPU architecture, transformer inference, Rust systems programming, and large-scale AI serving platforms. You will design and build systems that intelligently manage KV cache placement across GPU, CPU, storage, and remote memory tiers while maximizing throughput, minimizing latency, and reducing infrastructure costs. This is a highly hands-on position for someone who enjoys solving deep performance challenges, optimizing every layer of the inference stack, and turning low-level innovations into customer-facing product value. Position based in Israel.
Responsibilities
Design and implement KV cache offloading, streaming, and memory management infrastructure for large-scale LLM serving.
Build cache-aware scheduling systems that determine when to keep, evict, prefetch, stream, compress, decompress, or recompute KV cache blocks.
Optimize inference runtimes such as vLLM and SGLang, including paged attention, prefix caching, schedulers, and cache management systems.
Develop mechanisms that overlap IO operations with attention execution to maximize GPU utilization and minimize latency.
Build high-performance components in Rust, C++, and CUDA for scheduling, cache coordination, telemetry, and inference optimization.
Profile and eliminate bottlenecks across GPU, CPU, memory, networking, storage, and runtime layers.
Design benchmark frameworks and performance tests for long-context, streaming, multi-turn, and high-concurrency workloads.
Measure and improve key inference metrics including TTFT, TBT/ITL, GPU utilization, cache hit rates, and cost per token.
Collaborate closely with Product, Platform, ML, and Engineering teams to deliver production-ready optimization capabilities.
Desired Skills and Experience
Strong hands-on experience with CUDA programming and GPU performance optimization.
Deep understanding of transformer inference, attention mechanisms, KV cache architecture, batching, streaming generation, prefill, and decode.
Experience with vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, Triton Inference Server, or similar LLM serving frameworks.
Experience designing or optimizing KV cache systems, including cache reuse, eviction, prefix caching, radix caching, or cache offloading.
Strong systems programming skills in Rust, C++, or both.
Strong Python skills for experimentation, benchmarking, and performance analysis.
Experience building performance-sensitive schedulers, async IO systems, or distributed infrastructure.
Strong debugging and profiling skills using tools such as Nsight, CUDA profiling tools, or custom telemetry systems.
Experience with GPUDirect, RDMA, NVMe, cache compression, FlashAttention, paged attention, or distributed inference architectures is a strong advantage.
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.

Lightbits Labs.description:
In this role, you will help deploy and support our cutting-edge storage technologies, directly impacting the day-to-day experience of our enterprise customers.
You will be responsible for resolving complex technical challenges, mitigating risks, training technical personnel, and acting as the Voice of the Customer within Lightbits. If you thrive on collaboration, love solving intricate technical problems, and are passionate about driving customer success, we want to talk to you.
Location: USA (Remote – Central or Mountain Time Zones preferred)
Responsibilities
Customer Technical Support: Lead post-sales and customer success activities, partnering directly with customers to diagnose and resolve complex technical issues.
Engineering Collaboration: Analyze diverse customer use cases and partner closely with internal engineering groups to develop unique solutions, ensuring an exceptional, customer-obsessed experience.
Product Improvement: Leverage field insights and technical expertise to continuously improve Lightbits’ product supportability, quality, and internal processes.
Infrastructure Guidance: Provide expert guidance to customers on capacity planning, performance monitoring, and integration with automation frameworks (e.g., Ansible).
Lifecycle Management: Plan, validate, and oversee Lightbits software upgrades, OS updates, and security patches.
Deployment & Baseline: Install and configure Lightbits clusters, validate networking and storage settings, and document clear operational baselines.
Knowledge Sharing: Develop, update, and deliver targeted training sessions for customer technical teams, while actively contributing to internal team knowledge.
Feature Development & Enhancements: Collaborate directly with core engineering teams to design, write, and implement small product features, enhancements, and bug fixes driven by customer feedback and field requirements.
Desired Skills and Experience
Experience: At least 3 years of relevant experience in a customer-facing technical support, systems engineering, or post-sales role.
Customer Centricity: Proven track record of working with external enterprise customers, featuring a positive attitude, high availability, and strong engagement.
Problem-Solving: Exceptional debugging and troubleshooting skills with the ability to solve complex problems independently in a fast-paced environment.
Storage & Hardware: Hands-on experience working with enterprise storage systems and troubleshooting server hardware issues.
Linux & Scripting: Strong proficiency in Linux operating system administration and Shell scripting.
Networking: Deep understanding of networking technologies and protocols (e.g., Ethernet, TCP).
Support Operations: Solid understanding of enterprise support workflows, including ticket handling, proactive monitoring, and support metrics.
Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly.
Team work: A collaborative team-player mindset, paired with a strong ability to self-manage and work independently.
Travel: Readiness and willingness to travel as needed.
Preferred (Plus) Skills :
Proficiency with Python or other scripting languages.
Familiarity with system security tools and performance benchmarking/monitoring tools.
Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent commensurate experience).

LinearB is a Leader in the inaugural Gartner Magic Quadrant for Developer Productivity Insights Platform. Our platform correlates data across your SDLC stack to identify bottlenecks and automate developer workflows. Our developer-first approach to automating engineering improvement uses data as the foundation for enabling autonomous, self-improving dev teams. Engineering organizations use LinearB to improve their AI Leverage, Predictability, Efficiency, and Developer Experience by way of our Explore-Measure-Act methodology.
LinearB is looking for an experienced, hands-on Bookkeeper to join our Finance team.
In this role, you will take ownership of the company’s day-to-day accounting operations, month-end closing activities, and Israeli payroll processes. You will work closely with our global Finance team, employees, vendors, banks, auditors, and external advisors to ensure accurate and timely financial reporting.
The ideal candidate is independent, detail-oriented, proactive, and comfortable operating in a fast-paced global technology company.
Responsibilities:
Independently manage the company’s day-to-day bookkeeping and maintain accurate books through trial balance.
Take ownership of key month-end closing and consolidation activities, including bank, credit card, AR, AP, payroll, and fixed-asset reconciliations, as well as cut-off procedures, accruals, prepaid expenses, amortization, and allocations, through the preparation of the full balance sheet and P&L.
Manage intercompany transactions and reconciliations between global entities.
Manage accounts receivable activities, including invoicing, collections, customer reconciliations, and aging reports.
Prepare supporting documentation for annual audits and tax filings.
Prepare and submit reports to the Israeli National Insurance Institute, tax authorities, VAT authorities, and other relevant regulatory bodies.
Support the development and implementation of new finance-related processes and system improvements to enhance the department’s workflows.
Manage payroll accounting and reconciliations for Israeli employees.
Collaborate with the Finance team on budgeting and forecasting activities.
Requirements:
5+ years of experience in a similar position in a global high-tech company- a must
Certified Bookkeeper type 3 or above
Experience with tax compliance (including estimated payments, VAT, Nikuim, Odfot, etc.).
Payroll Accountant certification- an advantage.
Hands-on experience with Priority ERP and Shiklulit - a must
Experience working with NetSuite - an advantage.
Advanced written and verbal communication skills in English
Advanced skills in Microsoft Office and Excel
Team player with great interpersonal skills
Strong attention to detail, accuracy and accountability
Excellent organizational skills with the ability to think proactively and prioritize work

Linearb.description:
Responsibilities:
Deep technical resolution
Own the hardest tickets end to end: reproducing bugs, reading logs and production data, debugging integrations with GitHub, GitLab, Jira and CI systems, and finding workarounds when there isn't yet a fix.
Act as the subject matter expert across the LinearB UI and backend, with independent access to our database and logging tools.
Escalate genuine defects to engineering with a clean reproduction and a clear ask, and stay accountable for the customer outcome through to resolution.
Automation and deflection
Own how we reduce ticket volume and effort, and decide what that should look like. We would rather hire someone with their own view than someone executing ours.
Automate triage, severity classification and routing so that whoever picks up a ticket starts from a sorted queue.
Work with our Product documentation owners to close the gap between what customers ask and what our docs answer. You will bring the evidence of what is missing and help prioritise it; they own the content.
Treat every repeat ticket as a defect in the system, whether the fix is an article, a macro, an automation, or a product change.
The queue itself
Work the queue. Until automation and coverage carry more of the load, first-line tickets are part of this job, and we would rather say so plainly than surprise you. Reducing that share over time is one of the things we will measure you on.
Set the standard for how we respond: clear, fast, and technically correct, on every tier of ticket.
Partnership with Customer Success
Work closely with our CSM leads on the grey area between a technical problem and a customer relationship. Some tickets are purely technical. Others are a signal that an account needs a different kind of attention, and the reverse is true too: some relationship conversations turn out to be a bug.
Judge, case by case and with the CSM, who should own a given customer conversation and when to bring the other person in. Getting this right matters more than drawing a clean line between the two functions, and there is no policy that will decide it for you.
Help CSMs and CSAs get better at the technical questions they can reasonably handle, and be honest with them about the ones they should hand over.
Coverage model and how the function grows
Design how support coverage actually works: which hours are staffed, by whom, and what happens outside them. You will propose the model, not inherit one.
Coordinate a rotation of technical contributors from our CSM and CSA teams who support the queue outside core hours. You will own the schedule and the handoffs.
Make the case for what the function needs next, whether that is another engineer, an outsourced first-line partner, or more automation. As we add capacity, you lead it.
Build per-account SLA instrumentation in Zendesk so that our response and resolution commitments are visible and measurable in real time, for every account that has them.
Own the operational side of our contractual support obligations, including the reporting some customers are entitled to.
Requirements:
5+ years in a technical support, solutions or site reliability role where you were the person others escalated to.
Proven ability to triage, troubleshoot and resolve complex issues at root cause, independently, without a queue of colleagues to lean on.
Mastery of SQL, logging and observability tools (Datadog, LogRocket or similar), REST APIs, and SSO and SCIM configuration.
Practical experience with Zendesk and Jira, and a point of view on how they should be configured rather than just how to use them.
Demonstrated experience reducing support load through automation or process. AI agents, deflection tooling, knowledge strategy, macro and trigger design, workflow automation, or something we have not thought of. Tell us what you built and what it changed.
Nice to have: comfort reading and debugging code. Python, Node.js, TypeScript and React are what you would encounter here. Formal people management experience is also nice to have.
A track record of working with Product and Engineering as a peer, bringing evidence rather than anecdote, and influencing what gets fixed.
Excellent written communication. Much of this job is explaining difficult technical situations clearly to senior people at large companies, in writing, under time pressure.
Working knowledge of the software development lifecycle and git. Preferred.

משרות
משרות
חיפוש משרה
Cybersecurity Architect
מספר משרה: 20939
גוש דן
Ready to Power Up Your Career?
Cybersecurity Architect
מיקום: רמת גן | ארגון פיננסי מוביל
תיאור התפקיד:
ארכיטקט/ית אבטחת מידע וסייבר ( Cybersecurity Architect ) כפיפות ל- CISO.
תרגום דרישות המדיניות, האסטרטגיה והתקציב,לארכיטקטורה טכנולוגית, מודלים יישומיים ובחירת פתרונות בשטח.
1. תכנון ועיצוב ארכיטקטורת האבטחה ( Architecture & Design )
* תכנון מודלי אבטחה מתקדמים מקצה לקצה ( Zero Trust Architecture, Defense-in-Depth ).
* הגדרת ארכיטקטורת אבטחה לסביבות ענן ( Cloud Security: AWS, Azure, GCP ), סביבות היברידיות ותשתיות On-Premise .
* הגדרת סגמנטציה ברשת, אבטחת אפליקציות ( AppSec ), אבטחת API , וניהול זהויות והרשאות ( IAM/PAM ).
* יצירת Standard Guidelines (תקני אבטחה, Best Practices ודפוסי תכנון שבלוניים) עבור צוותי הפיתוח וה IT .
2. ליווי פרויקטים וסיוע לצוותי פיתוח ותשתיות ( Enablement )
* ביצוע סקירות ארכיטקטורת אבטחה ( Security Architecture Reviews ) למערכות חדשות לפני עריכת שינויים או עלייה לפרודקשן.
* שילוב מודלים של Threat Modeling בתהליכי פיתוח ( DevSecOps ) ובחינת סיכוני אבטחה בשלבים מוקדמים ( Shift Left ).
* עבודה מול ארכיטקטי תוכנה ( Software Architects ) וארכיטקטי תשתיות ( Infrastructure Architects ) כדי לוודא שדרישות האבטחה אינן מעכבות את הביזנס.
3. הערכת טכנולוגיות חדשות ( POC & Vendor Evaluation )
* הובלה ובחינה טכנית של מוצרי אבטחה חדשים ( Proof of Concept ) והתאמתם ל- Tech Stack הקיים בארגון.
* צמצום כפילויות של כלי אבטחה ( Tool Consolidation ) והגדלת ההחזר על ההשקעה ( ROI ) ממוצרים קיימים.
4. ניהול סיכונים טכנולוגיים ואינטגרציה לציון הרגולטורי
* ביצוע ניתוחי פערים ( Gap Analysis ) מול תקנים בינלאומיים (כגון NIST, CIS Controls, ISO 27001, SOC2, PCI-DSS ).
* מיפוי איומים טכנולוגיים ומתן פתרונות לצמצום משטח ההתקפה ( Attack Surface Reduction ).
דרישות התפקיד:
* ניסיון מקצועי: 5+ שנות ניסיון מעשי בתפקידי אבטחת מידע (כגון Cyber Security Engineer, DevSecOps, Cloud Security ) או כארכיטקט תשתיות/ענן.
* הבנה עמוקה ברשתות, פרוטוקולי תקשורת, Firewalls, WAF, Microsegmentation .
* ניסיון בארכיטקטורת ענן ( AWS, Azure, GCP ) וכלי אבטחה נייטיביים/חיצוניים.
* ידע במתודולוגיות פיתוח מאובטח (Secure SDLC), CI/CD pipelines ו- DevSecOps .
* ניסיון עם מודלי זהויות (Identity): SAML, OAuth, OIDC, Active Directory, Okta/Entra ID .
"When the match is right – everything Powers Up"

Logica-IT.description:
About the Role
We are looking for an experienced Data Owner to lead enterprise-wide Data initiatives from the business perspective.
This is a strategic leadership role for someone who combines deep business understanding with strong expertise in modern Data platforms and Enterprise Data Architecture. You will serve as the bridge between business stakeholders and technology teams, translating complex business needs into scalable Data and Analytics solutions while driving enterprise-wide Data strategy.
The role owns the business vision of Enterprise Data solutions, while partnering closely with IT, BI, Data Engineering, Architecture and external vendors to deliver high-impact initiatives.
What You'll Do
Lead enterprise-wide Data and BI initiatives from strategy through delivery.
Own Enterprise Data Products that support business processes and executive decision-making.
Translate business requirements into Data & Analytics solutions.
Partner with senior leadership, business stakeholders and IT teams to define priorities and drive execution.
Lead cross-functional BI, Data and external vendor teams.
Design and drive Enterprise Data solutions leveraging SAP Datasphere , Data Lake and modern Data platforms.
Lead data integration across SAP and enterprise systems.
Drive Data harmonization across business units and systems.
Define Data Models, Business Rules, Semantic Layers and Enterprise Data Architecture.
Lead Data Governance, Data Quality, Data Lineage and Single Source of Truth initiatives.
Drive enterprise-wide Data Transformation and organizational change.
Define Data roadmaps, priorities and strategic initiatives.
Challenge technical solutions and ensure alignment with business objectives.
Identify opportunities for automation, process optimization and improved business insights.
Requirements
Significant experience working in SAP S/4HANA environments.
Experience with SAP Datasphere or strong knowledge of SAP's modern Data Architecture.
Experience working with Enterprise Data Lake environments.
Proven experience leading complex Enterprise Data, BI or Analytics projects.
Deep understanding of Data Architecture , Data Modeling and Data Integration .
Experience defining Business Rules and enterprise data models.
Strong understanding of end-to-end business processes within large organizations.
Experience working directly with senior leadership and business stakeholders.
Experience leading cross-functional teams, vendors and strategic initiatives.
Strong business orientation with the ability to influence decision-making across the organization.
Nice to Have
SAP Datasphere
SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC)
SAP HANA
Data Lake Architecture
Master Data Management (MDM)
Data Governance
Enterprise Data Modeling
Experience leading global Data Transformation programs
Experience in large Enterprise environments with multiple business systems
What We're Looking For
Strategic thinker with strong business acumen.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to challenge existing approaches and drive innovation.
Strong ownership and end-to-end accountability.
Proven leadership in complex, cross-functional environments.
Ability to connect business strategy with Data-driven solutions.
Why Join?
Lead enterprise-scale Data initiatives with significant business impact.
Own the organization's Enterprise Data vision and strategy.
Work with modern Data technologies including SAP Datasphere , SAP HANA , Data Lakes and Enterprise Analytics platforms.
Influence executive decision-making and shape the future of Data across the organization.

השפלה
לארגון פיננסי בראשון לציון דרוש/ה איש/אשת צוות CCOE – Cloud Center of Excellence.
מודל עבודה: יום 1 בשבוע מהבית, 4 ימים מהמשרד.
תחומי אחריות מרכזיים של צוות ה-CCOE:
• בניית סטנדרטים: פיתוח ותחזוקה של ארכיטקטורת ענן (Landing Zones), נהלים ומדיניות (Policies) לשימוש נכון בענן (GCP&Azure)
• הובלת טכנולוגית : ליווי צוותי הפיתוח וה-DevOps בבחירת שירותים נכונים ופתרון בעיות ארכיטקטוניות מורכבות.
• Infrastructure as Code (IaC) : כתיבה וניהול של תשתיות בקוד ברמה גבוהה ומודולרית לשימוש כלל הארגון.
• FinOps : ניטור ובקרה על עלויות הענן, זיהוי בזבוזים והמלצה על פעולות לייעול (Right-sizing, RI/Savings Plans ) .
• Security & Compliance : עבודה צמודה עם צוותי אבטחה להטמעת בקרות אוטומטיות ושיפור ה-Security Posture .

• לפחות 3-4 שנות ניסיון בהקמה וניהול של תשתיות ענן, ניהול סביבות ענן גדולות ב- GCP/AZURE – חובה
• ניסיון מעמיק עם Terraform (כתיבת מודולים, ניהול State) או כלים כמו Pulumi / CloudFormation / Bicep – חובה
• ניסיון בכתיבת סקריפטים ב-Python, Go או Bash לאוטומציה של תהליכים
• ניסיון בסביבות מבוססות Kubernetes (EKS/AKS/GKE) וDocker
• הבנה עמוקה של תהליכי CI/CD (ג'נקינס, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI וכד')
• הבנה חזקה ברשתות ענן (VPC, Subnets, Routing, VPN, Transit Gateway)

Model data within the Loops platform based on business context and customer KPIs to deliver growth insights. This includes building and defining tools to automate and enhance the integration process, such as scripts for automated data discovery, data pipelines, and validation. As part of the pre-sales department, you'll lead PoCs with top global companies.

Our company’s Animal Health Technology Solutions offers global animal identification and monitoring solutions for companion animals and livestock. Description
We’re looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to join our R&D team and play a key role in building the company’s core technology from the ground up.
In this role, you’ll take end-to-end ownership of our backend systems - from architecture and technical design, through hands-on development, to production and scale. You’ll lead the creation of reliable, scalable foundations that bring Mami’s product vision to life.
At Mami, engineering goes far beyond writing code. You’ll work closely with every function in the company to design and build systems that solve meaningful business problems and directly impact the product and users.
What You'll Do
Build and lead complex, scalable backend systems that power our core web platform
Design and implement solid architectures with a strong focus on performance, reliability, and maintainability
Champion a "Full-cycle" engineering culture, owning everything from design to production-grade deployment
Collaborate closely with engineering and product teams to ensure efficient, well-integrated systems across platforms
Continuously raise the bar on code quality, best practices, and engineering standards
Requirements
Proven track record in at least 2 technology companies, building and maintaining large-scale backend systems in production
Strong system design and architecture skills, with the ability to think several steps ahead
You have a strong sense of ownership and are comfortable being responsible for high-impact systems
Fast and independent learner who enjoys working with new technologies
Creative, out-of-the-box thinker, who likes to challenge engineering thoughtfully, and improve existing solutions
Nice to Have
Strong background in AWS and cloud-native architectures.
Hands-on experience with Kubernetes.
Experience working with MongoDB or other NoSQL databases.
Familiarity with Go (Golang) or strong interest in adopting it.
About Mami
Mami is a fast-growing B2C commerce startup built on community, trust, and authentic connection. What started as Maayan Adam’s creator-led store has become a leading consumer brand with over 400,000 active users. Now, Mami is evolving into a tech-driven platform empowering creators and communities to build their own personalized shopping experiences, redefining how people connect, create, and shop online.
Mami.title: Senior Backend Engineer

Description
We're looking for an enthusiastic Bookkeeper to join our Finance team and work closely with our Head Bookkeeper.
You will take ownership of the company's day-to-day bookkeeping operations, managing core accounting processes from end to end, including accounts payable, accounts receivable, reconciliations, and supporting the monthly closing process.
This is a hands-on role with broad responsibility, ideal for someone who enjoys working in a fast-paced environment, is highly organized, and excels at managing financial processes that support business growth.
📍Ramat HaHayal, Tel Aviv
🏠 Full-time position with an on-site work model
What you’ll do
Manage the full accounts payable process, including invoice processing, verification, and supplier payments
Manage accounts receivable, including invoicing, collections, and follow-up on outstanding balances
Perform bank, credit card, and supplier reconciliations, and record journal entries
Support the monthly, quarterly, and year-end closing processes
Assist the Head Bookkeeper with financial reporting and ongoing accounting activities
Work closely with employees, suppliers, and external stakeholders to ensure smooth financial operations
Requirements
Bookkeeping Level 3 certification
Hands-on experience with “Hashavshevet” - advantage
Strong Excel skills
Experience with Priority or SAP - advantage
High level of accuracy and attention to detail
Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities
Excellent interpersonal and teamwork skills
About Mami
Mami is a fast-growing B2C commerce startup built on community, trust, and authentic connection. What started as Maayan Adam’s creator-led store has become a leading consumer brand with over 400,000 active users. Now, Mami is evolving into a tech-driven platform empowering creators and communities to build their own personalized shopping experiences, redefining how people connect, create, and shop online.
תיאור המשרה
﻿ (תיאור המשרה מנוסח בלשון נקבה, אך מיועד לכל המגדרים)
אנחנו מחפשים מנהלת חשבונות להצטרף למחלקת הכספים שלנו ולהיות שותפה מרכזית בניהול הפעילות הפיננסית של החברה.
בתפקיד הזה תעבדי בצמוד למנהלת חשבונות ראשית ותהי אחראית על הנהלת חשבונות שוטפת מקצה לקצה, תוך הקפדה על דיוק, סדר ותהליכי עבודה איכותיים.
זהו תפקיד עם אחריות רחבה, המתאים למי שנהנית לעבוד בסביבה דינמית, בעלת יכולות ארגון גבוהות, ויודעת להיות חלק מתהליכים פיננסיים התומכים בצמיחת החברה.
איך ייראה היום שלך אצלנו
ניהול תהליך הספקים מקצה לקצה, כולל קליטת חשבוניות, בדיקה וביצוע תשלומים
ניהול תהליך הלקוחות, כולל הפקת חשבוניות, מעקב אחר גבייה וטיפול ביתרות פתוחות
ביצוע התאמות בנקים, כרטיסי אשראי וספקים, ורישום פקודות יומן
תמיכה בתהליכי הסגירה החודשיים, הרבעוניים והשנתיים
עבודה צמודה עם מנהלת הכספים לצורך הכנת דוחות ופעילות חשבונאית שוטפת
עבודה שוטפת מול עובדים, ספקים וממשקים חיצוניים, להבטחת תהליכים פיננסיים יעילים ומדויקים
מה אנחנו אוהבים לראות
תעודת הנהלת חשבונות סוג 3 - חובה
ניסיון מעשי בעבודה עם ״חשבשבת״ - יתרון
שליטה גבוהה באקסל
ניסיון בעבודה עם פריוריטי או סאפ - יתרון
סדר, דיוק ויכולת ירידה לפרטים
יכולת עבודה עצמאית וניהול מספר משימות במקביל
יחסי אנוש מצוינים ויכולת עבודה בצוות
הסיפור שלנו
אנחנו סטארט-אפ בצמיחה מהירה, המבוסס על קהילה, אמון וחיבור אותנטי. מה שהתחיל כמועדון צרכנות קטן בהובלת מעיין אדם, הפך למותג צרכני מוביל עם למעלה מ-400,000 משתמשים פעילים. כיום החברה מתרחבת לפלטפורמה טכנולוגית שמעצימה יוצרים וקהילות לבנות חוויות קנייה אישיות משלהם, ומגדירה מחדש את הדרך שבה אנשים מתחברים, יוצרים וקונים אונליין.

Mami.description:
Description
We’re looking for a strategic and hands-on Chief Marketing Officer (CMO) to lead Mami into its next chapter of growth. This role will own the company’s marketing strategy end-to-end, build a powerful consumer brand, scale growth channels, and drive meaningful demand across every touchpoint with our users and community.
This is a unique opportunity to join a fast-growing market leader and shape Mami’s marketing vision from strategy to execution. You’ll develop bold, creative, and data-driven initiatives while driving performance across brand, content, design, performance marketing, and community.
Your main focus will be building a strong and iconic B2C brand in Israel, accelerating growth, scaling our community into a powerful engine, and positioning Mami as the leading B2C brand in the Israeli market.
What You’ll Do
Lead and Manage Mami’s Marketing team and strategy across brand, performance, content, CRM, Influencers, PR, and community.
Own and scale the full growth funnel- user acquisition, retention, activation, engagement, and monetization
Lead and develop internal marketing teams as well as external agencies, freelancers, and vendors.
Plan and manage marketing budgets, with hands-on ownership of measurement, optimization, and ROI-driven decision-making.
Conceptualize and execute creative campaigns and breakthrough brand initiatives.
Work closely with Product, Commerce, and Community teams to create a holistic and consistent user experience.
Analyze market trends, consumer behavior, and competitive landscape to continuously refine strategy.
Lead product launches, seasonal campaigns, and strategic collaborations.
Requirements
Proven experience as a VP of Marketing/CMO or a senior Head of Marketing in a leading B2C company.
Strong track record in brand building, growth leadership, and managing large marketing budgets.
Deep hands-on experience in performance marketing (Meta, Google, TikTok), combined with a strong understanding of Brand & Content.
Experience with community-driven brands, influencers, UGC, and creator ecosystems - a significant advantage.
Sharp strategic thinking combined with strong execution and hands-on leadership.
Ability to lead teams, manage multiple stakeholders, and thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
Highly creative, proactive, organized, and capable of driving complex cross-functional processes.
Excellent interpersonal skills, collaborative mindset, and genuine passion for building meaningful brands and communities.
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Marketing, Business Administration, or a related field - a strong advantage.
On-site availability with flexibility for meetings, launches, and field activities as needed.
About Mami
Mami is a fast-growing B2C commerce startup built on community, trust, and authentic connection. What started as Maayan Adam’s creator-led store has become a leading consumer brand with over 400,000 active users. Now, Mami is evolving into a tech-driven platform empowering creators and communities to build their own personalized shopping experiences, redefining how people connect, create, and shop online.
תיאור המשרה
אנחנו מחפשים סמנכ״ל/ית שיווק, להוביל את החברה לשלב הצמיחה הבא שלה. התפקיד כולל ניהול צוות השיווק, ואחריות מלאה על אסטרטגיית השיווק מקצה לקצה, בניית מותג צרכני חזק ועוצמתי, הרחבת ערוצי הצמיחה והנעת ביקוש משמעותי בכל נקודות המגע עם המשתמשות והקהילה שלנו.
זוהי הזדמנות ייחודית להצטרף לחברה מובילה בצמיחה מהירה, ולעצב את חזון השיווק שלנו, מהאסטרטגיה ועד לביצוע בפועל. במסגרת התפקיד תוביל/י מהלכים יצירתיים פורצי דרך ומבוססות דאטה, ותניע/י ביצועים בתחומי המותג, התוכן, העיצוב, והשיווק הביצועי (פרפורמנס).
הפוקוס המרכזי של התפקיד הוא בניית מותג חזק ואייקוני, הגדלת מעורבות הקהילה שלנו למנוע צמיחה משמעותי, ומיצוב החברה כמותג צרכני מוביל בשוק הישראלי.
איך ייראה היום שלך אצלנו
הובלה וניהול של צוות השיווק ואסטרטגיית השיווק בתחומי המותג, תוכן, משפיענים, יח״צ וקהילה, ושיווק ביצועי.
אחריות מלאה על משפך הצמיחה - רכישת משתמשים, שימור, אקטיבציה, מעורבות ומוניטיזציה.
הובלה ופיתוח של צוותי שיווק פנימיים לצד ניהול סוכנויות, פרילנסרים וספקים חיצוניים.
תכנון וניהול תקציבי שיווק, כולל אחריות להוצאה לפועל אופטימיזציה וקבלת החלטות מבוססות מדידה.
פיתוח והוצאה לפועל של קמפיינים קריאטיביים ומהלכי מיתוג פורצי דרך.
עבודה צמודה עם צוותי מוצר, מסחר וקהילה ליצירת חוויית משתמש הוליסטית, עקבית ואחידה.
ניתוח מגמות שוק, התנהגות צרכנים והסביבה התחרותית לצורך חידוד מתמיד של האסטרטגיה.
הובלת השקות מוצרים, קמפיינים עונתיים ושיתופי פעולה אסטרטגיים.
מה אנחנו אוהבים לראות
ניסיון מוכח כסמנכ״ל/ית שיווק, או במשרה דומה בכיר/ה בחברת צרכנות פרטית מובילה.
רקורד חזק בבניית מותגים, הובלת צמיחה וניהול תקציבי שיווק גדולים.
ניסיון בשיווק ביצועי (Meta, Google, TikTok), לצד הבנה חזקה במיתוג ותוכן.
ניסיון בעבודה עם מותגים מבוססי קהילה, משפיענים, יוזר ג׳נרטור קריאטור, ואקו סיסטם של יוצרים - יתרון משמעותי.
חשיבה אסטרטגית חדה בשילוב יכולות ביצוע גבוהות והובלה מעשית.
יכולת להוביל צוותים, לנהל ממשקים מרובים ולשגשג בסביבה דינמית ובצמיחה מהירה.
יצירתיות גבוהה, פרואקטיביות, סדר ויכולת להניע תהליכים מורכבים חוצי ארגון.
כישורים בינאישיים מצוינים, גישה שיתופית ותשוקה אמיתית לבניית מותגים וקהילות משמעותיים.
תואר ראשון או שני בשיווק, מנהל עסקים או תחום רלוונטי - יתרון משמעותי.
זמינות לעבודה מהמשרד, עם גמישות לפגישות, השקות ופעילות שטח לפי הצורך.
הסיפור שלנו
אנחנו סטארט-אפ בצמיחה מהירה, המבוסס על קהילה, אמון וחיבור אותנטי. מה שהתחיל כמועדון צרכנות קטן בהובלת מעיין אדם, הפך למותג צרכני מוביל עם למעלה מ־400,000 משתמשים פעילים. כיום החברה מתרחבת לפלטפורמה טכנולוגית שמעצימה יוצרים וקהילות לבנות חוויות קנייה אישיות משלהם, ומגדירה מחדש את הדרך שבה אנשים מתחברים, יוצרים וקונים אונליין.

Mami.description:
Description
We're looking for a Lifecycle & Marketing Automation Lead to join Mami's growth team and lead the design and execution of end-to-end customer journeys.
You'll bring our customer experience vision to life - creating personalized, multi-channel flows that drive engagement, retention, and revenue, while setting the standard for marketing excellence at Mami.
Your main focus will be Email, SMS, and WhatsApp flows, with opportunities to collaborate with Product, Content, and Data teams as Mami continues to scale.
This is a rare opportunity to shape both the customer experience and marketing culture of an early-stage, community-driven startup.
What You’ll Do
Take full ownership of the Marketing Automation platform - optimize templates, manage audiences, integrate data, and monitor deliverability.
Build and manage multi-channel customer journeys across Email, SMS, and WhatsApp with personalization, triggers, and A/B testing.
Map end-to-end journeys from sign-up to retention and win-back, including segmentation and dynamic content.
Analyze results using GA4, attribution, cohort analysis, and LTV metrics to inform strategy.
Lead briefs for copy and design, craft action-driven microcopy, and adapt content to target audiences.
Collaborate effectively across teams to ensure smooth delivery and execution.
Requirements
Proven experience in Marketing Automation in B2C/eCommerce or Consumer Apps.
Strong multi-channel experience (Email, SMS, WhatsApp), deliverability, and compliance with opt-in/opt-out regulations.
Hands-on experience with ActiveTrail (mandatory) - building complex flows, advanced segmentation, and templates.
Proficiency in GA4, UTM/attribution, A/B testing, and roadmap management.
Data-driven & analytical, comfortable reading reports, analyzing data, and using insights to optimize flows and campaigns.
Experienced in generating creative ideas and content that drive engagement and results.
Highly communicative, proactive, self-driven, and comfortable collaborating across teams in a fast-moving startup environment.
About Mami
Mami is a fast-growing B2C commerce startup built on community, trust, and authentic connection. What started as Maayan Adam’s creator-led store has become a leading consumer brand with over 400,000 active users. Now, Mami is evolving into a tech-driven platform empowering creators and communities to build their own personalized shopping experiences, redefining how people connect, create, and shop online.

Description
We’re looking for a sharp, hands-on Marketing Manager who knows how to take a brief and turn it into a well-executed marketing campaign.
You’ll see the full picture, from choosing the right channels and defining the assets needed to building timelines and making sure everything goes live on time and to brief.
You’ll coordinate multiple stakeholders, remove roadblocks, and own campaigns from the initial brief through launch.

Write briefs for Content, Design, and CRM teams
Track progress and ensure deadlines are met
Review deliverables, refine them, and ensure they answer the brief
Integrate relevant AI tools into the marketing workflow

Proven experience in account management, marketing, or a similar role, either in-house or at an advertising, social media, digital, or content agency
Experience managing and executing multi-channel campaigns
Ability to translate a brief into a clear, detailed, and actionable work plan
Experience writing marketing briefs and coordinating multiple teams across multiple campaigns simultaneously
Strong marketing judgment and the ability to identify, evaluate, and refine creative and marketing deliverables
Strong project management, organizational, and attention-to-detail skills

Hands-on experience using and integrating AI tools

תרגום בריפים לתוכניות שיווק 360° ברורות ומעשיות
ניהול ותיאום של כלל הממשקים המעורבים בביצוע הקמפיינים
קבלת בריפים מצוות הסחר וחידוד המטרה השיווקית
ניהול מספר קמפיינים במקביל ותעדוף משימות בהתאם לצורך
תכנון פריסת הקמפיינים בערוצים השונים
הגדרת הנכסים הנדרשים לכל ערוץ
בניית לוחות זמנים, תהליכי עבודה ותוכנית עלייה לאוויר

This is an opportunity to shape how the brand shows up across social media, bringing together content, creativity, and business goals. תצטרפו לחברה בצמיחה מהירה, תעבדו מול מותגים ושותפים מובילים בשוק הישראלי, ותהיו חלק משמעותי ביצירת מהלכים שמייצרים גם תוצאות עסקיות וגם ערך אמיתי לקהילה שלנו.

זיהוי ובנייה של שיתופי פעולה מסחריים ואסטרטגיים עם מותגים ושותפים מובילים
זיהוי הזדמנויות מסחריות והפיכתן למהלכים יצירתיים שמייצרים ערך עסקי
הובלת שיתופי פעולה מקצה לקצה - מהרעיון והקונספט ועד להוצאה לפועל
ניהול קשרים עם שותפים, ניהול משא ומתן ובניית שותפויות ארוכות טווח
פיתוח תוכניות מסחריות ושיווקיות, כולל תמחור, רווחיות ומיצוב
עבודה צמודה עם צוותי השיווק, המכירות, המוצר וצוותים נוספים כדי להפוך רעיונות לביצוע
ניהול מספר פרויקטים במקביל, תוך שמירה על סדר, לוחות זמנים ותשומת לב לפרטים
זיהוי מגמות והזדמנויות חדשות בשוק, והבאת חשיבה יצירתית ופרקטית לצמיחת העסק והקהילה
מה אנחנו אוהבים לראות
ניסיון בעולמות הסחר, פיתוח עסקי, שיתופי פעולה, שיווק, ניהול לקוחות או בתפקיד דומה
חשיבה שיווקית ומסחרית חזקה, עם יכולת לזהות הזדמנויות ולהפוך רעיונות למהלכים בפועל ביצירתיות וחשיבה עסקית
יכולות בין אישיות תקשורת מצוינים, עם יכולת לבנות קשרים, לרתום אנשים ולעבוד עם מגוון ממשקים
כישורים מצוינים בניהול פרויקטים במקביל, סדר וארגון וירידה לפרטים
יתרון משמעותי לבעלי ניסיון במשרד פרסום או קריאייטיב, חברת מוצר או מותג מוביל, או במחלקת שיווק, סחר, פיתוח עסקי או שיתופי פעולה
זמינות לעבודה מהמשרד וגמישות לפגישות עם שותפים לפי הצורך
תואר ראשון או שני במנהל עסקים, שיווק או בתחום רלוונטי - יתרון
הסיפור שלנו
אנחנו סטארט-אפ בצמיחה מהירה, המבוסס על קהילה, אמון וחיבור אותנטי. מה שהתחיל כמועדון צרכנות קטן בהובלת מעיין אדם, הפך למותג צרכני מוביל עם למעלה מ-400,000 משתמשים פעילים. כיום החברה מתרחבת לפלטפורמה טכנולוגית שמעצימה יוצרים וקהילות לבנות חוויות קנייה אישיות משלהם, ומגדירה מחדש את הדרך שבה אנשים מתחברים, יוצרים וקונים אונליין.

Mastercard.description:
Job Title:
Manager, Market Delivery
Overview:
Job Overview:
Customer Delivery Europe is in the center of the Mastercard Europe organization and the key contact between the Divisions, Operations and Technology, Global Products & Solutions and the other business units. We are close to the markets and to our customers.
Market Delivery Managers lead end-to-end project and program management for complex customer onboarding journeys, ensuring seamless integration from business impact to technical execution. They act as strategic consultants and technology relationship managers, guiding customers through operational changes, resolving technical issues, and coordinating with Mastercard subject matter experts. Their role also includes supporting TAM services, driving cross-functional collaboration, and enhancing delivery performance across local markets and key accounts.
Role
Responsible for strategic project/program management as the primary interface between regional customers and internal stakeholders, utilizing local market expertise to facilitate implementations throughout the pre-launch onboarding and post-launch support phases.
• Developing subject matter expert in the Market Delivery area, influencing stakeholders and applying advanced knowledge to drive achievement of area goals and initiatives by contributing to solution development and improvements for existing products, services, and/or processes.
• Executes complex delivery tasks including customer readiness assessments, coordination of training sessions, testing activities, and post-launch support to ensure seamless implementation.
• Supports integration of new products and solutions into the global implementation framework by collaborating with sales, product, and customer success teams to customize delivery plans.
• Identifies potential risks and issues throughout the delivery lifecycle, proactively escalating and collaborating on mitigation strategies to minimize impact.
• Ensures seamless integration and deployment of products and solutions within the global framework while accommodating local market nuances.
• Maintains detailed and accurate documentation of delivery activities, outcomes, and lessons learned to support knowledge retention and process improvement.
• Contributes to continuous improvement initiatives by recommending enhancements to delivery processes, tools, and documentation.
• Provides technical and project management expertise during pre-launch and post-launch phases to ensure successful delivery and customer satisfaction.
• Serves as a key point of contact between regional customers and internal stakeholders to ensure clear communication and issue resolution.
• Participates in cross-functional meetings to align delivery efforts with evolving business and customer needs.
• Guides and mentors junior team members through on-the-job experiences, reviewing work and fostering a culture of continuous improvement to grow expertise around their discipline.
All About You
• Understand the payment ecosystem and Mastercard products/services.
• Project management skills.
• Native in Hebrew, Fluent in English
• Profound user of Excel and PowerPoint.
• Analytical thinking and being a person who is usually addressed by others for getting technical advice
• Communicate effectively with stakeholders; listen attentively and ask clarifying questions.
• Ready for continuous learning and improvement
Work Conditions: Occasional trips
To find US Salary Ranges, visit People Place. Under the Compensation tab, select "Salary Structures." Within the text of "Salary Structures," click on the link "salary structures 2025," through which you will be able to access the salary ranges for each Mastercard job family. For more information regarding US benefits, visit People Place and review the Benefits tab and the Time Off & Leave tab.

Mastercard.description:
Our Purpose
Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.
Title and Summary
Manager, Software Engineering
Team Lead – Data Infrastructure
Position Overview
We are seeking an experienced and highly motivated Team Lead to lead our Data Infrastructure team. This role is responsible for managing a team of engineers while driving the design, scalability, reliability, and operational excellence of the company’s core data platform.
The ideal candidate combines strong technical expertise in distributed systems and data technologies with proven leadership capabilities, strategic thinking, and the ability to lead complex initiatives end-to-end — from initial design and planning through implementation, deployment, and production ownership.
Key Responsibilities
• Lead, mentor, and develop a team of Data Infrastructure engineers, fostering a culture of ownership, collaboration, and continuous improvement
• Define and execute the technical roadmap for the organization’s data infrastructure platform
• Oversee the architecture, scalability, reliability, and performance of large-scale data systems and pipelines
* Define and drive data quality standards, monitoring, and validation processes to ensure trust and reliability across the data platform
Partner with engineering and product teams to enable scalable data foundations for analytics, machine learning, and AI-driven initiatives•
• Lead cross-functional technical initiatives end-to-end, including requirements gathering, architecture design, implementation, deployment, and post-production ownership
• Partner closely with cross-functional teams including Data Engineering, Analytics, Backend Engineering, DevOps, and Product Management
• Drive operational excellence through monitoring, observability, automation, and incident management best practices
• Ensure high availability and stability of critical production systems
• Lead technical design discussions, architecture reviews, and engineering planning processes
• Establish and promote engineering standards, development best practices, and quality assurance processes
• Manage project prioritization, resource allocation, and timely delivery of strategic initiatives
• Support recruitment, onboarding, performance management, and career development of team members
• Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend improvements to the data platform ecosystem
Required Qualifications
• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field
• 7+ years of experience in software engineering, data engineering, or infrastructure engineering
• 2+ years of experience managing or leading engineering teams
• Strong experience with distributed systems and large-scale data platforms
• Hands-on experience with modern data technologies and frameworks such as Kafka, Spark, Flink, Airflow, DBT, Snowflake, Cassandra/ScyllaDB, or similar technologies
• Strong programming skills in Java, Scala, or Python
• Experience working in cloud-based environments such as AWS, GCP, or Azure
• Strong understanding of system reliability, performance optimization, and operational best practices
• Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and collaboration skills
• Proven ability to lead complex technical projects in a fast-paced environment
Preferred Qualifications
• Experience with real-time streaming and event-driven architectures
• Experience managing high-scale production environments
• Familiarity with Kubernetes and containerized infrastructure
• Experience leading platform modernization or migration initiatives
• Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure automation tools
Corporate Security Responsibility
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

Mastercard.description:
Our Purpose
Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.
Title and Summary
Senior Software Engineer
## Overview
Dynamic Yield by Mastercard is seeking a **Senior Software Engineer** with a strong foundation in backend engineering and experience building scalable, high-performance systems.
This role focuses on designing and developing backend services that power our **AI-driven products**, with extensive work on **Large Language Models (LLMs), AI agents, and modern GenAI technologies**.
We foster a professional environment where experienced engineers collaborate to drive technical excellence and continuously improve our architecture and products. As a Senior Software Engineer, you will play a key role in building production-grade AI systems, solving complex engineering challenges around scalability, performance, reliability, and AI orchestration.
## Role & Responsibilities
* Design, develop, and optimize scalable backend services and APIs that power AI-driven products.
* Build production-grade applications and workflows using **LLMs, AI agents, and GenAI technologies**.
* Design and implement agentic workflows, including **tool calling, orchestration, context management, and integration with internal services**.
* Integrate and optimize LLM-based capabilities while balancing **quality, latency, reliability, and cost**.
* Design and maintain scalable, reliable, and high-performance distributed systems.
* Take ownership of technical solutions from design and implementation through deployment and production monitoring.
* Improve system architecture, observability, code quality, and development processes.
* Collaborate with Product, DevOps, and other engineering teams to deliver end-to-end solutions.
* Stay up to date with advancements in backend technologies and the rapidly evolving GenAI ecosystem.
## Qualifications & Experience
* 5+ years of experience in software engineering, with a strong focus on backend development.
* Strong proficiency in **Python and/or Node.js**.
* Strong understanding of backend architecture, APIs, microservices, and distributed systems.
* Experience building scalable and reliable production systems.
* Hands-on experience with cloud platforms, preferably **AWS**.
* Experience with containerization and orchestration technologies such as **Docker and Kubernetes**.
* Experience working with databases and data stores such as **PostgreSQL, Redis, DynamoDB, or similar technologies**.
* Strong system design and problem-solving skills.
* Experience with **LLMs, Generative AI, AI agents, LangChain, LangGraph, or similar technologies** is a strong advantage.
* Experience with **Amazon Bedrock, OpenAI APIs, Langfuse, LLM evaluation, or agentic architectures** is a plus.
Corporate Security Responsibility
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

In this role, you will proactively identify best‑in‑class assets, lead rigorous scientific and clinical evaluations, and drive cross‑functional diligence to enable high‑quality, strategic partnering decisions. You will operate at the intersection of science, strategy, and execution, working in close partnership with Medical, Regulatory, and senior leadership to support disciplined growth and long‑term value creation.
Responsibilities
Proactively screen, source, and prioritize best‑in‑class late‑stage assets from Phase 2 through marketed products across rare and severe diseases, leveraging multiple platforms, databases, and industry sources.
Build and manage a robust and high‑quality pipeline of partnership opportunities aligned with Medison’s long‑term growth strategy.
Lead rigorous scientific and clinical evaluations by assessing clinical data versus current standard of care, mechanism of action differentiation, regulatory pathways, and competitive landscape.
Develop clear and data‑driven Target Product Profiles (TPPs) to support scientific, clinical, and strategic positioning.
Conduct comprehensive research, including literature review and data synthesis, to deeply understand disease biology, unmet need, and therapeutic value.
Engage directly with Key Opinion Leaders, clinical investigators, and external experts to validate assumptions and strengthen scientific and clinical assessments.
Drive cross‑functional diligence by partnering closely with function leads, Medical and Regulatory, Commercial, Legal, Finance, and other relevant stakeholders.
Support transaction strategy and execution by providing scientific and clinical input into transaction strategies, diligence materials, and contractual discussions.
Prepare clear, concise, and decision‑ready materials, including evaluation summaries, one‑pagers, presentations, and business cases for senior leadership and governance forums.
Continuously refine and strengthen Search and Evaluation processes, criteria, and scientific convergence frameworks to improve rigor, consistency, and speed of decision‑making.
Act as a trusted thought partner to leadership by surfacing insights, risks, and recommendations that directly influence portfolio strategy and Medison’s growth trajectory.
Represent Medison externally in partnering discussions, scientific meetings, and industry conferences to strengthen Medison’s visibility and network.
Requirements
An advanced degree in Life Sciences (PhD or MD) is required; an MBA or additional business training is a strong advantage.
At least eight years of relevant experience in Search and Evaluation, Business Development, Licensing, Corporate Development, venture capital, or related partnering roles within pharma or biotech.
Proven experience evaluating late‑stage assets from Phase 2 through marketed products, preferably in rare and severe diseases.
Strong understanding of drug development, clinical data interpretation, regulatory pathways, and competitive dynamics.
Demonstrated experience developing Target Product Profiles and comparing clinical data to existing standards of care.
Proven ability to lead cross‑functional diligence teams and work closely with Business Development deal leads throughout the transaction lifecycle.
Strong scientific credibility with the ability to engage confidently with Key Opinion Leaders, investigators, and senior internal stakeholders.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to create clear, concise, executive‑level decision materials.
Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple complex evaluations in parallel in a fast‑paced environment.
An ownership‑driven, hands‑on leadership style with strong strategic thinking, sound judgment, and business acumen.

Responsibilities:
As our IT Manager, you will lead all internal IT operations and infrastructure, including:
Managing and maintaining our Microsoft and Google Workspace environments
Overseeing network infrastructure, connectivity, and security
Providing hands-on IT support to employees
Implementing and maintaining security best practices
Managing hardware, software, SaaS tools, permissions, and onboarding/offboarding
Working closely with security and engineering teams
Owning IT policies, inventory, and documentation
Required Experience and Skills:
3–5+ years of experience in IT management or senior IT roles
Strong experience with Microsoft 365, Azure AD, Intune, and Windows environments
Strong experience with Google Workspace administration
Solid understanding of networking: VPN, firewalls, routing, switching, Wi-Fi
Experience managing SaaS tools, SSO, identity, and access management
Excellent troubleshooting and problem-solving abilities
Ability to work independently, take ownership, and support a fast-moving startup
Strong communication skills and a service-oriented mindset
Nice to Have:
Experience in cybersecurity or tech startups
Familiarity with macOS management
Knowledge of security frameworks (ISO, SOC2, etc.)
Why Join Us?
If you’re passionate about IT, security, and technology and want to make a real impact, we’d love to hear from you.
Be part of a fast-growing cybersecurity company protecting global brands
Work with cutting-edge technologies
Opportunity to own and shape IT infrastructure from the ground up
Great people, great culture, and meaningful work
Location: Tel Aviv District, Israel
If you think you could be our new team member, please send your resume to
jobs@memcyco.com

Development velocity is currently blocked by manual QA—especially in high-risk financial areas (refunds, credits, settlements). We’re hiring a fully-remote Freelance QA Automation Engineer to design and own test automation, wire it into CI, and unblock safe, confident releases. Prioritize and automate money-critical flows first: refunds/credits, payment provider integrations, ledgers, orders/reservations, webhooks, retries/idempotency. Integrate suites into CI/CD: PR gates, deploy-time smoke tests, nightly runs; provide clear, actionable reports. Build reliable test data/fixtures (sandbox accounts, test cards, seeded datasets, reset tools). Translate existing manual flows into maintainable automated cases; write concise test plans/checklists. Track and reduce flakes; define release criteria; triage failures to drive down MTTR. Collaborate with engineering/product; coach teammates to contribute tests and follow QA best practices. Mindspace.description:
About the position
This full-time position is based in Amsterdam and requires traveling to various Mindspace sites in Amsterdam and Utrecht and reporting to the Regional Sales Manager.
Your Sales Responsibilities:
You will be responsible for expanding and deepening our relationships with existing clients, as well as successfully converting new leads.
Owning all aspects of the pre-sales and sales of our spaces, as well as customer success, retention, and upsell, you’ll play a key role in our sales efforts through the qualification of leads and deal-closing.
Qualify SMB leads - convert them to tours and closed deals (inbound & outbound)
Provide a suitable proposal offer, based on Mindspace guidelines
Follow up with the customer, maintaining a consistent, open channel
Your Customer Experience Responsibilities:
Building and maintaining a strong community via networking and events
Engaging, growing and nurturing the Mindspace community; keeping things fresh and interesting
Creating an inclusive environment that fosters collaboration and creativity — both internally and externally
Maintaining ongoing communication with operation and maintenance teams to ensure that all processes run smoothly
Being the point of contact for your members and solving all member-related issues
Requirements
Demonstrated customer service and sales experience
Excellent team player
Experience working with various companies and stakeholders
Strong oral and written communication skills both in Dutch and English
Multitasking is a must! You must be able to balance multiple projects at the same time
Available to work 5 days on-site(s)
A ‘can do’ approach!
Critical competencies for success:
