Noga Iso.description:
תיאור התפקיד:
הובלה מקצועית - הכנת תסקירי השפעה על הסביבה/מסמכים סביבתיים מסוגים שונים/מסמכי בחינת חלופות, עבור פרוייקטי חשמל מרכזיים - קווי חשמל ראשיים, תחנות מיתוג ומשנה.
ניהול ההיבט הסביבתי של פרוייקטי חשמל מרכזיים, כולל פעילות מול יועצים בתחומי ידע מגוונים (אקולוגים, אדריכלי נוף, אגרונומים ועוד), ליווי והצגה של הממצאים הסביבתיים בפני מוסדות התכנון והסביבה, עד לאישורה של תכנית המתאר.
דרישות התפקיד:
תואר ראשון ממוסד אקדמי מוכר בתחומים: הנדסה סביבתית/מדעי הסביבה, ו/או אדריכלות נוף ו/או תואר רלוונטי אחר. תואר שני - יתרון
ניסיון של שלוש שנים, לפחות, בהכנת תסקירים ו/או מסמכים סביבתיים, לרבות ניהול פרויקטים בהיבט הסביבתי וניסיון בשילוב ההיבט הסביבתי בתקנוני תכניות מתאר.
הכרות עם פרוייקטי תשתית - יתרון.
שליטה גבוהה ביישומי Office, ידע וניסיון בתוכנות ניתוח גיאוגרפיות GIS - יתרון.
כושר הבעה בעברית בכתב ובעל פה ברמה גבוהה מאוד.
דרישות נוספות:
הבנת מידע הנדסי ויכולת ביצוע אינטגרציה בין מידע תכנוני - הנדסי לממצאי סקרים סביבתיים.
הכרה וניסיון בפעילות מול מוסדות ורשויות התכנון והסביבה, רשויות מקומיות וגופים ציבוריים, החל משלב של ייזום פרויקט ועד לאישורו הסביבתי והסטטוטורי.
תקשורת בינאישית, יכולת הצגה טובה של פרויקט בפני קהל/ מוסד תכנון וכד'.
ייזום תהליכי עבודה והובלת פרויקט, יכולת טובה לעבודה עצמאית, תוך ניהול זמן ותיעדוף משימות בסביבה דינמית, מורכבת ומרובת משימות.
יכולת עבודה בצוות, אמינות, ויושרה מקצועית.

Noga Iso.description:
תיאור התפקיד:
עיסוק בתחום הפעלת הרצות בכלי הסימולטור ובאפליקציות הנדסיות תומכות:
• הפעלת כלי הסימולטור לתרגול המפקחים.
• מעקב ובחינה מתמדת של תקינות ומוכנות הסימולטור לתרגול שוטף בכל עת, כולל בדיקת תקינותו בסיוע אנשי מחלקות אחרות.
• הזנת תסריטים תפעוליים בכלי, כולל בדיקת התכנסות "פתרון" תוך כדי הרצתו.
• אחריות לעדכון בסיסי הנתונים עם נתוני זמן אמת ושינויים טופולוגיים.
• למידת אפליקציות הנדסיות שונות שנמצאות בשימוש שוטף של המפקחים במשמרת.
• בחינת אפליקציות מיוחדות שיבנו לפני הכנסתן לשימוש פעיל במשמרת.
• משימות נוספות בהתאם לצורך ודרישת מנהל המחלקה.
דרישות התפקיד:
• תואר ראשון בהנדסת חשמל בתחום מערכות הספק.
• הכרת מערכת החשמל הארצית, כולל נקודות תורפה - יתרון.
• הכרה של יחידות הייצור השונות ואת סוגי הטכנולוגיות - יתרון.
• הכרת מערכות הייצור, הולכה והשנאה - יתרון.
• יכולת גבוהה של עבודה בצוות.
• שליטה גבוהה ביישומי אופיס.
• שליטה מלאה בעברית ובאנגלית (קריאה, כתיבה, דיבור).
• נכונות לעבודה מעבר לשעות העבודה המקובלות, במידת הצורך.

ריכוז ואינטגרציה של תכנית הפיתוח בתחום ההולכה וההשנאה; קידום הכנת תוכנית פיתוח מערכת ההולכה וההשנאה לרבות הגדרה ועדכון של פרויקטי הקמה, תוספות השנאה, קווים ושדרוגים (שו"ש) הנדרשים במערכת המסירה ;

We’re hiring an AI Engineer to design and build the intelligence layer behind our autonomous offensive security platform.
You’ll develop AI agents capable of performing vulnerability discovery and exploitation at the level of top human white-hat hackers – combining deep security expertise with advanced AI reasoning and decision-making.
This role, reporting directly to our Agent TL, offers the opportunity to define how AI transforms offensive cybersecurity.
You’ll collaborate closely with AI researchers, software engineers, and security experts to translate penetration-testing workflows into intelligent, automated capabilities – systems that plan, execute, and adapt in real time.

Collaborate with AI researchers to fine-tune and evaluate models that enhance reasoning, adaptability, and precision.

Ship production-ready AI systems that improve the speed, depth, and scalability of security testing.

3+ years of hands-on experience in machine learning, AI engineering, or cybersecurity development.

Builder mindset - thrives in fast-paced, early-stage startup environments with full ownership.

Proven ability to deliver production-grade AI systems (CI/CD, monitoring, rollback, scalability).

Experience building AI agents or orchestration frameworks
Background combining AI models with offensive security tools.
Contributions to open-source projects in cybersecurity, exploit development, or agentic AI systems.
Advanced degree (M.Sc/Ph.D.) in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or related technical field.
What We Offer
The chance to shape the core intelligence of a next-generation cybersecurity platform.
A collaborative, world-class team of AI engineers, researchers, and security veterans.
Freedom to innovate and experiment with the latest in AI-driven autonomy.
End-to-end ownership and direct impact on the company’s technology and vision.
Competitive compensation, growth opportunities, and the excitement of joining an AI-first cybersecurity startup at its foundation.

About the role
We are looking for a Strategic Sourcing Manager, Direct Materials, to join our Global Direct Sourcing organization and play a pivotal role in shaping the supplier ecosystem behind Novocure’s innovative medical technologies.
In this highly visible global individual contributor role, you will have end-to-end ownership of sourcing activities supporting both Direct Material categories and the Israel site, without direct people management responsibilities.
In this role, you will lead strategic sourcing initiatives across critical direct material and manufacturing categories that support our Tumor Treating Fields (TTFields) products, including electronic manufacturing services, components, wearables, accessories, sterilization services, and engineering support.
As a key business partner, you will work at the intersection of Supply Chain, Product Development, Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, Regulatory, Finance, and Legal, helping connect business needs with external supplier capabilities, technologies, and innovation opportunities. Your ability to build strong stakeholder relationships, influence decision-making, and drive sourcing excellence will directly impact business performance, supply continuity, innovation, and long-term value creation.
Success in this role means developing and executing sourcing strategies that support business growth, strengthening supplier partnerships, mitigating risk, and ensuring that sourcing decisions align with both local operational needs and global strategic objectives.
What you will do
Lead strategic sourcing initiatives across direct material and manufacturing-related categories, including electronic manufacturing services, components, contract sterilization services, engineering services, testing, calibration, and accessories
Develop and implement category strategies aligned with Novocure’s corporate objectives and Supply Chain KPIs, identifying opportunities for cost optimization, risk reduction, supplier diversification, and service enhancement
Lead supplier qualification, selection, negotiation, and contracting activities to ensure best total value for the organization
Coordinate end-to-end Source-to-Contract (S2C) activities for the Israel site, including sourcing intake, stakeholder alignment, RFx processes, supplier evaluation, negotiations, contract coordination, approval workflows, and implementation follow-up
Partner with business stakeholders and budget owners to understand demand, define sourcing requirements, validate assumptions, and align sourcing activities with business priorities
Collaborate closely with Finance, Legal, Quality, Regulatory, Engineering, Supply Chain, and Procurement Operations to ensure sourcing activities are compliant, well-documented, and aligned with company policies
Act as the key coordination point between Israel-based stakeholders and global category managers, ensuring local requirements are represented within global sourcing strategies
Facilitate cross-functional alignment, issue resolution, and effective decision-making throughout the sourcing lifecycle
Support Product Development, Early Innovation, and Engineering teams by identifying supplier capabilities, technologies, and partnership opportunities that enhance innovation and create competitive advantage
Monitor supplier markets, industry trends, supply-demand dynamics, and competitive developments to inform sourcing strategies and business decisions
Communicate sourcing strategies, spend analytics, and market intelligence to stakeholders across the organization
Develop and implement supplier relationship management (SRM) and vendor governance programs
Support supplier risk management initiatives and drive implementation of mitigation strategies
Lead supplier ESG-related initiatives in alignment with corporate sustainability objectives
What you will bring
Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field
7+ years of strategic sourcing experience within a regulated industry, including direct materials and services
Experience partnering with business leadership and cross-functional stakeholders, including Product Development and Engineering organizations
Deep understanding of strategic sourcing methodologies, tools, and best practices, including structured sourcing processes
Proven experience developing and executing sourcing strategies and delivering measurable business value
Strong negotiation and contract management capabilities
Knowledge of electronic manufacturing services and supplier ecosystems within MedTech, Life Sciences, or related industries
Experience leading cross-functional and virtual teams in local and global environments
Strong analytical capabilities and proficiency with SAP and advanced digital tools
Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills
Strong business acumen with the ability to balance commercial objectives, risk management, and policy compliance
Knowledge of manufacturing processes, lean methodologies, and quality and regulatory requirements within regulated environments
Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver results in a dynamic, fast-paced environment
Fluency in English and Hebrew, both written and spoken
Willingness to travel domestically and internationally as needed
Who you are
A strategic thinker who can translate business objectives into sourcing solutions
A relationship builder who influences effectively across functions, cultures, and organizational levels
A proactive self-starter who takes ownership and drives initiatives forward with minimal oversight
A collaborative partner who thrives in cross-functional environments and values teamwork
An analytical problem-solver who balances long-term strategy with operational execution
A results-oriented professional who continuously seeks opportunities to improve performance, reduce risk, and create value

About the role:
We are looking for a Senior Electrical Engineer to join our Sustaining Engineering team and play a key role in supporting the ongoing evolution of Novocure's innovative cancer treatment systems.
In this role, you will lead electrical engineering activities across design transfer and sustaining engineering, ensuring our products successfully transition from development into manufacturing while maintaining the highest standards of quality, reliability, manufacturability, and regulatory compliance.
Working closely with R&D, Manufacturing, Quality, and external suppliers, you will combine hands-on engineering with technical leadership to drive robust product solutions throughout the product lifecycle.
This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced engineer who enjoys solving complex technical challenges, mentoring others, and collaborating across multidisciplinary teams to bring life-changing medical technologies to patients worldwide.
What you will do:
Lead electrical engineering activities for Design Transfer and Sustaining Engineering projects .
Provide technical leadership and mentorship to electrical engineers within the DT & Sustaining Engineering team .
Serve as the company's subject matter expert for electrical design, supporting Design Transfer and Production activities .
Lead the transfer of electrical designs from R&D into manufacturing, ensuring manufacturability, quality, and reliability .
Partner with R&D teams to provide Design for Manufacturing (DFM) recommendations early in the development process .
Maintain and improve PCB and electrical board designs to support product robustness, manufacturability, and cost-effectiveness .
Define electrical project requirements, timelines, and budgets .
Generate and maintain complete production documentation, including PCB documentation, PCBA files, BOMs, assembly drawings, and work instructions .
Work closely with suppliers and manufacturing subcontractors throughout the product lifecycle .
Perform hands-on electrical design, testing, validation, and troubleshooting .
Develop and execute electrical test procedures and generate technical documentation and test reports .
Lead electrical design reviews and provide technical guidance to cross-functional teams .
What you will bring:
B.Sc. in Electrical Engineering (required)
M.Sc. in Electrical Engineering (advantage)
Minimum of 5 years of experience in electrical engineering within the medical device industry
Strong knowledge of medical device standards and electrical safety requirements
Minimum of 5 years of experience in digital circuit design, with basic knowledge of analog circuit design
Proven experience leading electrical projects from concept through manufacturing
Experience working with PCB design and layout tools, including Altium
Hands-on experience using laboratory test equipment, including oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, spectrum analyzers, and function generators
Strong technical, analytical, and problem-solving skills
Excellent communication skills in English, both written and verbal
Proficiency with Altium and Microsoft Office
Who you are:
A hands-on engineer who enjoys solving complex technical challenges .
A collaborative team player who thrives in cross-functional environments .
A technical leader who enjoys mentoring and supporting other engineers .
Organized and capable of balancing multiple projects and priorities .
Passionate about delivering high-quality engineering solutions that make a meaningful impact on patients' lives .

Description
Join Onyx Security and help build the control plane for autonomous AI in a fast-moving, high-impact environment. Onyx is building the control layer that enables enterprises to safely adopt and scale AI agents across the organization, with the visibility, governance, and operational control needed to understand what agents exist, what they do, how they behave, and what risks they introduce.
﻿About the role
Onyx is looking for an AI Researcher to help build the intelligence behind our AI security platform.
This is a hands-on research role focused on understanding how modern large language models and AI agents behave, identifying new attack vectors and protection techniques, and translating cutting-edge research into production-ready capabilities. The intelligence developed by this team is a core differentiator of our platform and a key driver of the company's success.
You will work at the intersection of machine learning, LLMs, and cybersecurity, partnering closely with AI engineers and product teams to develop technologies that directly power our product. We're looking for someone who enjoys understanding how neural networks and foundation models work, pushes the boundaries of AI research, and is excited to see their work deployed into production and used by customers.
What you will do
Research the behavior, capabilities, and limitations of modern large language models and AI agents.
Design novel techniques for detecting, evaluating, and proactively protecting against AI threats, prompt injection, model misuse, and emerging attack vectors.
Develop new approaches for securing AI systems and improving the intelligence that powers our platform.
Design and run experiments to evaluate model behavior, validate new ideas, and measure the effectiveness of protection techniques.
Build research prototypes and turn them into production-ready capabilities.
Work closely with Product and Engineering to translate research into scalable product features.
Stay current with advances in LLMs, foundation models, post-training techniques, AI security, and AI safety.
Contribute to the long-term technical direction of Onyx's AI security platform.
Requirements
﻿What you will bring
3+ years of experience in AI research, applied machine learning, or a related field.
Strong understanding of deep learning, neural networks, transformer architectures, and large language models.
Hands-on experience training, fine-tuning, evaluating, or post-training modern machine learning models.
Strong Python skills and experience with machine learning frameworks such as PyTorch.
Experience designing rigorous experiments and evaluating model performance.
Ability to translate research into production-ready systems.
Strong analytical thinking and excellent communication skills.
﻿Nice to Have
Experience with AI security, AI safety, adversarial machine learning, or robust machine learning.
Experience developing or evaluating autonomous AI agents, reasoning models, or agentic workflows.
Experience with supervised fine-tuning, model optimization, post-training techniques, or reinforcement learning.
Publications in leading AI conferences (NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, ACL, EMNLP, etc.) or impactful applied research in industry.
Experience deploying machine learning models into production and building scalable AI-powered products.

About the Role
Opmed.ai is a rapidly growing healthcare AI startup helping leading health systems optimize their operations. Our platform is already in use at major health systems and large networks such as Mayo Clinic and Geisinger, and we are backed by world-class funds including NFX and Grove.
We're looking for a Data Science Tech Lead to take technical and delivery ownership of this team, a hands-on senior IC role. You'll set research direction, own client-facing delivery end-to-end, and drive how the team builds and scales its use of GenAI tooling and agentic capabilities. You'll work closely with other data scientists & analysts and partner daily with Solutions, Implementation, and Engineering. This role comes with real latitude to shape research direction and influence our product offering and roadmap — not just execute against a backlog.
What you will do
1. Research Direction
Set the technical research agenda for our tabular prediction models.
Guide how we incorporate temporal signal - case history, lag features, schedule snapshots- without defaulting to time-series techniques that don't fit our data.
Own our strategy for extracting value from unstructured data sources via LLMs - feature extraction, embeddings, or fine-tuning - balancing accuracy, cost, and constraints like latency and privacy.
Set standards for experimentation, evaluation, and model guardrails.
2. Client Project Delivery
Own DS delivery end-to-end across concurrent client engagements - from discovery through modeling, validation, and go-live.
Partner with Solutions and Implementation on discovery and rollout; represent Data Science in client meetings, presenting results directly to stakeholders.
Ensure delivery lands inside the product, on timeline, coordinating with Engineering on productionization.
Track delivery risk across the client portfolio, flagging blockers and scope changes early.
3. GenAI Tooling & Team Capability
Build the team's onboarding and delivery playbook for new use-cases and encode it as reusable Claude skills/agents
Turn repeatable steps in the DS workflow into standardized, shared tooling.
Raise the team's GenAI fluency through mentoring on Claude Code and related tooling.
What We're Looking For
M.Sc. in Computer Science, Statistics, Engineering, or a related quantitative field - or equivalent practical experience (PhD is an advantage).
Experience building or adapting LLM-native ML research workflows - including monitoring research quality and running critical peer reviews of results.
6+ years in applied data science / ML, including recent experience as a senior IC technical lead.
Deep, practical expertise with tabular ML: gradient-boosted trees (XGBoost/LightGBM or similar), feature engineering, and rigorous model evaluation for regression and classification problems.
Comfortable working with temporal/panel data (lag features, entity history, point-in-time snapshots).
Proven ownership of client-facing technical engagements end-to-end - discovery, stakeholder presentations, and delivery against deadlines - ideally in a B2B / enterprise or professional-services-adjacent setting.
Hands-on experience building and shipping GenAI applications: LLM-based feature extraction or structured extraction from unstructured text, prompt engineering vs. fine-tuning trade-offs, and at least conceptual fluency with agent orchestration.
Track record of building tooling or frameworks (internal libraries, standardized pipelines, or similar) that scaled a team's output, not just personal productivity.
Strong communicator who can move fluidly between technical peers, engineering, and non-technical clinical or business stakeholders.
Comfortable holding multiple concurrent workstreams and client engagements with competing timelines.
It will be great if you have
Healthcare, clinical, or EHR data experience - HL7/FHIR familiarity, PHI-aware ML practices, or exposure to clinical NLP (e.g., ClinicalBERT-style models).
Experience fine-tuning or distilling LLMs (SFT, LoRA/QLoRA) for domain-specific extraction or embedding tasks.
Direct experience building Claude Code skills/agents or working within an agentic-tooling ecosystem (LangChain, LangGraph, or equivalent).
Background in causal inference or experimentation design - useful for rigorously measuring model and product impact, even if not core to the day-to-day.
Experience in a scale-up environment where Data Science sits close to client delivery rather than behind a platform/API boundary.
Why join us
At Opmed.ai you will see your work deployed in real hospitals and health systems, improving the daily lives of clinicians and patients. You will lead the heart of our technology, collaborate with a talented and mission driven team, and work with world class partners and health networks. If you want to build world class AI and optimization at scale and help shape the future of healthcare operations, we would love to talk.

Description
At Orca AI, we build AI-powered vision systems that enhance safety and decision-making for some of the world’s largest vessels.
Our platform processes live video streams from multiple onboard cameras to provide real-time situational awareness, detecting and tracking marine objects, even in low visibility and highly congested environments. These systems directly support navigational decisions and help prevent collisions, reduce human error, and improve operational efficiency.
Our systems are already deployed across thousands of vessels and have processed hundreds of millions of nautical miles of real-world data, operating in unpredictable and safety-critical conditions.
This role sits at the intersection of AI and high-performance systems engineering, focused on solving real-world problems under strict constraints. You will work on systems where performance and reliability are critical and where improvements have a direct, measurable impact on real-world safety.
This is a senior, systems-focused role with end-to-end ownership over performance and reliability of production computer vision pipelines. You will define optimization strategies, identify bottlenecks across the system, and drive improvements under real-world constraints.
What you’ll do
Build and optimize real-time computer vision pipelines running on edge systems processing live maritime video streams (e.g, NVIDIA Jetson, Triton Inference Server)
Take models from research and turn them into production-ready, reliable components deployed on vessels
Profile and improve end-to-end system performance across: multi-camera video ingestion; preprocessing; inference; postprocessing
Identify and resolve bottlenecks across CPU, GPU, memory, and pipeline coordination
Make and justify tradeoffs between latency, accuracy, stability, and resource utilization
Design and implement robust data and inference pipelines (video -> model -> actionable output for crew)
Develop benchmarking and evaluation workflows to measure performance end-to-end and support release gating
Build and improve observability tools, including logging, monitoring, and debugging workflows for production systems
Define and maintain clear interfaces between research code and production systems
Work closely with research and backend teams to integrate new models into production systems
Continuously improve system efficiency and reliability under hardware and runtime constraints
Requirements
5+ years of software engineering experience, with a strong focus on systems and performance
Hands-on experience working with computer vision or deep learning systems in production
Strong programming skills in Python and/or C++
Experience working with edge or embedded systems (e.g., NVIDIA Jetson platforms)
Strong understanding of system bottlenecks, including CPU, GPU, memory, and latency constraints
Strong intuition for profiling-driven optimization and performance tuning
Experience debugging complex systems and reasoning about behavior in real-world, noisy environments
Strong advantage
Experience working with edge or embedded systems
Experience working with custom high-performance data or inference pipelines
Familiarity with multi-sensor fusion (e.g., combining vision with radar or other signals)
Experience deploying and maintaining ML models in production environments
Experience with low-level optimization and/or C++ performance tuning
Proven experience optimizing model inference (e.g., TensorRT, ONNX Runtime, quantization, pruning, or similar techniques)
Additional context
The role is primarily system-focused with responsibility for optimizing inference, improving pipeline performance, and ensuring production reliability. Some interaction with models is expected (e.g., quantization, pruning, architecture-aware optimizations), while model development and training are primarily owned by the research team.
You will be working in environments where failures are often caused by real-world conditions rather than clean lab assumptions - such as low visibility, cluttered scenes, and dynamic environments - and where understanding system behavior in production is key to delivering robust solutions.

Description
At Orca AI, we're on a mission to shape the future of the shipping industry through cutting-edge autonomous ship technology. Our solutions empower teams both on the ship and ashore to make informed decisions that dramatically enhance safety, reduce fuel consumption, improve navigation, and minimize environmental impact.
We integrate state-of-the-art technologies like computer vision and augmented reality, ensuring that we create solutions that improve operational efficiency and promote safer, greener shipping practices. At Orca AI, we are committed to making a positive difference for both the environment and the people who rely on safe, efficient shipping practices. Join us as we work towards a safer, greener future for the maritime industry.
Your Impact
As the QA Team Lead, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring the quality and reliability of our groundbreaking maritime technology. You'll lead a talented QA team, define testing strategies, and implement automation frameworks to uphold the highest standards across our products. Working closely with software and product teams, you will take ownership of the testing lifecycle, drive quality initiatives, and ensure seamless delivery in a fast-paced, innovative environment.
What You'll Do
Lead QA Strategy & Execution: Design and implement comprehensive testing procedures, quality metrics, and test strategies to maintain product excellence.
Automation Leadership: Architect and lead the development of test automation frameworks and tools to streamline testing processes.
Team Management: Mentor and manage a skilled QA team, fostering collaboration with software and product teams to deliver high-quality solutions.
Quality Ownership: Take full ownership of product quality, proactively identifying, tracking, and resolving quality issues and escalations.
Process Optimization: Establish and enforce QA standards and best practices, ensuring thorough coverage of front-end, back-end, and integrated system testing.
Communication & Reporting: Monitor and report on quality metrics, ensuring clear communication of testing progress, risks, and outcomes.
Requirements
Proven Leadership: 2+ years of experience leading small to medium QA teams in a hands-on capacity, ideally within a fast-paced startup environment.
Comprehensive QA Expertise: Deep understanding of the software development lifecycle, QA methodologies, and best practices.
Technical Proficiency: Hands-on experience with:
Back-end and front-end testing
Cloud environments (AWS preferred)
Linux environments and scripting
Python programming
Continuous Integration/Deployment (CI/CD)
QA management tools (e.g., Jira)
Complex Systems: Experience testing multi-disciplinary systems that involve networking, communication, cameras, advanced algorithms, and AI.
Strong Communication: Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
Bonus Points
Experience with microservices architecture and REST APIs
Developing test automation infrastructure
Knowledge of ETL data pipelines
Proficiency in SQL (relational and non-relational databases)
Why Join Us?
Impact: Work on innovative technology that transforms maritime safety and sustainability.
Collaboration: Partner with a passionate, multidisciplinary team tackling complex challenges.
Growth: Drive the QA vision while advancing your technical and leadership skills.
Purpose: Make a meaningful impact on the future of global shipping and the environment.
This is a full-time position based in Tel Aviv. We do believe in a hybrid work environment, with an emphasis on the office, and one day a week from home.

Description
OurCrowd is a global investment platform connecting accredited investors and institutions with vetted, early-stage startups, venture funds and alternative investments. We're looking for a VP of Finance to lead financial strategy, planning, and operations.
The VP Finance will manage the Finance Department's day-to-day execution ensuring clear ownership across a highly complex organization that supports investment vehicles, funds, management companies, investor reporting, tax reporting, portfolio events, cash activity, and recurring financial close processes. Reporting to the CFO, the VP of Finance directly manages and mentors 3 Controllers/Team Leads, ensuring alignment, clear priorities, and strong performance across each area.
The ideal candidate operates at both a strategic and hands-on level. This role requires managing people, prioritizing competing deadlines, and enforcing process ownership, while coordinating closely with multiple departments. We are looking for a strong leader who can build a high-performing team, drive accountability, and coach reports to their full potential.
We are headquartered in Jerusalem. This is a hybrid role requiring 3 days per week in-office at our Jerusalem location, 30 Yesha'yahu Leibowitz Street.
Responsibilities
Daily management: Own operating cadence, weekly priorities, resource allocation, follow-up discipline, issue escalation, and cross-team coordination.
Process ownership: Implement a one-owner-per-process model — each process with a named manager, day-to-day owner, backup, and documented review cadence.
Quarterly and annual reporting: Oversee ad hoc, quarterly, and annual reporting to investors, management, GPs, investment vehicles, SPVs, and management companies.
Financial statements and close: Own the timetable and quality of quarterly and annual financial statements, including CPA/auditor coordination.
Investment operations: Oversee finance execution for deal closings, capital calls, transfers, cash movements, and related reporting.
Portfolio events: Ensure finance support for follow-ons, FMV, NAV, exits, distributions, secondaries, write-offs, and other portfolio events.
Regulatory control: Oversee recurring compliance processes, including FATCA/CRS, investor tax reporting coordination, and regulatory reporting support.
Tax planning and reporting: Coordinate tax cycles, CPA reviews, K-1/CAS/PFIC workflows, capital gains schedules, and investor-facing tax outputs.
Treasury and cash controls: Ensure bank accounts, balances, receipts, distributions, wires, and reconciliations are controlled, reviewed, and documented.
Requirements
10+ years of progressive finance experience, including 4+ years in fund accounting, private equity, or venture capital
CPA from a Big 4; public accounting/audit background - required
Proven experience managing, mentoring, and developing a finance team (Controllers/Team Leads or equivalent) with multiple workstreams, recurring deadlines, external service providers and cross-functional dependencies
Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field
Excellent English is essential, both written and verbal; professional working proficiency in Hebrew is required, with full bilingual fluency a strong asset
Experience with investment platforms, VC funds, partnership structures, private markets, asset management, fintech or complex multi-entity environments
Demonstrated experience operating within both Israeli and international business environments, including familiarity with local regulations, banking processes, and the ability to work independently and effectively with Israeli banks and tax authorities
Systems-aware and data-oriented, with the ability to partner effectively with Salesforce, ERP/accounting, Snowflake/BI, automation and AI initiatives.
Strategic and hands-on operating style, comfortable both setting direction and working in the details
Interview Process
The interview process includes:
Initial video interview with the Senior HR Manager
In-person interview with the Director of HR
In-person interviews with management (CFO, VP Finance Ops & Systems, CEO)
360 reference check (manager, peer, direct report)

OurCrowd.description:
Description
OurCrowd is a global investment platform connecting accredited investors and institutions with vetted, early-stage startups and venture funds. Behind that platform sits a tech organization building the systems that power how thousands of investors discover, evaluate, and act on private-market opportunities. We're now expanding our Technology team with engineers who can build the next generation of AI-driven products at the core of our platform.
Why Join Us?
This is a chance to build at the intersection of fintech and applied AI, not as a side experiment, but as the direction of the product. You'll design and ship production-grade backend and fullstack systems that sit at the heart of a real, global investment platform, while being hands-on building AI agents that teams across the company actually depend on: architecting scalable microservices in Node.js, putting LLMs and agentic tooling to work, and owning features end to end from design through deployment.
Because real users and real capital flow through our platform, your work ships and matters from day one. You'll get real ownership over the features you build, hands-on exposure to how we adopt agentic AI, and a front-row seat to the startup and innovation ecosystem we live inside every day. If you want to master cutting-edge AI tooling while solving hard distributed systems problems alongside a small, sharp team - this is the place to do it.
This role requires 3 days a week in-office with the technology team based out of our Tel Aviv office.
﻿
Fluent English and Hebrew required: English for direct communication with manager who is non Hebrew-speaking, and Hebrew for in person team discussions.
A strong sense of system design is a big plus for this particular team in the Technology department.
Responsibilities
Design, build, and ship production backend and fullstack features for OurCrowd's investment platform using Node.js and microservices
Build and deploy AI agents and LLM-powered tools used in production across the company, from prototype to rollout
Architect and maintain scalable microservices, integrating SQL and NoSQL data stores as needed
Design agentic workflows and orchestration pipelines, using low-code tools (e.g. n8n, Make) alongside custom services where appropriate
Own features end to end: design, estimation, implementation, testing, deployment, and monitoring
Partner with product, data, and engineering teams to turn business and investor needs into technical solutions
Evaluate emerging LLM frameworks and AI tooling to keep our stack current and production-ready
Write clean, well-tested code and participate in code reviews to uphold team quality standards
Troubleshoot issues across the stack, balancing delivery speed with the reliability a capital platform demands
Help shape architecture, tooling, and best practices as the team scales its use of agentic AI
Requirements
5+ years of backend / fullstack development experience
Hands-on experience with JavaScript, Node.js, microservices, and both SQL & NoSQL databases
2+ years of experience with AI or machine learning frameworks, including hands-on experience building AI agents in production — systems that real teams used
Familiarity with LLM frameworks, agentic tooling, and low-code orchestration platforms (n8n, Make, or equivalent)
Excellent communication skills, with fluency in English and Hebrew - required
Previous experience in fintech, payments, or capital markets/investment platforms - strong advantage
Familiarity with Salesforce is a plus
Strong fundamentals in distributed systems, data flows, and cloud/web architectures
An independent, fast learner, excited about mastering new AI technologies and tooling
A proactive team player motivated to impact the team, the product, and the customers
Interview Process
Recruiter phone call
Take home assignment
Technical in-person interview with 2 Team Leads
System Design focused virtual interview with Team Lead (English only)
In-person interview with CTO
In-person interview with HR
References

Palziv.description:
Global VP Sales & Marketing Role in Israel - Palziv
Global VP Sales & Marketing
Israel
Role Description
Lead Palziv’s global sales and marketing activities by developing and executing a comprehensive commercial and marketing strategy.
The role is responsible for accelerating profitable growth, developing markets and customers, increasing sales of value-added products and solutions, managing sales and customer service teams, and leading a commercial transformation from a primarily raw-material-based organization to a product-, solution-, and customer-value-driven organization.
Key Responsibility
Develop and Lead the Global Sales & Marketing Strategy
Develop a global sales and marketing strategy aligned with the company’s business objectives.
Build growth plans by geographic region, market segment, customer, product, and solution.
Lead commercial prioritization processes based on growth potential, profitability, and strategic value.
Create a unified commercial language across all regions and business units.
Establish global work processes for measurement, control, and continuous improvement of commercial performance.
Sales and Customer Service Management
Directly manage the sales and customer service teams in Israel, Europe, and the UK.
Hold strategic responsibility for sales activities in the USA and Mexico, without direct management responsibility.
Build sales targets, work plans, forecasts, and commercial pipelines.
Support managers and teams in achieving sales, service, customer retention, and growth targets.
Strengthen cross-functional interfaces between Sales, Customer Service, Operations, R&D, Finance, Marketing, and company management.
Implement standardized work processes and sales and service management tools, including CRM systems.
Global Marketing and Branding Management
Lead Palziv’s global marketing and branding activities.
Define the company’s positioning in different markets as a provider of advanced products and solutions, rather than only raw materials.
Build consistent marketing messages tailored to markets, customers, and business areas.
Manage marketing budgets and a variety of marketing tools.
Provide marketing support for sales activities, market penetration, and product launches.
Strengthen the company’s business and brand presence among strategic customers, partners, and global markets.
Business Development and Profitable Growth
Identify and develop new business opportunities in existing and new markets.
Expand the company’s activity with strategic customers and business partners.
Lead penetration into new geographic and business markets.
Increase sales of value-added, high-margin products and solutions.
Identify market trends, customer needs, and opportunities for developing new products and solutions.
Manage the global business development pipeline.
Lead New Product and Technology Launches
Lead launches of new products and technologies, including EPP / EPE and PalBead.
Build Go-To-Market plans for new products, technologies, and solutions.
Connect R&D, Production, Marketing, and Sales to ensure successful commercialization of new products.
Define target audiences, value propositions, pricing, marketing messages, and sales channels.

Paxos.description:
Applying to Paxos? Our only careers site is paxos.com/careers , and we only recruit via @ paxos.com email. Details below.
___
About Paxos
Today’s financial infrastructure is archaic, expensive, inefficient and risky — supporting a system that leaves out more people than it lets in. So we’re rebuilding it.
We’re on a mission to open the world’s financial system to everyone by enabling the instant movement of any asset, any time, in a trustworthy way. For over a decade, we’ve built blockchain infrastructure that tokenizes, custodies, trades and settles assets for the world’s leading financial institutions, like Mastercard, Visa, Robinhood, and PayPal.
The Opportunity
As a Senior Security Operations Engineer, you will serve on the front lines of our security program, helping protect the organization by detecting, investigating, and containing threats across our endpoints, cloud infrastructure, and network. You will act as both an investigator and a builder: triaging and resolving security incidents with precision while continuously improving detections and automations that help the team move faster and operate more effectively. This role is central to our day-to-day security posture, turning alerts into meaningful action.
What You'll Do
Triage, investigate, and respond to security alerts across endpoints, cloud infrastructure, and network telemetry.
Take a builder’s mindset to the role by automating repetitive workflows and using AI to increase speed, scale, and effectiveness.
Execute containment and remediation actions for confirmed incidents, while following and continuously improving established runbooks.
Tune and maintain SIEM and EDR detections to reduce false positives, strengthen signal quality, and close coverage gaps.
Apply threat intelligence, including IOCs and TTPs, to active investigations and ongoing monitoring.
Participate in the on-call rotation and contribute clear, actionable post-incident documentation.
About You
You bring 5+ years of experience in security operations, detection and response, or a related security engineering role.
You have deep experience leading investigations and response efforts across endpoints, cloud environments, and network telemetry, and can independently manage complex security incidents from initial triage through containment, eradication, and recovery.
You bring strong analytical judgment, mature decision-making, and a calm, methodical approach to high-severity alerts and incidents, including the ability to prioritize effectively and guide others through ambiguity.
You have advanced hands-on experience with SIEM and EDR platforms, including building and tuning detections, improving signal quality, reducing false positives, and shaping detection strategy based on evolving threats.
You think like a builder and continuously identify opportunities to automate repetitive security workflows, including applying AI thoughtfully to improve the speed, consistency, and scale of investigations and response.
You are skilled at applying threat intelligence, including IOCs, TTPs, and adversary tradecraft, to investigations, proactive threat hunting, and the continuous improvement of monitoring and detection capabilities.
You are comfortable participating in an on-call rotation, and you document incidents clearly and thoroughly while driving post-incident reviews, operational improvements, and stronger team readiness over time.
You have experience mentoring teammates, raising the quality of investigative work, and influencing security operations processes, tooling, and standards across the team.
Important Notice for Paxos Applicants
Fraudulent accounts sometimes pose as Paxos recruiters on LinkedIn and other platforms, and fake websites sometimes impersonate our careers site. These scammers attempt to deceive applicants into paying for job opportunities or providing personal financial information.
To verify a legitimate Paxos opportunity:
Our only official careers site is paxos.com/careers
We only use @ paxos.com email addresses
We never ask for payment or financial details to apply, interview, or work here
For technical roles, we do not perform a coding interview without prior screening by our engineering team
Thanks for your interest in Paxos!

PepsiCo.description:
Overview (English)
At SodaStream, part of PepsiCo, we are looking for a Global Planning Sr. Manager
The Global Planning Sr. Manager is a senior leadership role within SodaStream’s Global Supply Chain organization, responsible for leading the end-to-end planning agenda for SodaStream’s Israeli manufacturing operations across metal, assembly and plastics. The role ensures that production capacity, materials, inventory, master data and new product requirements are aligned with global demand, S&OP / IBP priorities and business objectives.
Reporting to the Global Supply Chain Sr. Director, the role is a member of the SodaStream Global Supply Chain Leadership Team and serves as a key interface between Israeli manufacturing, global S&OP, international markets, procurement, R&D, engineering, quality, logistics and cross-site supply chain teams. The position leads an organization of approximately 20 planning and supply chain professionals, including five direct reports.
#sodastream
Responsibilities (English)
Lead the end-to-end production planning process for SodaStream’s Israeli manufacturing sites across metal, assembly and plastics, translating global demand, S&OP / IBP priorities, inventory targets and operational constraints into executable production plans.
Set production priorities across plants and subcontractors, balancing service, capacity, inventory, cost and operational stability, while identifying material, capacity and supply constraints and leading mitigation and recovery plans.
Own planning recommendations for raw materials, buy items, long-lead components, technical warehouse materials and maintenance-related items, ensuring supplier lead times, MOQ constraints, demand variability and inventory objectives are reflected in supply plans.
Define and govern inventory targets, safety stocks and replenishment parameters, balancing customer service, supply continuity, working capital, obsolescence and operational risk.
Lead planning-related master data governance, MRP parameters, system inputs, reporting, dashboards and planning analytics to create a reliable single source of truth for planning, supply, inventory and operational decision-making.
Lead planning readiness for NPI and product changes, including bill-of-materials readiness, material availability, capacity readiness, inventory parameters and cross-functional alignment with R&D, Engineering, Operations, Procurement, Quality and global markets.
Serve as the key planning interface with global S&OP / IBP teams and international markets, providing visibility on capacity, material constraints, service risks, inventory and supply allocation priorities.
Manage the planning interface with SodaStream Netherlands and other cross-site partners, aligning supply plans, shipment needs, inventory levels, risks and recovery plans to ensure service reliability.
Lead, develop and strengthen a planning organization of approximately 20 employees, directly managing five team leaders / managers, setting clear objectives, accountability, operating routines and capability-building plans.
Drive planning standards, governance, process improvement, automation, digitalization and transformation across the planning organization, while contributing to global supply chain strategy and leadership forums.
Qualifications (English)
Bachelor's degree in industrial engineering, Supply Chain, Operations, Business or a related discipline; advanced degree is an advantage.
At least 10 years of experience in production planning, supply planning, material planning or end-to-end supply chain within a complex manufacturing environment.
At least 5 years of managerial experience, including proven experience leading planning teams through team leaders or managers.
Strong knowledge of S&OP / IBP, MRP, capacity planning, inventory management, production scheduling, master data and planning systems.
Experience working in multi-site manufacturing environments and international supply chains.
Strong analytical, problem-solving and decision-making skills, with the ability to translate data into clear operational and business decisions.
Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills, with the ability to align global and local teams across Operations, Supply Chain, Procurement, R&D, Engineering, Quality, Logistics and commercial markets.
Experience with ERP / planning systems, BI / reporting tools, automation, digitalization and planning-system transformation.
Excellent communication and presentation skills in English.
Strong leadership capabilities, including end-to-end supply chain thinking, business acumen, strategic planning, execution discipline, people development, continuous improvement mindset, resilience and the ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, cross-functional global environment with competing priorities.

Description
Pipl is an AI company that helps global enterprises make better fraud decisions. We're built on more than 20 years of identity data and Elephant, the industry's only large risk model trained on payment fraud.
Pipl's three products give enterprise teams modular access to the intelligence they need across payment and transaction ecosystems, where the cost of getting it wrong is highest.
Pipl Trust brings AI-native risk decisioning into payment workflows, with Elephant resolving identity across behavioral, device, and network signals in real time. Pipl Search connects identity intelligence for investigations and background checks, drawing on our global identity graph. Pipl Elements delivers phone and email signals that strengthen existing fraud models and verification workflows.
Our identity graph covers more than 5 billion identities and 740 billion signals. The world's largest payment networks, ecommerce marketplaces, and digital wallet platforms trust Pipl to get it right.
We are looking for a DevOps Engineer to be part of the Platform team that is responsible for architecting, provisioning, automating and deploying our products. In this role, on the day-to-day, you will have a major impact on the way we design, deploy, support, and operate our DevOps solutions to meet the needs, and evolve the underlying technology.
Responsibilities:
Design, develop, and implement scalable and robust cloud infrastructure solutions, utilizing industry best practices for high availability, performance, and security.
Manage and optimize CI/CD pipelines to enable seamless software delivery and automated deployments across multiple environments.
Collaborate with development, operations, and quality assurance teams to define and implement efficient workflows, ensuring the stability and reliability of production systems.
Identify and implement automation opportunities to improve the efficiency of software development and deployment processes, such as infrastructure provisioning, configuration management, and monitoring.
Monitor system performance, troubleshoot issues, and perform root cause analysis to identify and resolve problems promptly.
Implement security best practices, ensuring compliance with relevant regulations and standards.
Work on-call in rotation.
Requirements
At least 4 years of professional experience as a DevOps Engineer
Solid understanding of Cloud Infrastructure, (preferably GCP) - Must
Experience in containerization technologies like Docker, Kubernetes, GKE - Must
Experience in building, deploying and managing CI/CD pipelines using tools like GitHub Actions with ArgoCD - Must
Experience with using and implementing IaC; Terraform, Crossplane
Experience with monitoring tools like Prometheus, Grafana, Loki
Good scripting skills using Bash or Python
Ability to debug problems that span systems and design solutions that span the whole stack
Ability to hold yourself and others to a high bar when working with production systems
Strong communication and collaboration skills

Description
About Port
At Port.io, we are building an open and flexible Agentic SDLC Platform for modern engineering organizations. Following our recent $100M Series C funding round, we are in a phase of rapid hypergrowth with strong enterprise momentum.
We act as the central nervous system for engineering, enabling platform teams to unify their stack and expose it as a governed layer through golden paths for developers and AI agents. By combining rich engineering context, workflows, and actions, we help organizations transition from manual processes to autonomous, AI-assisted engineering workflows — while maintaining control and accountability.
As a product-led company, we believe in building world-class platforms that fundamentally shape how modern engineering organizations operate.
About the Role
We are seeking a strategic technical leader to drive the next phase of our engineering evolution. Reporting directly to the VP of R&D, you will carry two core mandates:
Manage one or more engineering teams with a focus on AI development.
Lead AI SDLC transformation efforts across the entire R&D organization.
This is a rare, high-leverage role at the intersection of people leadership, technical craft, and organizational transformation. If you want to define how an entire engineering organization works in the age of AI — and leave a lasting fingerprint on a fast-scaling SaaS platform — this role is for you.
What You'll Do:
Domain Ownership & People Management
Assume operational leadership for critical R&D domains, including management of engineering teams focusing on AI.
Manage, coach, and grow Team Leads and senior engineers, building leadership depth across your domains.
Own team health, delivery velocity, and engineering quality for every team under your purview.
AI Developer Experience (AI DX)
Lead the transformation of our engineering processes by implementing AI-driven tools, frameworks, and workflows.
Significantly accelerate R&D throughput, optimize developer workflows, and foster an AI-first engineering culture — leading by example.
Drive adoption of agentic coding tools (e.g., Cursor, AI agents) across teams and measure their impact on productivity.
Technical Authority & Governance
Challenge existing architectural paradigms and introduce innovative, out-of-the-box solutions to complex technical problems.
Mentor engineering teams and raise the bar for AI engineering quality and best practices across R&D.
Strategic Cross-Team Leadership
Orchestrate complex, cross-functional initiatives that require deep technical alignment across disparate teams.
Manage project delivery, timelines, and execution to ensure seamless cross-functional results.
Architectural Vision
Define and execute the long-term technical AI roadmap, ensuring high standards of scalability, reliability, observability and engineering excellence across the platform.
Requirements
Engineering leadership experience: Extensive background as a Director of Engineering or equivalent senior technical leadership capacity (typically 8+ years of experience), overseeing multiple Team Leads and cultivating leadership talent in medium-to-large startup environments. Proven experience working in organizations with enterprise customers.
Delivery track record: Demonstrated success managing cross-functional engineering teams and delivering large-scale technical projects.
Deep GenAI expertise: Strong knowledge of LLMs, evals, RAG, AI harness/agent architectures, and production-grade AI systems.
AI DX hands-on experience: Proven track record of implementing AI agents and tooling to improve R&D productivity across multiple teams, with measurable outcomes and adoption.
Architectural vision: Strong track record of architectural decision-making, technical mentoring, and long-term roadmap planning.
Communication: Exceptional ability to bridge the gap between technical teams and business stakeholders. Fluent Hebrew and English.
Startup DNA: Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, hyper-growth environment where priorities shift and speed matters.
Why Port?
Work on real problems at scale — Port serves enterprise engineering organizations with thousands of developers.
Rare scope — own both team leadership and org-wide AI transformation from day one.
Hyper-growth moment — $100M Series C, strong enterprise pipeline, and a category we're actively defining.
Brilliant team — collaborate with world-class engineers and product leaders who care deeply about craft.

At Port, we've taken a platform-first, builder mindset from day one, developing the modular building §blocks we call pillars. Our users are exceptional engineers who continuously build creative and unexpected solutions with our platform. Being a PM here means embracing that creative tension while staying relentlessly focused on where the platform needs to go next.
As a PM at Port, you'll own a pillar end-to-end alongside your team of engineers and designers. You'll build and evolve it as a standalone value stream and as a connected part of the broader platform. PMs at Port are full picture owners: they shape the story of their pillar from market positioning to technical enablement, defining success not just by what gets shipped, but by the measurable impact it delivers.
What you'll do
Define what to build and why. Go deep with customers, analyze usage data, and research the competitive landscape. Bring that view to your team, build a sharp perspective on what's worth building next, and communicate the reasoning to engineering, leadership, and the market.
Shape experiences engineers choose to use. Port’s developer experience spans the entire ecosystem across the UI, API, CLI, and daily chat and coding interfaces. Work closely with design and engineering to make each surface deliberate, from the first wireframe through launch.
Drive cross-functional impact. At Port, PMs don't hand off and wait. You work across engineering, design, marketing, sales, and CS throughout the full product cycle, accountable for picking the right problem, the solution built, and whether the launch lands.
Build for agents and developers. Port is the context and action layer for both. Shape your domain so agents can act on it reliably and developers can navigate it intuitively. Understand the tradeoffs in how data, APIs, and interfaces serve both. Separate the signal from the hype, and use that view to sharpen your roadmap.
Measure what matters. Define success metrics before you ship. Track adoption, analyze what's landing, and iterate until the outcome is real.

4+ years in product management across at least two companies or roles, with a track record of shipping products that developers or technical users rely on.

Technically grounded. You've experimented with APIs, MCP, CLI, and similar surfaces. You can think like the engineer you're building for and hold your own in technical conversations.
Obsessed with experience. You care deeply about how something feels to use, not just what it does. Whether it's a UI, API, chat, or CLI interface, you've worked closely with designers and engineers to make each surface right, and pushed back when something wasn't good enough.
Analytical. You work with both qualitative and quantitative data to drive decisions. You define success metrics before you ship and use them to decide what to do next.
Hands-on with AI. AI tools are part of your daily workflow. You have a real thesis on where AI for developers is heading, and you can articulate why.
Strong communicator. You explain product decisions clearly, inspire the team around a direction, and can tell the story of what you're building to customers and executives alike.
Collaborative by default. You share credit, ask for input, and make the people around you better. You've pulled a team forward on something hard, not just contributed to it.

We act as the central nervous system for engineering, enabling platform teams to unify their stack and expose it as a governed layer through golden paths for developers and AI agents.
By combining rich engineering context, workflows, and actions, we help organizations transition from manual processes to autonomous, AI assisted engineering workflows while maintaining control and accountability.
As a product led company, we believe in building world class platforms that fundamentally shape how modern engineering organizations operate.
Role & Responsibilities
We are looking for a highly motivated developer to join our team and help shape the future of internal developer portals.
Upon joining Port, you will:
Build cutting edge solutions using a modern tech stack, serving thousands of daily active developers worldwide.
Help organizations build internal developer portals easily, improving developer experience and platform engineering processes.
Work end to end on design, implementation, and daily feature delivery, influencing complex, scaled backend systems that cater to a wide user base.
Our stack includes:
Frontend: React + TypeScript
Backend: NodeJS + TypeScript, Python, Golang
Databases & Infrastructure: Kafka + Kafka Connect, Redis, PostgreSQL
Beyond coding, you will:
Assist in planning and grow the engineering team’s skills
Help recruit new talent
Contribute to open source projects, collaborating with developers globally
At Port, you won’t just build, you’ll shape the future of developer experiences.
Who You'll work with:
As a Fullstack Developer at Port, you'll be joining a collaborative and dynamic team of talented and experienced developers where creativity and innovation thrive.
You'll closely collaborate with our dedicated Product Managers and Designers, working hand in hand to bring our developer portal product to life.
Your input and expertise will have a significant impact on the product's development, as it's tailor made for developers like you.
Additionally, you will have the opportunity to work closely with our customers and engage with our product community. Your insights and interactions with them will play an important role to ensure we deliver the best product possible.
Together, we'll continue to empower platform engineers and developers worldwide, providing them with the tools they need to create seamless and robust developer portals. Join us in our mission to revolutionize the developer experience!
Requirements
6+ years of professional software engineering experience
Experience in designing and developing complex systems, highlighting your ability to tackle challenging technical problems
A collaborative team player skilled in driving initiatives to successful achievements.
Experience in React + Typescript
Experience in NodeJs + Typescript
﻿Advantages:
Experience in Python
Experience in Golang
Experience in Kafka, MongoDB, Postgres, OpenSearch, Redis
Experience in AWS
Experience in Kubernetes
Experience with modern AI architectures and design patterns.

Port.io.description:
Description
About Port
Port is the Agentic SDLC Platform. The way engineering teams build software is constantly evolving, and every new wave - such as AI agents operating across the SDLC- makes engineering more powerful, but also more complex and chaotic.
Port turns that chaos into control: one platform to build, govern, and operate the software development lifecycle, enabling every team to move as fast as technology allows.
Following our $100M Series C funding round, we are entering an exciting stage of significant growth and global expansion. As a product-led company, we believe the recipe for success is a world-class product that speaks for itself.
About Your Day-to-Day
As a Social Media Manager, you will play a meaningful role in shaping how Port communicates its vision and interacts with the global engineering community.
You will work closely with the Content, Design, and Demand Generation teams, Product Marketing and CEO office, take ownership over Port’s organic social presence and community engagement, and help transform complex technical concepts into clear, viral, and high-impact social narratives.
Responsibilities:
Owning and executing the global social media strategy across LinkedIn, X, reddit, stack overflow, YouTube, and emerging developer platforms with independence and accountability.
Collaborating with technical stakeholders to translate "Agentic Engineering" and platform engineering trends into engaging, platform-native content.
Turning ambiguity into a structured content calendar, ensuring a consistent and high-quality brand voice that resonates with developers and CTOs alike.
Driving high-quality execution of social campaigns, from live-tweeting major events to launching video series and product updates.
Communicating clearly and documenting performance , using data to track engagement, follower growth, and social-to-site traffic.
Continuously improving community standards , proactively engaging in technical discourse, and managing Port’s online reputation.
Film, edit, and publish short-form video and Shorts as a core, recurring part of the role, frequently self-produced and often shipped same day
Ghostwrite and publish thought leadership on behalf of our founder and executives, in their voice, on technical subject matter
Partner directly with our technical team on research-led and engineering-focused content, translating complex material into content that developers respect
How Success Will Look Like
Success in this role means becoming the digital voice of Port, building a loyal and engaged community of engineering leaders.
Within the first months, you are expected to:
Take full ownership of all social channels and establish a predictable posting cadence.
Deliver consistent, high-quality content that significantly increases organic engagement rates.
Proactively identify trending topics in the DevOps and Platform Engineering space to position Port as a thought leader.
Build strong working relationships with internal SMEs (Subject Matter Experts) to extract insights for content.
Contribute to a calmer, more predictable social workflow through better planning and automation.
﻿What we're looking for:
﻿ A creator's instinct. You film, you publish constantly, and you have a personal feel for what performs rather than only a framework for it
Genuine comfort working alongside deeply technical people, with the ability to hold a credible conversation about engineering subject matter
Demonstrated thought leadership experience, ideally ghostwriting for founders or executives
Someone who works well with spontaneity. Priorities here shift the same day and the strongest ideas often arrive unplanned
Requirements
Writing and creative skills
4+ years of experience in social media management or community building, specifically for a technical B2B SaaS or DevTools company.
Experience with technical storytelling —you can explain the evolution from a static Internal Developer Portal (IDP) to an Agentic Engineering Platform (AEP) in a concise, high-impact social post.
Proficiency in social media toolstacks (e.g., Sprout Social, Buffer, Canva, and native analytics platforms).
Ability to operate in a fast-paced environment , responding to industry news and technical trends in real-time.
Personal Attributes & Mindset
High ownership mentality — you treat our social channels as your own product and care deeply about every reply and post.
Strong sense of structure — you are highly organized and can manage a multi-channel calendar without friction.
Comfortable with technical ambiguity — you aren't afraid to dive into documentation to find the "hook" for a post.
Collaborative and creative — you can brainstorm with designers one hour and data analysts the next.
Clear and witty communicator — you have a "voice" that is professional yet authentic to the developer community.
Cares deeply about impact — you don't just chase "likes"; you care about driving meaningful conversation and brand affinity.

About the position:
The Special Projects Lead in Port's CEO's Office serves as a strategic connection point between Port's product organization and its go-to-market teams. Reporting to the Field CTO, this role addresses the company's highest-priority challenges as they emerge, and operates across a broad and evolving scope of strategic initiatives.
The core of the role is 0→1 execution. Each quarter, the position is aligned to specific company KPIs, and is responsible for building the required foundations from the ground up: processes, tooling, content, and enablement infrastructure. Initiatives are developed, validated, and operationalized before being transitioned to the relevant owning team.
Execution spans a wide range of activities depending on the initiative in focus. These may include:
Building product demos and technical assets on the Port platform
Partnering with marketing to produce content that communicates Port's positioning to the market
Meeting with customers and prospects to gather feedback and validate direction
Representing Port at industry conferences and events
Conducting market research to inform where the company invests next
Designing and standing up new internal processes, programs, and tooling
The scope of this role is intentionally broad and will evolve alongside company priorities. It is well suited to a candidate who thrives on breadth, operates with speed and autonomy, and is motivated by working at the center of the business.
What success will look like:
Own strategic initiatives end to end, from definition through execution and handover, working in close partnership with the Field CTO on direction while driving the execution independently
Proactively identify signals in the market, product, or field, and initiate ideas and projects independently, without waiting for direction from the Field CTO or CEO
Set a consistently high quality bar, delivering work that is best in class rather than simply complete
Operate independently in front of customers and prospects, running meetings and demos with confidence and credibility
Become a recognized internal expert on both the Port platform and the broader market, and a person other teams come to for answers
Move quickly across changing priorities, ramping into new domains and delivering meaningful output within weeks rather than months
The clearest signal of success is that initiatives this person touches move faster, land better, and reach a higher standard than they would have otherwise.
Requirements
4 years of experience in Engineering / technical customer facing roles, with hands-on technical ability
Hands-on experience with AI tools and agents: prompting, building automations, working with agentic workflows
Strong presentation skills, comfortable running meetings and demos in front of technical and executive audiences
Fluent English (written and verbal) and Hebrew
Experience with dev tools, platform engineering, or DevOps concepts is a strong plus
Advantage for experience in Sales engineering, Product Marketing, and technical GTM roles
Personal Attributes & Mindset
Exceptional communicator, written and verbal, able to adapt to technical, executive, and customer audiences
Winner mindset: optimistic, competitive, and eager to take on any challenge
Sharp problem solver, able to break down complex and ambiguous problems into clear direction
Confident and engaging presence, comfortable leading a room
High ownership: takes responsibility and follows through end to end
Autodidact, learns new tools, domains, and problems fast with minimal guidance
Comfortable with ambiguity and constantly shifting scope
Cares deeply about quality, impact, and the success of the company as a whole
Extensive travel could be required

Prisma Photonics.description:
In this role, you will research and develop next-generation distributed fiber-optic sensing technologies, focusing on signal processing, system modeling, simulations, and experimental validation. Working at the intersection of physics, electro-optics, fiber-optic sensing, and DSP, you will transform complex physical phenomena into robust sensing solutions for real-world applications.
You will tackle challenging physical and algorithmic problems, contribute to cutting-edge sensing products, and collaborate closely with multidisciplinary R&D teams.
This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment, enjoys working across disciplines, and is excited to take ideas from research and lab validation to large-scale deployment.
What You’ll Do:
Conduct experimental and theoretical R&D for Prisma’s next-generation distributed fiber-optic acoustic sensing systems.
Develop, implement, and validate DSP algorithms for coherent optical sensing systems.
Build end-to-end expertise across the full sensing pipeline, including optical signal generation and propagation, coherent detection, signal acquisition, DSP, and advanced data analysis.
Design and run laboratory experiments to validate new concepts, improve system performance, and support current and future product generations.
Develop simulations, models, and analysis tools using Python and/or C++ for lab experiments, field data analysis, signal processing, and system-level performance evaluation.
Work with field experiment data to identify performance gaps, validate models, and improve sensing capabilities.
Collaborate with R&D teams across disciplines to develop, validate, and integrate new sensing capabilities.
Communicate complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
What You Bring:
MSc or PhD in Physics, Applied Mathematics, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
Strong understanding of DSP methods, system-level modeling, and validation of algorithms using experimental or field data.
Strong background in one or more relevant domains, such as electro-optics, fiber sensing, optical communications, RF DSP, radar/sonar, ultrasound imaging, or related fields.
Experience applying DSP methods to physical sensing problems, including modeling, extracting, and interpreting signals from noisy experimental or field-deployed systems.
Experience with advanced signal processing methods, such as filtering, spectral analysis, FFT-based processing, estimation, detection, or time-series analysis.
Experience processing large-scale or streaming signal data and developing real-time or near-real-time DSP pipelines.
Strong programming skills in Python, C++ or similar.
Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities.
Strong communication skills, with the ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a multidisciplinary team.
Ability to manage multiple tasks and projects in a dynamic R&D environment.
Great to Have:
Experience applying AI/ML techniques to signal processing problems and/or using AI-assisted tools to accelerate DSP research, simulations, and experimental analysis.
Hands-on laboratory experience with advanced optical measurement techniques and optical/electro-optical systems.
Experience with electro-optical noise analysis, including phase noise, detector noise, amplifier noise, SNR, and related performance limitations.
Experience with GPU acceleration, CUDA, or parallel computing.

BDR SDR cloud SAAS CRM About Profisea Profisea is a multi-cloud DevOps as a Service company and Premier Partner with AWS, GCP, Azure, and Oracle. We help fast growing startups and scaleups run reliable, cost efficient cloud infrastructure without building an internal DevOps team from scratch. Our clients include companies across fintech, AI, and SaaS who are scaling fast and need real cloud expertise, not just credits. About the role We’re looking for a Sales Development Representative to build and manage outbound pipeline for our US market. You’ll be based in our Israel office, but your day will run on US hours and your entire focus will be American CTOs, VPs of Engineering, and founders evaluating how to scale their cloud infrastructure. This is a foundational role for our US expansion. What you’ll do Research and identify target accounts that fit our ideal customer profile, fast growing US companies with meaningful cloud spend who need DevOps capability without hiring internally. Run outbound campaigns across email, LinkedIn, and phone to generate qualified meetings with US prospects. Qualify inbound leads from marketing campaigns and events. Work closely with account executives to hand off qualified opportunities smoothly. Keep CRM data accurate and up to date in HubSpot. What we’re looking for Native or native level English, American accent and business communication style are important since you’ll be speaking with US prospects daily. Deep familiarity with US business culture. American citizens, former US residents, or Olim from the US are a strong fit. Willing and able to work US hours, meaning afternoon and evening shifts Israel time. 1 to 3 years of SDR or BDR experience, ideally in SaaS, cloud, or technical B2B sales. Comfortable talking to technical audiences like CTOs and VPs of Engineering, even without a deep technical background yourself. Self starter, comfortable being the only one on the team working that shift. Experience with HubSpot or similar CRM tools is a plus. Familiarity with cloud platforms like AWS, GCP, or Azure is a plus but not required. What we offer Ground floor opportunity to build Profisea’s US market presence. Direct mentorship from experienced sales leadership. Competitive commission structure.
