Siemens Israel.description:
Responsibilities
AI Quality & Stability Research
Define and implement metrics to measure the stability, accuracy, and reliability of our production AI Copilot (PSCoPilot)
Design evaluation frameworks for AI agents operating in safety-critical robotics and simulation environments
Build observability and tracing pipelines using platforms like Langfuse to monitor Copilot performance, token usage, latency, and tool-calling success rates
Analyze failure modes, hallucination patterns, and tool-calling accuracy across 48+ MCP-exposed robotic operations
Develop automated regression and benchmark pipelines to track Copilot quality over time
Data Science & Experimentation
Conduct statistical analysis on Copilot interactions (tool selection accuracy, collision detection correctness, path planning success rates)
Research and apply techniques from AI evaluation literature (LLM-as-judge, human-in-the-loop validation, domain-specific benchmarks)
Leverage LangChain and similar orchestration frameworks to prototype evaluation chains, structured agent workflows, and comparison experiments
Explore how multi-layer agent architectures (fast triage + deep execution) affect accuracy and cost trade-offs
Challenge the team with data-driven insights on where the Copilot underperforms and why
Domain AI Research
Investigate how to improve AI reasoning for robotics tasks requiring high precision (welding, clearance checking, reachability analysis)
Research grounding techniques that reduce errors in domains with zero tolerance for incorrect outputs
Explore and apply new AI technologies (GenAI tools, AI coding assistants, agents, MCP-based solutions) to enhance Copilot capabilities
Validate technical feasibility through hands-on experimentation with our production MCP bridge and two-layer streaming agent engine
Communication & Documentation
Document findings, benchmarks, and technical recommendations
Present results to technical and business partners
Collaborate with the team to translate research insights into production improvements
Qualifications
Currently pursuing a Master's degree or equivalent experience in AI, Data Science, Machine Learning, Computer Science, Statistics, or a related field with minimum 2 years until graduation
Strong background in data science, statistical analysis, and experiment design
Proficiency in Python with experience using LLM orchestration platforms (LangChain, AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI)
Familiarity with LLM evaluation techniques, prompt engineering, or AI agent architectures
Experience with or strong interest in defining quality metrics for AI systems
Fast learner with strong self-motivation and ability to challenge technical decisions with data
Proficiency in English
Preferred
Experience with AI observability platforms (Langfuse, LangSmith, or similar)
Exposure to robotics, simulation, manufacturing, or safety-critical AI domains
Familiarity with MCP (Model Context Protocol), AI coding assistants, or multi-agent systems

Siemens Israel.description:
In this role, you will provide essential technical support to our customers utilizing our Tessent Design-For-Test (DFT) products. Key Responsibilities:
As a Corporate Application Engineer, your role will involve:
Staying current with the latest advancements in Scan Insertion, ATPG, BIST, and Diagnosis tools.
Collaborating with our Application Engineers and customers worldwide to resolve complex technical DFT issues.
Developing and delivering best-in-class product and flow support for DFT.
Readiness for occasional business travel (less than 10% of working time).
Qualifications:

A Bachelor's (BSEE) or Master's (MSEE) degree in Electrical Engineering, with a Master's degree being preferred.
At least two years of experience in IC/VLSI design, specifically in IC/VLSI testing and design for testability.
Preferred experience includes design, simulation, and verification of IC/VLSI circuits and systems, design verification, and product test generation.
An in-depth understanding of Design for Test (DFT) structures is required.
Knowledge of Scan Data Compression methodologies and ATPG flows and/or MemoryBIST Flows is highly desired.
Experience with CAD tools such as Synthesis, Simulation, ATPG, Memory BIST, Logic BIST, and Boundary Scan.
Strong troubleshooting skills are essential.
Excellent interpersonal communication skills and customer-facing skills are a must.

UNIX, Linux.
Verilog (Behavioral, RTL, gate level), System Verilog, VHDL (Behavioral, RTL, gate level), TCL.

About the Role
You will own the player economy across our RMG and Sweepstakes brands: bonuses, offers, VIP and loyalty, GC/SC coin packages and pricing, segmentation, economy-driven features, game RTP and content mix. You set the economic rules, measure the outcomes and adjust.
You will work across Product, CRM, VIP, User Acquisition, Analytics, Casino, Customer Service and Marketing so every team operates against one economic and monetization plan.
What You Will Do
Define monetization and economy strategy by vertical, brand and player segment: bonus cost as a share of GGR, promotional depth, VIP reinvestment, pricing and RTP policy.
Own the bonus and offer framework: mechanics, eligibility, cost models, wagering/playthrough rules and abuse controls.
Own player segmentation and lifecycle monetization across new, active, retained, lapsing, reactivated, high-value and VIP players.
Design and price GC/SC coin packages, bundles, first-purchase/first-deposit offers and personalized offers.
Own VIP and loyalty economics: tier thresholds, reinvestment rates, rewards and cost per tier; automatically control spend on negative-value players.
Approve the economics of promotions proposed by CRM, VIP, Customer Service and Marketing and hold teams accountable to the plan.
Set RTP policy by brand, market and game category, and manage game/provider mix against margin and retention targets.
Define economic requirements for features including bonus engines, gamification, missions, tournaments, jackpots, cashback and loyalty.
Own A/B testing across pricing, bonus depth, packages, rewards, promotions and economy features; scale what works and stop what does not.
Forecast the impact of changes before release and report actual performance against forecast after launch.
Define economy and monetization dashboards with Analytics and run a regular economy review with leadership.
Work with Compliance to ensure bonus terms, RTP disclosure and promotional mechanics remain within the rules of each market.
What You Bring
5+ years in Monetization, Game Economy, LiveOps, Product or Revenue Optimization within iGaming, Sweepstakes, Social Casino or highly monetized F2P gaming.
Direct ownership of bonus, promotional, economy or VIP reinvestment budgets, with measurable results you can demonstrate.
Proven ability to improve revenue, payer/depositor conversion, retention, ARPPU and player LTV.
Working knowledge of slot mechanics, RTP models, volatility, bonus abuse patterns and wagering/playthrough design.
Understanding of dual-currency Sweepstakes economies: Gold Coins / Sweepstakes Coins, purchases, promotional currency, playthrough and redemption.
Strong analytical skills: able to build cost models and independently interpret cohort, segmentation and LTV data.
Track record of controlled experimentation and changing commercial decisions based on evidence.
Leadership experience and the ability to challenge commercial teams and explain economics in clear business language.
Strong advantages: direct US Sweepstakes experience, operator-side experience with CRM/bonus engine platforms, multi-brand experience, RMG casino experience, SQL/BI capability and experience building or leading monetization/economy teams.
How Success is Measured
Bonus and promotional cost as a share of GGR within target by vertical, brand and segment.
Effective RTP and margin within policy while protecting retention and player value.
VIP reinvestment proportional to player value and profitability.
Improvement in second purchase / second deposit rates, payer conversion, ARPPU, retention and LTV.
Incremental revenue from A/B tests, new features, pricing and segmentation without costs growing faster than revenue.
The Offer
We are prepared to pay at the top of the market for exceptional talent.
High executive-level base salary
Significant performance-based bonus
Meaningful equity participation
Long-term incentives linked to the value you help create
Real ownership, direct access to senior management and significant decision-making authority
We are not looking for someone to simply manage an existing function. We want someone who can build it, own it, materially grow the business and participate in the upside they create.

WHO WE ARE
At Six Values, we are more than just a B2B betting and gaming technology company - we are creators of experiences that change people’s moods for the better.
We work directly with our own Tier-1 brands - no affiliate networks, no traffic arbitrage. We are in “scale up” mode, hiring the best and most highly motivated, fast-working, bureaucracy-hating, “I want to win but I’m not afraid to fail…” team players. We provide full-cycle B2B support services to multiple technology and gaming partners, we believe in the free market, and want to hear from the best of the best.
ROLE SUMMARY
The Middle Web/Graphic Designer joins our iGaming creative team to design and deliver work across site, email, and landing page templates, visual materials for our brands, and animated content for banners and landings. You keep source files up to date, support the front-end team through implementation, and use AI tools as a genuine part of your day-to-day process - not as an occasional shortcut. This is a full-time, full-cycle role working directly on Tier-1 brands, not through an affiliate or arbitrage team.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
• Design and deliver site, email, and landing page templates for company brands
• Create visual materials for company and marketing needs
• Produce animated content - banners and landing page animations
• Keep source files updated to their latest version and well organised
• Support design materials through front-end development, ensuring accurate implementation
• Use AI tools (Midjourney, Freepik, Magnific, and similar) as an integrated part of the daily design workflow, not just occasional use
• Big plus: build and maintain design workflows using node-based AI pipelines, e.g. Weavy by Figma or equivalent
SKILLS & EXPERIENCE
Soft skills: team player, strong time management, ownership and responsibility.
Hard skills: UI/UX, Graphic Design, Motion Design, Figma, Adobe Photoshop, Adobe Illustrator, Adobe After Effects, AI tools used daily in production (Midjourney, Freepik, Magnific, and similar).
Experience: 2+ years in design or a related field. Prior experience in iGaming is required - candidates without it will not be considered.
Big plus: hands-on experience with node-based AI pipelines and AI upscaling/generation tools (Weavy by Figma, Freepik, Magnific, or similar) - if you’ve already built workflows around these systems, you’re exactly who we’re looking for.
OTHER
• Intermediate animation skills (Adobe After Effects or similar) are a plus
• Level depends on the project - Junior to Middle+ - your portfolio should show a strong understanding of template creation, a great sense of color, and unique designs or concepts
• This industry doesn’t forgive slow learners - but if you’re already in the topic, you’ll enjoy it here
• Genuine desire to learn new techniques and share knowledge with the team
WHY JOIN US
• Work directly with our own Tier-1 brands - no affiliate or arbitrage layer between you and the product
• Full-time, full-cycle role with real ownership of your output
• Be part of a fast-growing, innovative company with a clear vision and mission
• Work in a dynamic, collaborative environment that values speed, clarity, and decisiveness
• Join a team of highly motivated, talented professionals who are passionate about delivering exceptional experiences

Key Responsibilities

Site Optimization: Execute front-end changes (HTML/CSS/JS) to improve UI/UX, landing page performance, and Core Web Vitals.
Dynamic Content: Implement dynamic segmentation and personalization strategies directly within the front-end code.
Create Landing pages: create end to end landing pages for different sources and affiliates.
2. Analytics & Tracking (GA4 Specialist)
Tracking Implementation: Own the end-to-end setup of GA4 via Google Tag Manager (GTM), including custom event tracking and enhanced measurement.

Industry Trends: Stay updated on iGaming tech trends, such as affiliate platform integrations and player loyalty tech.

Essential:
Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Marketing, Information Systems, or a related field.

About the Role
We are looking for a sharp, proactive, and commercially minded Sales Operations Manager to support Surecomp's global commercial organization and work closely with our senior leadership team.
We are looking for someone who understands how sales organizations work, knows how to turn data into insights, and is eager to be in the middle of the action rather than on the sidelines of it. You will own the operational engine of our global sales organization, from Salesforce governance and pipeline visibility through to forecasting, reporting, and commercial analysis, while working closely with senior leadership to translate insights into action.
The right person for this role has a Sales Operations foundation and the mindset to go beyond it. Someone who takes ownership naturally, moves fast, thinks commercially, and uses AI and modern tools not because they have to but because they want to, proactive by nature, not because someone asked to be, and due to the excitement it brings.
This is a hybrid position based out of our Kfar Saba office, supporting a global commercial organization across EMEA, APAC, LATAM, and North America.

Own and continuously improve global Sales Operations processes, reporting, and governance across the commercial organization.
Build, maintain, and optimize Salesforce dashboards, pipeline reports, data quality frameworks, and sales performance metrics.
Support the CRO and commercial leadership with forecasting, pipeline analysis, and business performance reviews.
Identify revenue risks, pipeline gaps, and growth opportunities through structured data analysis and commercial thinking.
Partner with regional sales teams to improve CRM adoption, opportunity management, and process discipline.
Support the preparation and execution of business reviews, including analysis, executive presentations, and follow-up tracking.
Work closely with senior leadership to translate strategic decisions into clear operational actions and cross-functional coordination.
Drive commercial initiatives in collaboration with Sales, Marketing, Finance, Customer Success, and Product teams.
Leverage AI tools and automation to improve reporting, forecasting, and operational efficiency across the revenue organization.

Experience in Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Commercial Operations, or a similar business-facing role.

Strong analytical skills with proven ability to build reports, track KPIs, and translate data into business insights.
Experience working with or supporting global sales teams or senior commercial leadership.

Practical experience using AI tools to improve productivity, reporting, or operational workflows.

Description
This is the demand generation engine, and it’s yours. Every digital channel that brings qualified demand into the funnel, paid and organic, is yours to build, run, and keep making better.
It’s a hands-on role, and honestly, that’s the best part. You’ll be in the ad accounts. You’ll build the nurture yourself in the automation platform. You’ll show up in the communities where your buyers actually spend their time. You launch something, watch what happens, and change it, often the same week. Short feedback loops, real budget, and the freedom to test things without asking permission first.
What you’re measured on is what converts, not what you launched. Lead volume matters, but the number you really own sits further down: MQL → SQL → Opportunity, and the pipeline that comes out the other end. When something slips, you get to go find out why: targeting, message, channel, or handoff, and fix it while there’s still time to matter.
You’ll run the calendar the way a good program manager would: multiple channels, agencies, and internal dependencies, with clear owners and dates. Campaigns ship when they said they’d ship, and that reliability is a big part of why the rest of the business trusts marketing.
You’ll work closely with Sales, SDR/BDR leadership, Product Marketing, and Revenue Operations every week. None of them report to you, which makes this a role for someone who enjoys bringing people along, sharing what’s working, being straight about what isn’t, and making it easy for everyone to see where the pipeline is coming from.
If you’d rather own a channel than oversee one, and you like the version of marketing where you can point at a number and say “that one’s mine,” you’ll enjoy this.
Key Responsibilities
Run the paid channels
Build, launch, and optimize paid search, paid social (LinkedIn, Meta, X), display and programmatic, and content syndication, audiences, creative, bids, budgets, and sequencing.
Run structured tests continuously across creative, audience, offer, and landing page. Weekly optimization cadence, not quarterly retrospectives.
Own the media budget end to end: allocate the next dollar to the channel producing pipeline, and shut down what does not — with the data to defend both decisions.
Run the organic and community channels
Own organic and community as genuine demand sources, not an afterthought: Reddit and other buyer communities and forums, organic social, YouTube, and owned content distribution.
Earn distribution where buyers actually are — participate credibly in communities rather than broadcasting into them, and know the difference between a channel that tolerates promotion and one that punishes it.
Own SEO and GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) — visibility and citation in AI search and answer engines — in partnership with content.
Account-based marketing
Build and prioritize target account and persona lists, and adapt the approach as deal size and buying committee change.
Run coordinated account-based programs across advertising, email, and SDR outreach so an account sees one story, not four.
Lifecycle, nurture, and marketing automation
Build and own email nurture programs, lead scoring, and routing logic directly in the marketing automation platform.
Keep data hygiene, suppression, and consent handling clean as programs scale.
Webinars and events
Own the full motion: pre-event targeting and registration driving, live engagement, and post-event follow-up with a defined SLA — measured on pipeline, not attendance.
Funnel ownership and Sales partnership
Define and defend qualified-lead criteria with Sales and SDR/BDR leadership, and own the handoff SLA and the feedback loop on lead quality.
Inspect stage-to-stage conversion weekly, diagnose drops, and adjust targeting, messaging, or channel mix.
Treat Sales feedback as a primary signal — and hold the quality bar when volume pressure pushes the other way.
Measurement, attribution, and reporting
Build and maintain the demand gen dashboard, and use it weekly rather than monthly.
Establish a defensible source of truth for attribution with Revenue Operations, and reconcile marketing-reported pipeline against what Sales sees in the CRM.
Present performance clearly to an executive audience — including the quarters that go badly, surfaced early with a recommendation attached.
Program and project management
Run a rolling multi-channel campaign calendar with named owners, dependencies, and deadlines across internal teams and external agencies.
Land launches on date, and unblock dependencies before they slip rather than reporting on them afterwards.
AI in the workflow
Apply AI where it produces measurable lift — creative production and testing, audience building, personalization at scale, predictive scoring, and campaign optimization — with guardrails on brand voice and data quality.
Requirements
Required
3+ years in B2B SaaS demand generation within a sales-led motion (mid-market and enterprise segments), not a pure self-serve or product-led environment.
Demonstrably hands-on. You personally build campaigns, sit in the ad platforms, and make the optimizations. You can walk through exactly what you changed in an underperforming campaign last month, and why.
A track record of improving funnel conversion and pipeline contribution — not only lead or MQL volume.
Fluent across the paid stack: Google Ads, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, Meta, programmatic/display, and content syndication.
Fluent across organic and community channels: SEO, community platforms including Reddit, and organic social — with a real point of view on how to earn attention there.
Hands-on with a marketing automation platform (Marketo, HubSpot, Pardot, Eloqua or similar) and CRM (Salesforce or similar) — building programs yourself, not requesting them.
Experience with ABM platforms (6sense, Demandbase or equivalent) and with multi-touch attribution and analytics tooling (GA4, BI/dashboarding, CRM reporting).

SysAid.description:
Description
This is a senior marketing leadership role with real breadth. You'll own SysAid's market narrative, brand identity, and the full content engine behind it, leading a team of seven across product marketing, content, creative, design, communications, partner marketing, and field marketing.
The right person has lived at the intersection of PMM and brand long enough to have opinions about how they should work together. They lead by creating clarity. They think in systems. And they're genuinely curious about what AI means for how a marketing team operates, not as a trend to follow, but as infrastructure to build on purpose.
About the role
You'll own how SysAid shows up in the market. That means the messaging that lands in a sales conversation, the brand identity on a campaign, the content that earns category authority over time, and the story that reaches analysts, press, and partners. All of it runs through you.
Your team covers a lot of ground: product marketing, content, creative, design, communications, partner marketing, and field marketing. That's a diverse set of disciplines, each with its own cadence and craft. The leadership challenge here isn't managing up; it's creating the conditions for seven specialists to pull in the same direction, at the same pace, without losing coherence.
You'll report to the CMO and sit at the table with Growth, Sales, and Product. You're expected to show up with a point of view on the message, on the market, on what we should be saying, and what we should stop saying.
The person we're looking for has probably led a repositioning. Has built a messaging framework that held up under pressure from Sales and Product. Has grown people who went on to lead their own functions. And is already thinking about how AI changes what a content team can produce, and what it takes to make that output trustworthy.
One thing worth knowing: this team owns the content infrastructure that feeds SysAid's AI-powered marketing engine. In a world where AI generates content at scale, the quality of the inputs determines the quality of everything downstream. That's not a technical problem; it's a leadership and editorial one. And it sits with you.
What you'll do
Own SysAid's messaging framework, which is the single source of truth for how the company talks about what it does and why it matters.
Build and maintain persona-level, product-level, and industry-level positioning that holds up in the field, including in a sales conversation, an analyst briefing, a paid campaign, or a press interview.
Translate product releases, market shifts, and competitive moves into messaging updates that reach every function fast.
Own SysAid's brand identity: visual standards, tone of voice, brand book, asset templates, and 10x our creative output.
Own the communications and PR strategy, specifically how SysAid shows up in press, analyst relations, and industry conversations.
Activate these narratives across every channel, in collaboration with Growth, to drive pipeline and brand awareness.
Grow and nurture your team, empowering them to achieve their targets and career goals.
Operationalize AI across every key content, creative, and GTM process.
Requirements
10+ years in B2B SaaS marketing, with direct ownership of both product marketing and brand. Exposure to both is not the same thing.
Proven track record building messaging from scratch — frameworks that held up when they hit Sales, Product, and the market simultaneously.
Experience leading and growing diverse marketing teams. Your reports develop under you. That's a pattern, not a coincidence.
A track record in cross-functional GTM: launches, repositioning exercises, or category-defining moments you can walk through in detail.
AI-native mindset. Not someone who has just tried the tools, but someone who has thought through what AI means for how a content team should be structured, what the inputs need to look like, and how to keep quality high at volume.
Comfortable at the strategic layer when the picture is still forming. Precise and execution-focused when it's time to ship.
Empathic by default, but not soft. You lead by creating clarity — for your team, for your peers, for the exec team.
A robust sense of humor:)
Why SysAid
SysAid sits at the intersection of two things the market hasn't figured out how to combine yet: enterprise-grade ITSM with agentic AI that actually does the work.
Most IT platforms added a chatbot and called it AI. SysAid's AI resolves incidents, fulfills requests, triggers workflows, and deploys automations on its own: no code, no developer, no black box. Every action is logged, traceable, and tied to rules the IT team sets. That's not a product feature. That's a different category. And the market is still catching up to what that means.
The company is at an inflection point. The product is winning. The pipeline is growing. And the marketing team is mid-way through building the operating system to match, which is a structured execution model where AI handles content production at scale, and humans own direction, quality, and judgment. It's in motion, not finished. The person stepping into this role will shape how it comes together.
That's the opportunity. A market position that's genuinely differentiated. A product that does what it says. An infrastructure that's being built with intention. And a team of seven waiting for a leader who can raise the standard across all of it.
If you want to own the narrative for a company at this moment, not after the story is written, but while it's being written, this is it.

SysAid.description:
Description
SysAid is becoming an agentic ITSM leader - and we're rebuilding R&D to match. In our AI-native model, a managed, always-on "Machine" produces most of the code while small pods of engineers, PMs and designers direct, review, and govern it. In that world, quality isn't a phase - it's how the system is built. We're hiring a Quality Lead to own that. Why this role is different: you won't run a traditional QA team that tests features at the end. You'll own the quality gates inside the Machine and in production, author the monitoring skills our pods rely on, and hold independent authority to fail the Machine's output. Quality is our north star, and this role sets the bar.
THE MISSION: Make reliability, performance, and user experience a property of the system — not of individual heroics. Build and lead a Quality function (~9 people) that keeps an AI-native delivery org fast and trustworthy, and give the business confidence that what the Machine ships is safe to ship.
WHAT YOU'LL DO:
﻿ Own quality gates in the Machine — prose-driven tests (generated from requirements, not the code), adversarial / agent-checks-agent review, static analysis and code-quality remediation (e.g. SonarCloud), and CI gates that run before anything reaches a human.
Own quality in production — release verification, production testing, and ownership of change-fail and deployment-rework rates.
Author monitoring guidelines & reusable observability skills that delivery pods and the Machine consume — so monitoring is built in, not bolted on.
Own the evals that score the Machine's output for behavioral consistency and reliability — treating evaluation as a first-class engineering discipline.
Act as an independent governance voice — with the authority to block or fail output that doesn't meet the bar, partnering closely with Architecture.
Partner with the Core Platform team on the quality of customer-issue fixes and existing functionality.
Lead, coach and grow the team — quality/gate engineers, an agent-evaluation engineer, production-monitoring (SRE) and QA-infrastructure engineers.
Set the quality metrics and report them — DORA + deployment-rework rate, escaped-defect rate, review-queue depth, eval pass rates.
WHAT YOU'LL OWN (OUTCOMES)
Fewer regressions and less firefighting; faster resolution of customer issues.
Reliability, performance and UX that customers can count on.
A quality system trustworthy enough to let autonomous delivery scale safely.
Requirements
7+ years in software quality / QA engineering, including leading a team, ideally owning quality for a SaaS product at scale.
Deep hands-on experience with test automation, CI/CD, and quality gates;
comfort with code-quality tooling (SonarQube/SonarCloud or similar).
Strong production monitoring / observability background (Datadog or
equivalent) and SRE-adjacent practices; monitoring-as-code a plus.
Fluency with engineering metrics — DORA, change-fail / rework rate, defect
escape — and using them to drive decisions.
Comfortable with AI-assisted / agentic development and evaluating LLM/agent
output (evals) — or a strong, demonstrated eagerness to go deep here.
A player-coach: credible hands-on and able to build and grow a team.
Able to hold an independent line and manage stakeholders across Engineering
and Product.
Professional English; based in (or able to work from) our Ukraine delivery center.
NICE TO HAVE
Experience with agentic coding tools and orchestration.
LLM evaluation frameworks and prompt/skill versioning.
ITSM domain experience.
WHY JOIN
An unusually broad, high-impact mandate: own quality across the Machine,
production, and monitoring — with real authority.
Shape the quality function of an AI-native R&D org from a strong technical base —and set standards that govern every build at fleet scale.
We build the way we sell: our own R&D is the proof case for agentic ITSM.

Teads.description:
About Teads
Teads is a leading omnichannel advertising platform focused on driving outcomes for brand and performance advertisers across screens. With a focus on meaningful business outcomes for branding and performance objectives, Teads drives value by leveraging predictive AI technology to connect quality media, beautiful brand creative, and context-driven addressability and measurement. Teads is directly partnered with more than 10,000 publishers and 20,000 advertisers globally. The company is headquartered in New York, New York with a global team of around 1,700 people in 30+ countries.
For more information, visit www.teads.com.
Our main Engineering challenges at Teads
Build efficient and easy-to-use web products used by thousands of users working for the world’s most premium publishers, advertisers, and agencies.
Rich and diverse tech stack and system architecture to optimize for performance, scalability, resiliency , and cost efficiency. We use mostly Scala and TypeScript, among others.
Working in a very high-traffic environment (2.2 billion users per month, 100 billion events per day) with low latency and high availability constraints (2 million requests per second, responses in less than 150 milliseconds).
Management of large datasets with milliseconds order of magnitude access time, to compute in a near real-time complex auction resolution algorithm (18 million predictions per second).
A fast-changing environment where we continuously collaborate with Product teams and constantly adapt our Cloud infrastructure for new features and Products .
Bring a wide diversity of profiles to the same level of quality and knowledge Work in an international environment with offices located in Israel, Slovenia and France.
Our Core Data Platform team
We're a leading force in the ad tech industry, revolutionizing how brands connect with their audiences. Our platform processes billions of ad impressions daily, generating massive datasets that drive our core business.
We thrive on innovation and seek a Senior Data Infra Engineer to help us build and scale the data infrastructure that powers our insights and analytics.
This is a unique opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies and make a direct impact on our products.
What will you do?
As a Senior Data Infra Engineer, you'll be a key part of our data platform team, responsible for designing, building, and maintaining robust and scalable data pipelines. You'll work closely with data scientists, analysts, and server side engineers to ensure our data is reliable, accessible, and ready for analysis. Your expertise will be crucial in expanding our data warehouse and data lake capabilities, enabling us to deliver next-generation ad tech solutions.
Your mission will be to:
Develop and Optimize Data Pipelines: Design, build, and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines using Apache Spark to ingest, process, and transform large-scale datasets from various sources.
Manage Cloud Infrastructure: Architect and manage our data infrastructure primarily on Google Cloud Platform (GCP) or Amazon Web Services (AWS) . This includes services like BigQuery, S3, GCS, EMR, and AirFlow.
Enhance Data Storage: Improve and manage our data warehouse and data lake solutions, ensuring data quality, consistency, and accessibility for business intelligence and machine learning applications.
Collaborate and Innovate: Partner with cross-functional teams to understand data needs and implement solutions that support new product features and business initiatives.
Ensure Data Integrity: Implement monitoring, alerting, and logging systems to maintain data pipeline health and ensure data accuracy.
What will you bring to the team?
5+ years of data engineering experience , building and operating production data pipelines at scale (TB+ datasets, hourly/daily batch or streaming workloads).
Hands-on production experience with Apache Spark and distributed data processing frameworks such as Flink, Hive, or Trino. Strong understanding of large-scale batch and streaming pipelines , including performance tuning and troubleshooting. Language is not a filter: Scala, Python, or Java are all fine. What matters is that you can debug and ship production Spark code, not which language you write it in
Production experience building and operating data solutions on GCP or AWS , including cloud-native services such as BigQuery, Dataproc, GCS, S3, EMR, or Redshift. Experience across the full project lifecycle is preferred.
Production experience with Kafka or Kafka-compatible streaming platforms , including the development, operation, and troubleshooting of real-time data pipelines, as well as debugging production incidents involving consumer lag, partition rebalancing, or data loss.
Strong understanding of data warehouse and data lake concepts , including Medallion Architecture (Bronze, Silver, Gold) and data platform best practices.
Nice to have
Production experience with a lakehouse table format (Apache Iceberg or Delta Lake). The specific format matters less than the underlying concepts: you understand how the lake stores data on object storage, how a table format adds transactional semantics on top and how a data warehouse can read that data. You have dealt with schema evolution and table maintenance.
Please submit your CV in English.
We care about you
Hybrid working model (3 days per week in the office)
Nearby parking available
Expand your toolbox with our mentorship program and internal learning tools
Pet friendly office
Happy hours
…and of course a fully stocked kitchen!

Teads.description:
About Teads
Teads is a leading omnichannel advertising platform focused on driving outcomes for brand and performance advertisers across screens. With a focus on meaningful business outcomes for branding and performance objectives, Teads drives value by leveraging predictive AI technology to connect quality media, beautiful brand creative, and context-driven addressability and measurement. Teads is directly partnered with more than 10,000 publishers and 20,000 advertisers globally. The company is headquartered in New York, New York with a global team of around 1,700 people in 30+ countries.
For more information, visit www.teads.com.
About the opportunity
We are looking for a Senior Data Scientist to join a team of passionate engineers who build premium solutions at scale. Every day, we tackle ambiguous and stimulating challenges. We build and operate large-scale distributed machine learning systems that process 1B predictions per second during real-time auctions.
What will you do?
As a Senior Data Scientist , your mission will be to:
Improve existing algorithms & tools allowing to explore and analyze more and more data and provide accurate feedback on the Teads activities.
Develop new algorithms & new approaches to provide accurate predictions and drive new products by providing business insights.
Implement your algorithms and models end to end.
Collaborate with a variety of teams to develop services from design to production.
Make sure the software is in good hands by writing, running and automating tests (unit, functional, load...).
Keep up to date with the latest Machine Learning technologies to make sure we always use the best class algorithms according to the context.
Shape how billions of people discover and enjoy premium content by improving ad relevance, quality, and efficiency across Teads’ global publisher network.
What will you bring to the team?
Strong communication skills, working collaboratively with the team, able to teach concepts, and communicate clearly to a wide audience of complicated topics.
Strong problem solving skills, and deducing from specific problems wider range products.
True scientist skills: fast learner, curious, sense of details, rigorous.
Experience in Statistics (i.e. statistical analysis, regression analysis, …) and Artificial Intelligence (i.e. Data Mining, Machine Learning, …).
An appetite for Data Science applied to high-volumetry, low-latency topics.
Ability to read scientific articles, to analyze critically, and to implement as appropriate.
Good programming abilities.
You are very mindful about your application architecture, performance, testing and maintainability and its overall quality.
Requirements:
5+ years of hands-on experience with coding ML based solutions in high scale systems
Relevant industry experience / publications in ad-tech and recommender system
Msc/Phd in computer science / math
Industry experience in building engineering at scale
Large-scale distributed systems, service oriented architecture.
Previous experience with all or some of the elements of our Stack (we mainly use Go, Python, Java, AWS , Jupyter notebooks).
Knowledge in data engineering.
Ability to transform raw data into actionable business insights
Please submit your CV in English.
Life at Teads
At Teads, we don’t just offer new roles - we blend creativity, technology, and data to shape the future of media. You’ll work with smart humans, meaningful brands, and cool tools, all while helping redefine how advertising works in a world that demands more transparency, better insights, and smarter strategies.
As a Teadster, you’ll play a critical role in shaping our future success in the region. Here’s why Teads stands out:
We've merged two open internet category leaders—Outbrain and Teads—to create the ‘new’ Teads, a unified omnichannel platform that drives results from branding to performance across all screens, including CTV, mobile, and web.
As part of our team, you’ll thrive in a collaborative and forward-thinking environment that fosters innovation, creative problem-solving, and continuous learning.
Teads is committed to your success, offering the support, tools, and development opportunities you need to excel in your role.
Our company culture is welcoming, dynamic, diverse, global, and built on top performance.
Teads is an equal employment opportunity employer and committed to diversity and inclusion at all stages of recruitment and employment.
Our team is made up of individuals who are approachable, resourceful, passionate, and proactive. We foster a sense of belonging through our Employee Resource Groups – employee-led groups in which we debate topics and drive change: environmental, women empowerment, charitable initiatives to diversity, equity, and inclusion, you’ll be able to share your passions with likeminded people.

Strong builder’s mindset — balancing deep system thinking with practical, hands-on delivery.
10+ years of full stack system architecture and complex platform engineering experience.
Deep expertise designing distributed, composable, and extensible systems across frontend and backend environments.

Proven experience integrating and operationalizing AI-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor) into engineering workflows.
Experience building plugin frameworks, extension systems, or developer platforms that emphasize modularity and scalability.
Track record of defining and promoting engineering best practices — especially in the context of AI-driven development.
Demonstrated technical leadership — mentoring engineers, shaping architecture standards, and driving adoption of new paradigms.

Tripledot Studios.description:
Who are we?
Tripledot Studios is one of the largest independent mobile games companies in the world.
We are a multi-award-winning organisation, with a global 2,500+ strong team across 12 studios.
Our expanded portfolio includes some of the biggest titles in mobile gaming, collectively reaching top chart positions around the world and engaging over 25 million daily active users.
Tripledot’s guiding principle is that when people love what they do, what they do will be loved by others.
We’re building a company we’re proud of. One filled with driven, incredibly smart and detail-orientated people, who LOVE making games.
Our ambition is to be the most successful games company in the world, and we’re just getting started.
The role is working within our studio: Supersonic
Here's a boilerplate paragraph you can drop into any Supersonic ad:
Supersonic is one of the world's leading mobile game publishers, working with independent studios everywhere to turn promising ideas into games played by millions. Based in Tel Aviv and founded in 2020, the team has published more than 150 titles across the hybrid casual and casual space, backed by deep expertise in game analysis, monetisation and user acquisition. In August 2026 Supersonic joined Tripledot Studios.
Role Overview
We are looking for a seasoned, hands-on Head of Engineering to drive technical excellence and lead Supersonic’s core development teams at scale. Acting as both a technical authority and people leader, you will manage multidisciplinary teams responsible for publishing SDKs, advanced level-generation tools, client-facing cloud integrations and multiple games.
You will oversee engineering execution and workflows across a diverse portfolio, including three core SDKs, two backend systems and multiple in-house games, while continually improving production pipelines. This is a highly strategic role requiring deep expertise in Unity performance, tooling and cross-team communication to ensure our portfolio can scale seamlessly for millions of daily active users.
This role will suit a hands-on, action-oriented leader who communicates clearly, stays open-minded and can move comfortably between code, architecture, people leadership, product priorities and business needs. The position is based in Tel Aviv, with four days per week in the office and Sunday working from home.
Key Responsibilities
Manage, mentor and develop three multidisciplinary teams comprising developers, QA engineers, technical artists and game designers.
Own technical direction, architecture, maintenance and execution across three core SDKs, two backend systems and multiple in-house games.
Remain hands-on with Unity development, acting as the technical authority for complex problem-solving, architecture and code where needed.
Take ownership of product needs as well as technical delivery, translating priorities from engineering, product and monetization stakeholders into clear, actionable roadmaps.
Drive the architecture and development of internal tooling, including custom Unity Editor scripts and algorithmic or procedural level-generation systems that empower game designers across projects.
Define, implement and continually improve engineering workflows, automation and CI/CD pipelines to enable rapid, stable game builds across the portfolio.
Oversee cloud and backend integrations that power critical, data-driven client features, bridging technical work across client, infrastructure and server-side teams.
Lead Unity performance and optimization strategies across mobile devices, including memory management, CPU/GPU profiling, load times and frame rates.
Support scalable LiveOps and data-driven feature deployment, including remote configuration and A/B testing, while serving as the central technical leader across engineering, product and monetization teams.
Required Skills, Knowledge and Expertise
10+ years of professional software-development experience, with a dominant focus on Unity, C# and mobile game production.
Expert-level knowledge of Unity, including custom Editor scripting, AssetBundles or Addressables, and extending the Unity pipeline.
A strong track record of managing, mentoring and scaling multidisciplinary engineering teams in a fast-paced, agile environment.
Strong experience developing clean, modular and reusable SDKs or packages used across multiple projects or a broad game portfolio.
Deep mobile LiveOps experience, including remote configuration, A/B testing frameworks and data-driven feature deployment; experience in hyper-casual or hybrid-casual development is valuable.
Hands-on experience building complex content tools, including level-generation or algorithmic layout systems.
Experience integrating cloud services or proprietary game servers to support live client features; familiarity with platforms such as Firebase, AWS or GCP is valuable.
Experience configuring and overseeing CI/CD pipelines for mobile game development using tools such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions or Unity Build Automation.
Advanced Unity profiling and mobile optimization skills, including experience with Unity Profiler, Memory Profiler and Frame Debugger across low- and high-end devices.
Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to manage stakeholder expectations and lead effective cross-team workflows in English.

About the Role:
We're looking for a Product Manager to own the operational efficiency aspect of the platform end to end. This is both a strategy and an execution role: you'll decide what execution responsibilities the product would expand to and be in the details with engineering and design shipping it. The hard part isn't building a workflow - it's knowing which work a customer will genuinely hand to an agent, and what has to be true before they will.
What You'll Do:
Define human and agent interaction models: Shape how users collaborate with AI agents, from user initiated queries and agent driven outreach to seamless side by side execution.
Lead agentic ticket resolution and IAM automation : Own the end to end product strategy for identity tasks, including provisioning and deprovisioning, entitlement changes, plus joiner, mover, and leaver workflows.
Own the agentic execution layer: Spec the core product rails for executing actions in customer environments, including human approval flows, risk controls, and confidence building mechanisms.
Drive field to roadmap feedback loops: Partner closely with customer facing and POC teams to translate real world edge cases and customer insights into scalable roadmap features.
Requirements:
2+ years building or owning products where the deliverable is work getting done - workflow automation, ITSM, orchestration, ops tooling, RPA. Something with queues, approvals, handoffs, and a human on the other end who either trusts the system or works around it.
Experience with agentic AI or LLM-based system s - particularly human-in-the-loop design and how agents hold up their end of a conversation with a person
Enough security fluency to make access decisions responsibly, or the appetite to build it fast. You don't need years in the industry, but you'll be making calls about access and permissions and you can't be squeamish about the stakes.
You're comfortable in the details. You'll spec approval flows and escalation logic with engineering and design, define what "resolved" means precisely enough to measure, and write requirements precise enough to build from.
Nice to Have:
Background in IAM, IGA, or PAM - you know what an entitlement, a group, and a joiner-mover-leaver process actually are
Cybersecurity experience more broadly, in any function
Experience working with customer-facing or POC teams, turning field signal into roadmap
Intertwine your future with ours!
At Twine, we're dedicated to fast, informed decisions and transparent collaboration, tackling some of the cyber industry’s most complex challenges. With passion and expertise, we build AI digital cybersecurity employees like no other. Join us in addressing the evolving, unparalleled challenge of bridging the cyber execution gap.

About the Role:
You'll own technically difficult problems before the solution is known. Starting with a cybersecurity need, you'll study the domain, frame the technical challenge, investigate possible approaches, and build the solution through production. You'll have access to Twine's shared agent infrastructure, but the role goes far beyond configuring existing components. Many use cases will require new reasoning methods, agent architectures, evaluation techniques, data strategies, or model behavior. This is a role for someone who enjoys applied research but is motivated by outcomes. The goal is not simply to prove that an idea can work, it is to make it useful and reliable for customers.
What You'll Do:
Design and implement AI solutions for complex cybersecurity workflows.
Develop new approaches for agent reasoning, planning, tool use, context management, decision-making, and recovery from failures.
Determine the right technical approach for each problem, combining models, algorithms, data, and conventional software where appropriate.
Define quality for each use case and create evaluations that measure correctness, task completion, consistency, safety, latency, and cost.
Analyze agent behavior deeply, identify the underlying causes of failures, and improve the relevant model, data, tool, or architecture.
Collaborate with cybersecurity experts, product teams, software engineers, and AI infrastructure engineers throughout development.
Requirements:
Excellent software engineering skills and substantial experience with Python.
Hands-on experience building advanced systems with modern language models.
Deep familiarity with several areas relevant to AI agents, such as planning, tool use, retrieval, memory, structured generation, model adaptation, or evaluation.
The ability to turn an ambiguous problem into a technical research plan and then into working software.
Strong experimental instincts: you form clear hypotheses, design meaningful tests, and make decisions based on evidence.
Sound judgment about when to use an AI technique and when a deterministic approach is more effective.
Ownership of the complete result, including its behavior after reaching production.

Developing autonomous or long-running agents that interact with real systems.
Building evaluation environments, simulations, or benchmarks for complex model behavior.
Experience in cybersecurity, identity, security operations, or enterprise automation.
Applying published research or your own research to production problems.

Description
At UVeye, we’re on a mission to redefine vehicle safety and reliability on a global scale. Founded in 2016, we pioneered the world’s first fully automated suite of AI-powered vehicle inspection systems, combining computer vision, machine learning, and generative AI.
With over $380M in funding and strategic partnerships with Toyota, Amazon, General Motors, JLR, Volvo, and Hertz, our technology is deployed across manufacturing plants, dealerships, wholesale auctions, fleets, and seaports worldwide. Named one of Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies of 2026, our 300+ global employees are solutions-oriented, accountable, and driven by one shared goal: making roads safer for everyone.
We seek a Senior Full-Stack Engineer to join our R&D web team. In this role, you’ll work alongside top-tier developers to design, build, and deliver scalable, cloud-based solutions that power our core products. You’ll be deeply involved in all stages of development from ideation to deployment
A day in the life and how you’ll make an impact:
Creating and owning end-to-end features for various web projects, leveraging microservice architecture, cloud functions, and API services
Maintaining and improving code quality and stability, with a focus on multi-tenancy security and user management systems
Leading cross-team technical design discussions on application architecture, UI components, UX, back-end and third-party integration, and testing
Leading and accompanying new products and features from prototype to production, utilizing mono repo architecture and event-sourcing principles
Working closely with customers to gather insights on how to improve the product
Participating in the design and development of cloud-based systems, using GCP cloud functions and Firebase
Ensuring the implementation of robust DRP data recovery systems and pain testing
Developing and maintaining multiple UI applications, using the latest Angular version (19), Flutter, Material Design, and Bootstrap
Requirements
5+ years of experience as a Backend/Frontend/Full Stack Developer
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related fields or equivalent experience
Development experience in Node.js
Experience with JavaScript frameworks such as Angular (Preferred), React, Vue.js, or similar
Familiarity with cloud infrastructure, including Google Cloud Platform (GCP)
Experience with microservice architecture, API services, and multi-tenancy security
Knowledge of event sourcing, big data processing, and mono repo architecture
Experience with Flutter, Ionic, or React Native – an advantage
Familiarity with Firebase, cloud functions, and API services – an advantage
Commitment to clean code and avoiding unnecessary testing
Familiarity with GitHub Copilot, Cloud, and Tropic
Why UVeye:
Pioneer Advanced Solutions: Harness cutting-edge technologies in AI, machine learning, and computer vision to revolutionize vehicle inspections.
Drive Global Impact: Your innovations will play a crucial role in enhancing automotive safety and reliability, impacting lives and businesses on an international scale.

About The Position
Upwind is a next-generation Cloud Security Platform that leverages runtime context to identify and prioritize critical risks, providing precise insights and efficient cloud security management. Unlike traditional tools, Upwind uses runtime data proactively for risk prioritization and posture insights, ensuring teams focus on what truly matters. With industry-leading efficiency and eBPF-powered sensors, Upwind delivers comprehensive capabilities, including agentless cloud posture discovery, real-time threat protection, and integrated API security. From misconfigurations to malware defense, Upwind ensures end-to-end, cost-effective cloud infrastructure protection. At Upwind, you’ll have the opportunity to think creatively, explore new ideas, and use your skills to make a meaningful impact on our growth.
We're looking for a Technical Account Manager to build strong, strategic relationships with customers and ensure successful onboarding, adoption, and long-term value from the Upwind platform. You'll serve as the main point of contact, guide technical deployments, lead roadmap discussions, and provide hands-on support to drive engagement and satisfaction.
Responsibilities
Act as a strategic partner to the sales team post-POC, supporting account continuity while enabling sales to focus on new opportunities
Oversee deployments in collaboration with Solutions Architects to ensure smooth and successful onboarding
Serve as the primary point of contact for customers, addressing issues quickly and maintaining a high-quality customer experience
Build strong, long-term relationships by introducing new features, gathering feedback, and leading roadmap discussions
Partner with sales during renewals and expansion to align technical planning with customer needs and drive value
Proactively engage with customers to surface key security insights, guide feature adoption, and ensure they realize the full value of the Upwind platform
Requirements
3+ years in customer-facing roles in SaaS, with experience in technical support, solution architecture, or similar roles
Strong technical background in cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, Azure), cybersecurity, or DevOps
Excellent communication, problem-solving, and relationship-building skills
Experience leading technical projects, managing deployments, and driving feature adoption
Strategic mindset with the ability to align technical solutions to business goals
Relevant certifications in cloud or security (preferred)

About The Position
Upwind is a next-generation Cloud Security Platform that leverages runtime context to identify and prioritize critical risks, providing precise insights and efficient cloud security management. Unlike traditional tools, Upwind uses runtime data proactively for risk prioritization and posture insights, ensuring teams focus on what truly matters. With industry-leading efficiency and eBPF-powered sensors, Upwind delivers comprehensive capabilities, including agentless cloud posture discovery, real-time threat protection, and integrated API security. From misconfigurations to malware defense, Upwind ensures end-to-end, cost-effective cloud infrastructure protection. At Upwind, you’ll have the opportunity to think creatively, explore new ideas, and use your skills to make a meaningful impact on our growth.
We are looking for a highly technical Infrastructure Team Lead to establish and lead a new Infrastructure team.
This is a hands-on technical leadership role focused on the scalability, performance, and reliability of the systems our product and engineering teams run on. You will design and evolve our core infrastructure: databases, messaging systems, and the services around them- to keep pace with a fast-growing, high-load, multi-tenant system, while building and leading the team responsible for it.
This is a leadership role for someone who stays close to the technology: setting technical direction, guiding architecture, getting hands-on with hard performance and scale problems, and working through complex production challenges alongside the team.
What You'll Do
Take ownership of our infrastructure's scalability, performance, and reliability — end to end, across a fast-growing, high-volume system
Build and lead a new infrastructure team, hiring and mentoring engineers as the team grows
Dive deep into architecture, databases (Aurora, OpenSearch, Redis), and system design to identify and resolve scale and performance bottlenecks
Work hands-on with messaging systems (Kafka, RabbitMQ) and database infrastructure to keep pace with increasing load
Consolidate infrastructure work under one team and bring structure and clear ownership to this core domain.
Operate independently — you'll be given real ownership and real problems to solve, and you're expected to drive solutions without needing constant guidance
Partner with engineering teams across the company, but as the clear owner of infrastructure decisions, not just an advisor
Requirements
5+ years of hands-on software development / architecture experience and at least 2 years as a team lead/ tech lead, you've built and designed real systems, not just directed others
A proven, demonstrable track record of driving significant performance improvements- measurable gains in efficiency, latency, or system load.
Strong understanding of databases, scalability challenges, and system architecture
Experience across more than one company/environment
A degree (any field, any institution)
Independent, self-driven working style- you take a problem and run with it
Experience with Java is a big plus
What Success Looks Like
You build a team that can independently carry infrastructure work
You can take a messy, high-pressure infrastructure problem and turn it into a solved, owned, well-architected system
You help strengthen company culture where scale and performance solutions are happening by design and planning, not reactively.
Leadership can hand you a hard problem and have strong confidence that you will be able to handle it end to end autonomously.

About The Position

We're in a period of significant growth. There's an enormous amount to build, improve, and shape - and every hire changes the trajectory of the company.
We're looking for a Growth Marketing Manager to conduct the entire growth orchestra: paid acquisition, landing pages, experimentation, SEO and LLM visibility, partners and vendors. You'll own the full funnel from first impression to qualified pipeline, and you'll own the number.

You'll report to the Head of Growth and work day-to-day with Content, Product Marketing, Design, Sales, and RevOps. It's an individual contributor role today with a clear path to building a team as the function scales.

Own paid acquisition end to end. Plan, launch, and optimize Google Ads and LinkedIn Ads - targeting, creative, bidding, budget allocation - against pipeline and CAC targets, not clicks. Open new channels as we grow.
Own the conversion path. Partner with Content Marketing and Design to build landing pages and campaign assets, then run a continuous A/B testing program on messaging, layout, offers, and forms to move conversion rate.
Run growth as an experiment engine. Build a testing roadmap, prioritize by expected impact, run clean experiments, and turn results into decisions the whole team can act on.
Own organic and AI visibility. Drive technical and content SEO alongside LLM citation optimization- making sure Upwind shows up when security engineers and CISOs ask AI assistants about cloud security.
Manage partners and vendors. Agencies, review sites, syndication, co-marketing, events - hold them to clear KPIs and make each one earn its budget.
Build the AI-native marketing stack. Use AI tools across research, creative production, analysis, and automation to compress cycle times and scale output without scaling headcount.

Work like a seller. Sit close to Sales, understand the buyer and the deal cycle, and optimize for pipeline quality - not lead volume.

Deeply analytical. You're fluent in funnel metrics, attribution, and experiment design. You build the model, find the insight in the data, and are comfortable defending it.
Conversion and experimentation experience. You've built and tested landing pages and know how to run an A/B test that produces a real answer.
SEO and LLM optimization know-how. You understand how organic discovery works today and are actively figuring out how it works in an AI-first world.
AI-native by default. You already use AI tools throughout your workflow and are relentless about finding new ways to work faster.
Sales instincts. You can pitch, negotiate with vendors, and think in terms of what closes deals - not what looks good in a report.
Full professional proficiency in English, written and verbal. You'll write copy that a US security buyer takes seriously.
A self-starter who ships. High motivation, fast learner, comfortable with ambiguity, and biased toward getting things done in a fast-moving startup.

Description
﻿About Us
At Utila, you’ll help build the modern, enterprise-grade platform that powers digital asset operations for more than 200 global institutions. Our technology secures $15B+ in monthly transaction volume and has protected over $100B to date, and we’re growing fast, backed by $50M in funding and a rapidly expanding customer base.
We work on mission-critical systems that demand innovation, precision, and deep technical expertise. If you’re excited by complex challenges, want to work with exceptionally strong teammates, and are looking to make a real impact on the future of financial technology, you’ll feel right at home here.
Join us, and help build something big.
Responsibilities
Utila is a truly product-led company. We define the strategy, decide what to build, and own the end-to-end user experience. As a Senior Product Manager, you will be responsible for multiple domains in our platform, requiring you to:
Outline Utila’s product direction : Define the roadmap based on market research, competitive analysis, and direct engagement with prospects and customers.
Own the problem space : Be the authority on who we are solving for, why it matters, and how Utila can best meet these needs.
Drive features through the entire product lifecycle : From ideation to launch, with continuous tracking and refinement.
Ensure organizational alignment : Keep the C-level, engineering, sales, customer success, and operations aligned on roadmap, priorities, and execution.
Define and evolve product requirements : Translate customer needs and pain points into clear, actionable requirements with a defined problem, usage, and user experience.
Deliver exceptional user experience : Partner with our UX team to create experiences that stand out as a Utila differentiator.
Requirements
Product Management Experience – 5+ years of hands-on experience with a proven track record of successfully delivering B2B SaaS enterprise-grade products from conception to launch.
Technical Acumen – Ability to go deep into complex technical flows spanning multiple endpoints and cloud architectures.
Interpersonal Skills – Excellent ability to collaborate seamlessly within cross-functional teams.
Communication Skills – Exceptional verbal and written skills, with a commitment to clarity and precision in describing use cases and features.
Domain Knowledge (Preferred) – Familiarity with the institutional digital asset space—including wallets, custody, compliance, or crypto infrastructure—is a strong advantage.
Education – BSc/MS in Computer Science, another engineering/technical degree, or equivalent military experience.
Why Join Us?
Utila is a place for innovators, problem-solvers, and leaders. You’ll be part of a fast-paced, ambitious environment where your contributions make a direct impact. If you're looking to grow your career while helping shape the future of secure virtual transactions, we’d love to hear from you.

Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with VAST engineering, product management, pre-sales, and professional services to elevate product features, escalate unresolved bugs, and advocate for customer-specific priorities.
Requirements
﻿Experience: 5+ years of experience in technical customer-facing roles (Customer Success, Technical Support, Cloud Engineering, or Post-Sales) working with complex cloud infrastructure, networking, or storage solutions.
Multi-Cloud Expertise: Extensive expertise with Cloud Service Providers (CSPs) like AWS, Azure, and GCP, covering instance management, operations, and the ability to quickly ramp up on any missing provider.
Cloud Networking & Security: Advanced understanding of cloud networking and security—specifically designing, deploying, and integrating cloud architectures with On-Premises systems (Hybrid Cloud).
Diagnostics Skills: Practical and demonstrable cloud networking diagnostic skills (VPC/VNet, subnets, route tables, security groups) and utilization of Linux OS utilities for client-to-cluster troubleshooting.
Scripting & Cloud CLIs: Highly skilled at creating and debugging Python scripts using cloud APIs/SDKs. Proficiency with cloud CLIs (AWS CLI/aws, Google Cloud CLI/gcloud, Azure CLI/az) and scripting (Python, Shell/Bash) for diagnostics and automation.
Linux Systems Administration: Advanced Linux systems administration experience (primarily Rocky Linux or similar Enterprise Linux distributions).
Containerization & Orchestration: Strong experience working with Docker and Kubernetes environments.
Infrastructure as Code: Practical, hands-on experience using Terraform and Ansible to deploy and manage cloud-native infrastructure.
Observability Stacks: Solid experience with observability stacks and infrastructure tools (such as Grafana and Prometheus).
Education: B.Sc. or MS in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience).
Travel & Availability: * Ability to travel around 20% of the time to support customer deployments and professional services.
Participation in a rotational weekend shift once every 8-12 weeks and occasional holiday coverage.

Veracyte, Inc..description:
At Veracyte, we offer exciting career opportunities for those interested in joining a pioneering team that is committed to transforming cancer care for patients across the globe. Working at Veracyte enables our employees to not only make a meaningful impact on the lives of patients, but to also learn and grow within a purpose driven environment. This is what we call the Veracyte way – it’s about how we work together, guided by our values, to give clinicians the insights they need to help patients make life-changing decisions.
Our Values:
We Seek A Better Way : We pursue bold ideas, embrace complexity, and keep pushing forward.
We Make It Happen : We act with urgency, deliver with excellence, and always find a way.
We Are Stronger Together : We engage with empathy, align around what's best for Veracyte, and celebrate as one team.
We Care Deeply : We show up with integrity, kindness, and respect for one another.
The Position
As a Senior Software Test Automation Engineer, you will help ensure the quality and reliability of software that supports cancer diagnostics and monitoring. This hands-on engineering role focuses on building scalable test automation frameworks, reusable tools, and automated test solutions that enable teams to deliver high-quality Software as a Medical Device (SaMD) product. You will partner across Software Engineering, Product, DevOps, Verification, and Quality teams to embed quality throughout the development lifecycle while helping accelerate innovation that positively impacts patients' lives.
Responsibilities
Design, develop, and maintain scalable test automation frameworks, libraries, tools, and reusable components using modern software engineering practices.
Develop and maintain automated tests for REST APIs, backend services, microservices, integrations, databases, business workflows, and end-to-end user scenarios.
Define and implement automation approaches spanning component , contract, integration, system, regression, and end-to-end testing.
Integrate automated testing and quality gates into CI/CD pipelines to provide rapid and actionable feedback.
Improve the reliability, maintainability, scalability, and diagnostic value of automated test suites.
Monitor and continuously improve test health by addressing flaky tests, unstable environments, coverage gaps, and execution inefficiencies.
Develop tooling and utilities for test data management, service virtualization, mocks, simulators, fixtures, and environment management.
Investigate automation and product issues across applications, APIs, databases, cloud services, containerized environments, integrations, and deployment pipelines.
Partner closely with software engineers to improve application testability and establish effective automated test strategies.
Create reusable frameworks, documentation, examples, and best practices that enable product teams to develop and maintain their own automated tests.
Participate in design and code reviews with a focus on quality, reliability, maintainability, and testability.
Establish and promote standards for automation architecture, reporting, diagnostics, and framework design.
Evaluate and implement emerging technologies, including AI-assisted capabilities, to enhance test automation efficiency and coverage.
Collaborate with Software Verification and Quality teams to support regulated verification activities and generate appropriate test evidence when required .
Perform exploratory or manual testing when it provides greater value or supports product risk assessment.
Who You Are
We are looking for someone who combines a strong software engineering foundation with a passion for quality, automation, and continuous improvement. You thrive in collaborative environments, enjoy solving complex technical challenges, and are motivated by developing software that can make a meaningful difference in patient care. We welcome candidates who may not meet every qualification listed below but believe they can make a strong contribution to our team. Supported by Veracyte's values of being stronger together, seeking a better way, caring deeply, and making it happen, you'll help drive both technical excellence and positive impact.
Required Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science , Software Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
6 – 7 years of experience in software quality engineering, software development, or test automation engineering.
5+ years of hands-on experience developing automation solutions using C#, Java, Python, TypeScript, or comparable programming languages.
Demonstrated experience designing, building, and maintaining test automation frameworks and reusable testing tools.
Proven experience testing enterprise-scale web applications, REST APIs, backend services, microservices, integrations, and cloud-native systems.
Strong software development skills, including object-oriented design, modular architectures , debugging, code reviews, version control, and automated quality practices.
Experience automating APIs, databases, distributed systems, and backend services.
Experience implementing automated testing within CI/CD platforms.
Hands-on experience testing cloud-native applications in containerized and cloud environments.
Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
Excellent written communication, collaboration, and technical documentation abilities.
Experience working effectively in Agile software development environments.
Preferred Qualifications
Strong experience developing automation frameworks within the .NET ecosystem.
Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and modern cloud-based testing environments.
Experience with contract testing, service virtualization, automated test data generation, mocks, and simulators.
Experience automating non-functional testing, including performance, resilience, reliability, and security testing.
Experience leveraging AI-assisted technologies for automation development, mainten

The successful candidate will provide support for analysis of large and complex data sets related to cancer and will bring specific domain knowledge and experience to empower research and development of our tools and products.
In collaboration with R&D and production team members, the Senior Scientist candidate will engineer high-quality tools for genomic sequence data analysis to develop new products or improve existing offerings, all while adhering to Veracyte’s state of the art software engineering methodologies. This entails working cross-functionally with data scientists, clinical analysts, software engineers, and business analysts to ensure our genomic data becomes a powerful asset and value growth driver. Specifically, the candidate will participate in the design and prototyping of processing pipelines and algorithms for data analysis to improve clinical performance and optimize critical systems. Analyze next-generation sequencing data ranging from single research experiments to very large data sets reaching correct conclusions based on rigorous mathematical analysis and principles of statistics and probability.
Research and develop novel deep & machine learning architectures, statistical algorithms and mathematical models for application in genomics within a Python-based infrastructure.
Lead the design and development of data specification standards and data science business processes
Collaborate effectively with R&D, production, and clinical teams to build pipelines for high-throughput sequencing data
Ensure internal processes and metrics are aligned to create the highest product quality and competitive advantage
Produce clear, concise and correct technical documentation including research reports and algorithm specifications
Generating ideas to improve existing technology and drive future technology

Master’s degree / PhD or Master’s degree with 3 years of relevant experience in engineering, computer science, bioinformatics, statistics, or similar, with a strong foundation in probability theory and/or statistics.

Expertise in scientific methods, processes, algorithms and systems for knowledge and insights extraction from data
Extensive knowledge in the domains of machine learning, signal processing and related quantitative techniques and theory
Proficient in Python, bash and scripting fundamentals, including file parsing and data visualization
Experience with cloud computing technologies (AWS preferred).
Experience with data management in a regulated environment - a plus
Key attributes
Independent self-management and organizational skills in setting and executing rapidly changing priorities.
Entrepreneurial, driven to create and to be impactful team player
Strong attention to detail demonstrating accuracy and consistency in tracking and reporting data
Eagerness to acquire new skills in areas such as databases, statistics, and genetics
Excellent verbal and written communication
Ability to evaluate and apply new technologies in a short time
#LI-Hybrid, or #LI-Remote

Pay range
$1 — $2 USD
What We Can Offer You
Veracyte is a growing company that offers significant career opportunities if you are curious, driven, patient-oriented and aspire to help us build a great company. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, and are committed to fostering an inclusive workforce, where diverse backgrounds are represented, engaged, and empowered to drive innovative ideas and decisions. We are thrilled to be recognized as a 2024 Certified™ Great Place to Work ® in both the US and Israel - a testament to our dynamic, inclusive, and inspiring workplace where passion meets purpose.
