Vessel Technologies, Inc..description:
Come Reinvent the Building
Most architects spend their careers designing buildings one at a time. At Vessel, we're doing something fundamentally different.
We believe the building itself can become a product: thoughtfully designed, relentlessly engineered, continuously improved, and produced with the precision and discipline we expect from the world's best consumer products.
Housing today is too expensive to build, too slow to produce, too complicated to operate, and too often disappointing to live in
We don't believe incremental improvements to the way buildings are constructed will solve that, so we're redesigning the building itself
Vessel brings together architecture, engineering, manufacturing, technology, and first-principles thinking to build an entirely new generation of multifamily buildings
We're backed by institutional partners including Lennar, America's largest homebuilder, and our buildings are already home to residents in the United States
Now we're looking for an exceptional architect to help us design what comes next.
This Is Not a Traditional Architecture Job
At Vessel, our architects are much closer to industrial designers than traditional project architects. You'll work on a product, not a single building.
You won't design a building, document it, hand it over, and start again
You'll study how people actually live in Vessel buildings, and visit completed ones to see what we got right and what we didn't
You'll rethink a kitchen because residents use it differently than we imagined
You'll investigate new materials that could make a home better, simpler, or more durable
You'll prototype ideas with engineers and challenge assumptions that have existed in architecture for decades
Then you'll make the product better. Again and again.
The work is fast, hands-on, and crosses traditional professional boundaries. Because we're still building both our products and the company itself, an exceptional person can have an outsized impact very quickly.
If what you want is a conventional career at an architecture firm, this probably isn't the job. If you want to help invent a new way of creating buildings, it might be.
What You'll Work On
Design the Product
Help shape the architectural design of Vessel's products, from how a resident moves through an apartment to layouts, circulation, accessibility, materials, fixtures, and finishes
Design for repeatability: instead of asking “what works for this project,” you'll learn to ask “what is the best solution, and how do we make it work thousands of times?”
Understand the Resident
Spend time in Vessel buildings, observe how residents actually live, and listen to feedback
Study what works and what doesn't, and turn those observations into product improvements
Be as interested in people and behavior as you are in drawings
Experiment
Research new materials, components, fixtures, finishes, technologies, and spatial ideas
Develop concepts, prototype them with engineers, test them, and sometimes start over
Treat every experiment as a chance to learn something, whether or not the idea works
Make Calypso Better
Help develop successive generations of Calypso, Vessel's current multifamily building platform, incorporating lessons from residents, manufacturing, construction, operations, and engineering
Help decide what belongs in the standard product, what should become an option, and what shouldn't be done at all
Help Invent What Comes Next
Explore new Vessel products, configurations, and ways of living, beyond Calypso
Contribute ideas that could become the products Vessel is building a decade from now
Design With Engineering, Not Around It
Work side-by-side with Vessel's mechanical engineers, where architecture owns what the product should be and engineering owns how it gets built
Care about manufacturability, assembly, tolerances, interfaces, cost, durability, maintenance, and repeatability, not just appearance
Understand the Rules Well Enough to Challenge Assumptions
Develop a strong understanding of the U.S. building codes that affect our products, including accessibility, egress, and fire and life safety
Work with our technical architecture team to build code requirements into the product from the beginning, not discover them at the end
Learn to tell the difference between “how buildings are normally done” and “what the code actually requires”
See Your Work Become Real
Travel periodically to Vessel projects in the United States
Walk buildings you helped design, watch them being assembled, and talk with the people building and operating them
Bring what you learn back to Tel Aviv and make the next one better
Who We're Looking For
We're less interested in checking every box than in finding an unusually talented person with the right way of thinking. You probably have around 5–8 years of professional experience in architecture, industrial design, product design, or a closely related discipline.
More importantly, you:
Are intensely curious
Are a systems thinker
Care deeply about how people experience the things you design
Like getting into the details
Enjoy research and experimentation
Are comfortable questioning assumptions
Want to understand how things are actually made
Are excited by working directly with engineers
Are comfortable moving quickly and figuring things out as you go
Have high standards but don't need a large organization or elaborate process around you to do great work
Want responsibility, not simply assignments
Also:
Working knowledge of Revit and fluent written and spoken English
Experience with SolidWorks, interiors, prefabrication, DFMA, manufacturing, modular construction, or productized building systems is useful, but less important than intelligence, curiosity, taste, and the ability to learn quickly
A U.S. architecture license is a plus, not a requirement
Why Vessel
There aren't many opportunities in an architect's career to help create an entirely new category of building. This is one of them.
Join a small, multidisciplinary tea

Description
We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our growing Data Infrastructure team!
The team's main responsibility is developing Voyantis' data platform - from building the microservices and pipelines that onboard customer data into our platform, to the infrastructure and tooling that enables our internal data teams to analyze, transform, process, and collect data independently. Our goal is to build leverage: every feature we ship reduces friction for the teams that depend on our platform. We're looking for a builder who takes full ownership from inception to production, cares deeply about quality and performance, and leverages AI tools to move faster and deliver better outcomes.
About Us
Voyantis was founded in 2020 on the premise that market fundamentals are shifting companies worldwide from growth-at-all-costs strategies to efficient and responsible growth practices, with a focus on improving Unit Economics. With a bold mission to leverage AI to reimagine the whole Growth process, to streamline this transition and ensure its sustainability, Voyantis eliminates the guesswork from customer value creation, empowering leaders with actionable strategies and tactics to acquire, nurture and retain the high-value customers their businesses really need, with the actions and the timing that would be most impactful to achieve their goals.
Leading companies like Miro, Rappi and Moneylion rely on Voyantis to effectively apply these predictions. They use Voyantis to drive high-value customer acquisition on platforms like Google and Meta, optimize incentives through Salesforce and Braze, and perfectly time upsells, resulting in a 20%-40% ROI uplift.
Voyantis is well-backed by top VCs such as Target Global and SquarePeg. The company has tripled in size annually over the past two years and now boasts a team of 100 with offices in California, New York and Tel Aviv.
Responsibilities
Design and implement scalable, production-grade data pipelines and microservices that ingest, transform, and move data from a wide variety of customer sources at high volume.
Build and maintain high-performance backend services and APIs that interface with our data ecosystem, ensuring reliability, low latency, and security.
Develop and evolve the platform infrastructure — data warehouse, orchestration, compute — that internal data teams rely on daily.
Identify opportunities to automate recurring workflows and turn ad-hoc needs into robust, self-serve platform capabilities.
Collaborate with data scientists, analysts, and engineers across R&D to translate requirements into platform features.
Drive code quality through design reviews, code reviews, and adherence to engineering best practices.
Leverage AI tools throughout the full engineering cycle — from scoping and design to implementation and debugging — to deliver faster, higher-quality outcomes.
Requirements
5+ years building production backend services in Python / Go / Node
Strong software engineering fundamentals — design patterns, testing, CI/CD, microservices architecture
﻿ Experience designing and operating distributed systems in cloud environments (AWS)
Deep understanding of data — modeling, pipelines, ETL/ELT processes, and query optimization.
Experience with modern data warehouses such as Snowflake / Databricks and orchestration tools such as Airflow / dbt.
Strong SQL skills and experience working with large-scale datasets.
Proven ability to take ownership end-to-end: from gathering requirements and designing solutions to deployment and production support.
Hands-on experience using AI coding tools (Cursor, Claude Code, or similar) as a core part of the engineering workflow.
Proactive by nature with a strong sense of ownership and internal drive for excellence.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills; high English proficiency.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience.

A defining part of this role is your partnership with Operations. Today, a lot of what makes Acquire work is carried by our Operations team working alongside our AI engine. Wayve.description:
The Role
We are looking for an ADAS Feature Engineer to help build the application-layer software that connects Wayve’s AI capabilities to real vehicle behaviour. This role sits at the intersection of AI, vehicle systems, active safety, and product delivery: you will develop C++ feature logic, validation tools, and system behaviours that allow AI-native driving technology to operate robustly in real-world vehicle environments. You will work closely with machine learning, product, vehicle integration, and systems teams to turn model outputs and vehicle data into reliable, testable, and customer-relevant ADAS features.
Key Responsibilities:
Design, implement, and maintain C++ application software for ADAS and active-safety-related vehicle features.
Build feature-level logic on top of AI / ML outputs, including validation, feasibility checks, state machines, fallback behaviours, and safety-aware decision logic.
Work with ML engineers to understand model outputs, limitations, failure modes, and how these translate into vehicle behaviour.
Use logs, simulation, replay, and vehicle testing to debug, tune, and validate feature behaviour.
Define and improve metrics, test cases, and validation strategies for ADAS feature performance, robustness, and quality.
Collaborate with product, systems, vehicle integration, and OEM-facing teams to translate requirements and real-world constraints into engineering solutions.
Support field testing and iterative development, including investigation of vehicle issues, edge cases, and performance gaps.
Contribute to software architecture, code quality, tooling, and engineering practices for feature development.
About you
In order to set you up for success as an ADAS Feature Engineer at Wayve, we’re looking for the following skills and experience:
Essential
Strong C++ software engineering experience, ideally in production or safety-relevant systems.
Hands-on experience in ADAS, autonomous driving, robotics, vehicle software, active safety, or closely related domains.
Practical understanding of vehicle feature development, including real-world testing, simulation, replay, logs, or prototype vehicle debugging.
Ability to reason about vehicle behaviour, sensor/model inputs, timing, failure modes, and feature-level decision logic.
Experience working cross-functionally with teams such as ML, perception, planning, controls, vehicle integration, product, or systems engineering.
Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to make pragmatic engineering trade-offs under ambiguity.
A quality mindset, with experience writing testable, maintainable software and using data to validate behaviour.
Desirable
Experience with ADAS features such as AEB, ISA, AES, ACC, lane keeping, collision avoidance, trajectory validation, or active safety systems.
Experience at an automotive OEM, Tier 1 supplier, autonomous driving company, robotics company, or vehicle technology startup.
Familiarity with ML or AI-based autonomy systems, including how model outputs are consumed by downstream software.
Experience with ROS, Linux, Bazel, CMake, Docker, QNX, protobuf, MCAP, CAN, calibration, or vehicle logging systems.
Experience with vehicle test tracks, public-road testing, HIL/SIL, scenario-based testing, or NCAP-style validation.
Familiarity with tools used in automotive development and testing, such as CANoe, Vector tools, MicroAutoBox, or similar.
This is a full-time role based in our office in Leonberg. At Wayve we want the best of all worlds so we operate a hybrid working policy that combines time together in our offices and workshops to fuel innovation, culture, relationships and learning, and time spent working from home. We operate core working hours so you can determine the schedule that works best for you and your team.
#LI-KM1

We understand that everyone has a unique set of skills and experiences and that not everyone will meet all of the requirements listed above. If you’re passionate about self-driving cars and think you have what it takes to make a positive impact on the world, we encourage you to apply.

Wayve.description:
The role
We’re seeking an exceptional Application SW Engineer to join our Japan-based within the Application Software team, focused on localising and advancing Wayve’s autonomous driving technology for the Japanese market. This is a unique opportunity to play a hands-on role in shaping our AV capabilities in Japan from the ground up.
In this role, you’ll be responsible for the bring-up and early validation of our AI software stack on customer hardware platforms, ensuring seamless performance across diverse SoCs and operating systems. You’ll collaborate closely with cross-functional teams across Verification, Release, and OEM partners to ensure smooth integration and reliable delivery.
Key responsibilities:
Execute software bring-up on customer hardware platforms (e.g. NVIDIA Drive, Qualcomm Ride).
Port and configure Linux-based systems, QNX, and Adaptive AUTOSAR environments.
Integrate and validate drivers, middleware, and boot-time configurations.
Collaborate with Verification & Release teams to integrate hardware into CI/CD, HIL, and test infrastructure.
Work with OEM and Tier 1 teams to resolve hardware-specific integration issues.
Implement system-level diagnostics, logging, and secure boot configuration.
Develop automation for setup, flashing, health checks, and test execution on target hardware.
About you
In order to set you up for success at Wayve, we’re looking for the following skills and experience.
8+ years of experience in embedded or automotive software development, ideally with hands-on platform bring-up experience.
Strong proficiency in C/C++, Bash, and Python.
Deep understanding of Linux-based embedded systems (Yocto, systemd, bootloaders, device trees).
Familiarity with QNX and Adaptive AUTOSAR environments and the ability to configure and debug them on target hardware.
Experience with bring-up on automotive-grade SoCs (e.g., NVIDIA Orin, Qualcomm SA8295/SA8650, Renesas, TI).
Comfortable working with hardware debuggers, flashing tools, serial consoles, and board support packages (BSPs).
Familiarity with communication protocols like CAN, Ethernet, PCIe, SPI, I2C.
Hands-on experience integrating embedded platforms into CI/CD pipelines and test automation frameworks.
Desired
Exposure to automotive verification environments (e.g., HIL systems, Vector toolchains, custom CI rigs).
Experience working in a safety-critical domain with an understanding of ISO 26262, boot-time determinism, and watchdogs.
Understanding of secure boot, OTA updates, and system-level cybersecurity topics.
Familiarity with Docker, Jenkins, Git, and artifact management tools like JFrog Artifactory.
This is a full-time role based in our office in Japan. At Wayve we want the best of all worlds so we operate a hybrid working policy that combines time together in our offices and workshops to fuel innovation, culture, relationships and learning, and time spent working from home.
We understand that everyone has a unique set of skills and experiences and that not everyone will meet all of the requirements listed above. If you’re passionate about self-driving cars and think you have what it takes to make a positive impact on the world, we encourage you to apply.

Wayve.description:
The role
As automotive system engineer, you will be responsible for designing the L2/L3 automotive grade system based on our AV2.0 approach. This includes the strategy and the concept of how to embed our fundamentally new autonomy solution in future OEM vehicle infrastructures. You will also engage with our customers and represent our approach and our company in the planning of collaboration projects.
You will grow with the company and be critical in establishing how we design our system closely with software engineering leads. Our stack includes base software for sensor data processing, neural network execution and diagnostics and robotic functions for vehicle control.
You will also act as a coach to others towards an automotive grade, requirement based development mindset to help teams deliver automotive grade software.
Key responsibilities:
Requirement Definition:
Define clear, actionable system requirements for assigned products, whether focused on L2+, L3 automated driving, or ADAS functionalities.
Collaborate with product managers, software developers, and hardware teams to ensure requirements align with customer and business needs.
Ensure traceability and alignment of requirements throughout the product lifecycle.
Data Driven Development:
Create comprehensive scenarios that the system must handle, ensuring it performs reliably in various real-world conditions. Support for selecting and creating such testing scenarios from data corpus and for ensuring that data-driven insights guide system development and testing processes.
Ensures that scenario definitions are validated and refined through collaboration with multiple teams, aligning with overall business and customer needs.
Support Implementation:
Work closely with software developers to align on data collection requirements, scenarios, KPIs and behaviour specifications
Work closely with the solutions and architecture teams to develop the system architecture based on the system requirements and customer constraints.
Oversee and support the integration of solutions into vehicles, ensuring seamless functionality and compatibility.
Hands-On Testing:
Actively test and validate systems in vehicles to gain direct experience and provide firsthand feedback.
Analyze performance in real-world scenarios, identifying strengths and areas for improvement.
Define test specifications at the system-level (working with the HIL team) and the vehicle-level integration.
Problem Resolution:
Serve as the first line of support for problem resolution, diagnosing and addressing system issues.
Collaborate across teams to escalate and resolve complex issues, ensuring timely solutions.
Continuous Improvement:
Provide input on process enhancements and system optimizations based on testing and user feedback.
Contribute to the continuous evolution of Wayve’s L2+/L3 and ADAS technologies.
About you
In order to set you up for success as a Systems Engineer at Wayve, we’re looking for the following skills and experience.
Essential
Experience:
5+ years of experience in system engineering, automotive development, or related fields.
Proven experience in defining and managing requirements for complex systems, preferably in ADAS or automated driving domains.
Proficiency in requirements management (e.g., Jama, DOORS) and system engineering tools (e.g., MATLAB/Simulink, Enterprise Architect)
Technical Skills:
Strong understanding of automotive systems, including sensors (cameras, radars, etc.), software integration, and vehicle dynamics.
Experience with system validation and troubleshooting in real-world conditions.
Soft Skills:
Excellent problem-solving skills, with the ability to diagnose and resolve issues effectively.
Strong communication and collaboration skills, with a proactive and hands-on approach.
A forward-thinking mindset and experience in implementing disruptive technologies using traditional automotive processes.
Education:
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Systems Engineering, Automotive Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.
Familiarity with automotive safety standards (e.g., ISO 26262, SOTIF) is a plus.
Desirable
Knowledge of AI and machine learning frameworks and experience with data and test driven development, incl. KPI generation and tracking
Experience with software development for automotive applications , including experience in C/C++ and/or Python .
Experience with system-level validation of AI components, including edge-case scenario testing and robustness assessment.
This role is a full-time role based in Sunnyvale, CA (hybrid) and the reasonably estimated salary for this role ranges from $209,700 to 311,400, plus a competitive equity package. Actual compensation is based on the candidate's skills, qualifications, and experience. ODD Characterization:

Behavioral Competency Mapping:
Build and maintain a taxonomy of behavioral competencies (e.g., merging, yielding, unprotected turns, interacting with pedestrians) required to safely operate in each ODD.
Quantify the complexity and frequency of each competency based on local traffic data, regulations, and real-world observations.

Recommend minimal data slices needed to support safe and predictable system performance in a new region.

Collaborate with safety and product on findings and proposals for behavioural improvement.
Cross-functional Collaboration:

Provide input to scenario library development, synthetic data generation, and test case prioritization.
Predictability & MTBF Guidance:

Provide guidance on what additional data is needed to reach MTBF targets in each ODD segment.

Wayve.description:
The role
As a Technical Program Manager for Robotaxi at Wayve, you'll own the programs that bring our robotaxi service to life - from vehicle and fleet readiness to on-the-ground launch and scaling in market. Based in Yokohama, you'll work across autonomy, vehicle software, hardware, operations, safety, and local partners to turn Wayve's AI Driver into a safe, reliable robotaxi service - keeping complex, multi-team, cross-geography delivery predictable in a fast-moving, ambiguous environment. You'll often bridge Wayve's global R&D with local delivery in Japan. As the only TPM on the ground in Japan, this is a generalist role: alongside robotaxi delivery, you'll help support local vehicle programs across hardware and software as needed.
Your impact will be measured by your ability to deliver programs, drive efficiency, manage risk, and align execution with business goals. A successful TPM is a force multiplier - helping teams move faster, more effectively, and with purpose.
Key responsibilities:
Drive program delivery: Own the lifecycle of robotaxi programs - from vehicle and fleet readiness to launch and in-market scaling - improving delivery through structured execution and coordination.
Manage dependencies & risk: Track and manage dependencies, risks, and trade-offs across autonomy, vehicle, operations, and safety - and escalate early with clear options.
Coordinate across functions & geographies: Keep engineering, fleet operations, safety, and local partner teams aligned - bridging Wayve's global R&D with local delivery in Japan.
Support launch & operations on the ground: Provide hands-on program support for robotaxi launch and in-market operations, on the ground in Yokohama.
Support local vehicle programs: As the only TPM in Japan, flex to support local vehicle hardware and software programs as needed.
Run delivery rhythms: Run planning, stand-ups, reviews, and retros that keep multi-team delivery predictable and reliable.
Keep stakeholders aligned: Communicate progress and risk to engineers, partners, and senior leaders, tailoring updates to each audience.
Champion continuous improvement: Improve tooling, processes, and ways of working, and share patterns across the TPM org
About you
In order to set you up for success as a Technical Program Manager for Robotaxi at Wayve, we're looking for the following skills and experience.
Essential
Bias for action: 5+ years leading complex, multi-team programs (or a strong record at this level). You lead high-complexity work across teams and get things done.
Technically strong across software and hardware: Credible with engineers across autonomy, vehicle software, and vehicle hardware; you reason about how the AI Driver runs as a robotaxi service on real vehicles - and can support vehicle hardware / software programs too - even though you won't write production code.
Stays neutral and adapts under pressure: Effective in ambiguous, safety-critical environments; you flex your style and bring structure without slowing delivery.
Strong project management: Skilled at planning, prioritising, and managing risk and dependencies across teams.
Exceptional communicator & collaborator: Operating from a remote office, you keep distributed teams aligned across time zones - communicating with clarity, proactively and in writing - and influence without authority across all stakeholders.
Cross-cultural & on the ground: Comfortable working across geographies and cultures, and hands-on with vehicles and operations in Japan; Japanese language skills a plus.
Generalist range: As the only TPM in-country, comfortable flexing beyond robotaxi to support vehicle hardware and software programs; happy wearing multiple hats.
Data-driven: Comfortable defining and using metrics to steer delivery and decisions.
Growth mindset: Open to feedback and always looking to improve.
Systems thinking: You reason about how the parts of a complex system fit together, and how a change in one area ripples into others.
Product-minded: You focus on outcomes and the people your programs serve - prioritising by impact and defining what good looks like, not just tracking activity.
Desirable
Robotaxi / AV operations, fleet, mobility, ride-hailing, or automotive experience; experience launching or scaling a service in market.
Exposure to ML, autonomy, or other compute-heavy / safety-critical domains; experience working across global and local teams. Japanese language skills and/or based in (or willing to relocate to) Yokohama / Tokyo.
An engineering or computer science degree, or experience working as an engineer.
This is a full-time role based in our office in Yokohama / Tokyo, Japan. At Wayve we want the best of all worlds, so we operate a hybrid working policy that combines time together in our offices and workshops to fuel innovation, culture, relationships and learning, with time spent working from home.
We understand that everyone has a unique set of skills and experiences and that not everyone will meet all of the requirements listed above. If you're passionate about self-driving cars and think you have what it takes to make a positive impact on the world, we encourage you to apply.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to drive complex investigations across multiple engineering disciplines

Experience with non-volatile memory or advanced memory technologies such as Flash, MRAM, PCM, ReRAM, or similar technologies

Our client is a pioneer in AI-powered voice technology and a dominant voice provider in Media & Entertainment. They partner with major global studios, streaming platforms, and media networks to break language barriers at scale, with our production-grade voice AI already powering content live across the world's largest platforms.
They are entering their next chapter of hyper-growth: expanding into real-time voice agents, enterprise APIs, and live multilingual broadcasting. Experience: 3+ years of hands-on product marketing experience within B2B SaaS, AI, deep-tech, or media technology environments.

Cross-Functional Partnership: Track record of close collaboration with Sales, Product, and external growth/creative agencies.

We are looking for a Data Solutions Team Lead to join our delivery teams and work closely with customers on real-world IoT deployments.

It's an execution-focused, individual contributor role, working closely with Sales and technical teams to drive presales engagements from first conversation through early customer adoption.

We are passionate about it and are looking for equally passionate team mates who can help us to move forward with new features, bug fixing and performance optimizations. For this particular role we are looking for an engineer with outstanding level of seniority and the interest for technical leadership, ready and capable of taking the ownership of the existing product source base and drive the design and implementation efforts for the new features and improvements both in control path written in Python and data path which resides in Linux kernel. Zenyard is building an AI-powered reverse engineering agent. As a Frontend Engineer, you’ll build high-signal interfaces for expert users, security researchers working inside complex binaries and large codebases.

Build UI for reverse engineering and research workflows

Experience building modern web applications
Strong JavaScript/TypeScript skills
Experience with React (or a similar framework)
Comfortable working with complex data and technical users
Good product taste: you can simplify without dumbing things down

Background in security, reverse engineering, or low-level systems
Strong UX intuition for power users (shortcuts, information density, latency sensitivity)

Zenyard.description:
Role Overview
Zenyard is building an AI-powered reverse engineering agent. As a Security Researcher, you’ll help shape how the system understands real-world binaries, by reversing complex targets, finding where automation breaks, and turning that insight into product capabilities.
This is a hands-on research role with direct product impact: your work will influence accuracy, explainability, and trust in the results we deliver to security teams.
What You’ll Do
Reverse engineer complex binaries and large real-world codebases
Analyze malware samples and vulnerability-relevant behavior (as needed)
Identify edge cases and failure modes in decompilers and reversing workflows
Work closely with engineering to translate findings into robust product features
Validate accuracy and explainability of analysis outputs across diverse targets
What You Bring
Strong background in reverse engineering or security research
Experience with low-level programmingDeep understanding of operating systems, binary formats and common executables format
Comfort working with decompiled code and imperfect signals: partial symbols, noisy decompilation, obfuscation, etc.
Ability to clearly communicate technical findings
Nice to Have
Experience with vulnerability research or malware analysis
Experience reversing high-level languages
Public work: blog posts, talks, or CTF participation

aspectiva.description:
Description
Senior UX Designer at Walmart Global Tech Israel
﻿
About us:
Walmart Global Tech’s presence in Israel has grown over the past few years with 4 acquisitions to date, all develop using industry leading technologies.
We are seeking a highly skilled and self-driven Senior UX Designer to join our Tel Aviv UX team.
The ideal candidate will have strong experience in User Experience (UX/UI) and understanding or User Research (UXR) , combined with strong UI and creative design skills , a deep understanding of research- and data-driven product goals , and the ability to take ownership of end-to-end UX processes .
This role requires a designer who can work in a structured and methodical way —defining problems clearly, grounding decisions in user research and data , and translating insights into clear, intuitive user flows and high-quality experiences , while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams.
Key Responsibilities:
Lead Core Product UX Design: Take full ownership of the user experience for Walmart Israel's digital products, shaping the design vision and transforming complex requirements into intuitive, highly functional digital solutions.
End-to-End Execution: Map comprehensive user journeys and structural workflows, seamlessly translating them into interactive prototypes and pixel-perfect, high-fidelity UI designs.
Research & Data-Driven Iteration: Conduct targeted user research (e.g., usability testing, user interviews) and leverage behavioral analytics to validate design hypotheses, pinpoint friction areas, and continuously optimize the product.
Cross-Functional Alignment: Act as the central design advocate, partnering closely with Product Managers and Engineers to balance user insights with technical feasibility and overarching business goals.
Requirements
UX Strategy, Research & Data
﻿Research & Synthesis Expertise: Demonstrated ability to conduct foundational and evaluative research (interviews, surveys) and distill findings into actionable artifacts like personas and Jobs-to-be-Done (JTBD).
Methodological Fluency: Deep understanding of Human-Centered Design principles, Double Diamond frameworks, and Information Architecture modeling.
Analytical Acumen: Strong capability to interpret behavioral data, A/B test results, and funnel metrics to ground design hypotheses in empirical evidence.
Design Execution & Collaboration
Craft & Tooling Mastery: Expert-level proficiency in Figma and Adobe CS, backed by a portfolio showcasing scalable design systems and meticulous attention to UI detail.
Collaborative Mindset: Proven track record of thriving in agile, cross-functional environments alongside technical and commercial teams.
Persuasive Communication: Excellent storytelling and presentation skills, with the ability to confidently defend design choices to leadership using structured rationale and data.
Nice to Have – AI Mindset:
Interest in how AI is shaping user experience and product design
Ability to integrate AI thinking into discovery, ideation, and UX flows
Awareness of user trust, transparency, and limitations in AI-driven experiences
Experience designing AI-driven or data-informed experiences is a plus
Additional Requirements:
Strong English communication skills
Hebrew – required

Description
Walmart Global Tech's presence in Israel has grown over the past few years through 4 acquisitions to date , and this team sits at the core of Walmart's e-commerce platform — the largest retailer in the world .
You'll join an AI Platform team that applies advanced Data Science, NLP, ML, and LLM-based capabilities to infer deep product insights.
Your Mission:
﻿
You bridge complex technical infrastructure and data-science-driven capabilities, turning diverse requests from product teams into a unified, scalable platform roadmap. This is a high-visibility role requiring strong execution and the ability to align engineering, data science, and global stakeholders.
﻿Responsibilities:
﻿Platform Roadmap: Turn diverse requests from product teams into a unified, scalable platform roadmap — prioritized by business impact and scalability.
Cross-Functional Execution: Partner with Data Science, Engineering, and Product teams to resolve dependencies and ship reliably at scale.
Global Collaboration: Work seamlessly with Israel-based and US/global teams, bridging timezones and working styles.
Requirements
2–4 years of PM or Technical PM experience in backend, platform, API, or data-driven environments.
Strong ability to abstract specific feature requests into generalized, reusable platform capabilities.
A B.Sc. in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical/quantitative field — or meaningful equivalent experience.
Deep comfort with technical systems: REST APIs, databases, ETL pipelines, and high-scale data infrastructure. Strong conceptual grasp across the stack (Kafka, NoSQL, BigQuery, agentic/MCP platforms, and similar).
Bias for action — extremely organized, execution-focused, and eager to move fast in ambiguity.
Professional working proficiency in English (spoken and written) — fluent enough to own async communication, lead cross-timezone meetings, and write precise technical specs with a global team.
Advantages & Nice-to-Haves
B2C e-commerce or consumer product background — consumer intuition helps prioritize the right platform signals.
Hands-on experience working alongside Data Science on model evaluations or quality frameworks.
Who Thrives Here
We especially appreciate people who...
Are genuinely excited by the challenge of building infrastructure that scales to hundreds of millions of shoppers — even when the work itself is invisible to them.
Learn fast, share ideas openly, and give honest feedback.
Have a can-do attitude and thrive in ambiguous, fast-moving environments.
Think in systems — connecting a single technical decision to its impact across every team and surface it touches.
Not sure you fit all the criteria? Apply anyway — let us decide.

aspectiva.description:
Description
This is a temporary position covering a maternity leave, for a period of six months
Walmart Global Tech’s presence in Israel has grown over the past few years with 4 acquisitions to date. The team is an integral part of the core of Walmart’s e-commerce platform – the largest retailer in the world. In Aspectiva, the first acquisition in this site, we build state-of-the-art NLP solutions that enable millions of Walmart shoppers to make smarter and more confident buying decisions.
We are looking for an Associate AI Product Manager (entry-level position) to join our team for a 6-month contract (backfill). This is an opportunity for a highly-capable entry-level individual to gain valuable industry experience, as part of a team of strong product professionals.
You'll work at the intersection of Data Science, e-commerce, and data platforms – owning capabilities that directly shape how millions of customers discover and buy products. You’ll own real product problems, and work across Walmart's e-commerce organization.
The ideal candidate will have strong analytical and technical foundations – from a quantitative, engineering, or CS background – combined with hands-on experience working alongside data science or ML teams, strong intuitions on how to define quality criteria and drive model improvements, and the ability to take full ownership of a technical backlog and deliver results independently.
﻿Responsibilities:
﻿ Own, deeply understand, and execute plans for improving NLP / DS models and capabilities across various domains and customer needs; from prioritizing improvement iterations, through defining quality criteria, to collaborating with DS and Engineering on delivery.
Define evaluation frameworks: Establish quality dimensions, create labelling guidelines and examples, and work with quality and data science teams to build automated evaluation pipelines.
Own and drive a prioritized backlog of improvements to platform capabilities; understand the domain in-depth, gather feedback and faults (incl. customer analytics), and apply methodical reasoning to assess best prioritization within a given capacity.
Collaborate with data science and ML engineers as well as with global product teams, to translate product problems into model improvements; challenge assumptions, evaluate trade-offs, and drive measurable outcomes.
Manage multiple concurrent workstreams across a global, cross-timezone team.
Requirements
1-2 years of Product Management experience in a data-centric or platform-focused role – or proven equivalent analytical/technical background with clear PM-relevant responsibilities.
Strong technical foundation – degree in Computer Science, Data Science, a highly related scientific field
Passion for, and deep understanding of ML and NLP concepts, techniques, and models.
Experience engaging directly with data science or ML functions, feeling comfortable in technical discussions and in meaningfully challenging DS choices.
Strong analytical skills – comfortable with data, metrics, and quality evaluation; able to define what "good" looks like and how to measure it.
Strong written and spoken English; able to communicate complex ideas clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Ability to work independently and drive progress.
Advantage: experience managing B2C products and features.
Advantage: experience working with teams across different time zones and geographies.
We especially appreciate people who...
• Are genuinely excited by the problems AI can solve for shoppers.
• Learn fast, share ideas openly, and give honest feedback.
• Have a can-do attitude and thrive in ambiguous, fast-moving environments.
• Think customer-first, connect technical outputs to real shopper value and impact.
Not sure you fit all the criteria? Apply anyway — let us decide.

About the Role
We are seeking a world-class, highly analytical, and business-driven FP&A Manager (Individual Contributor) to join our finance team, reporting directly to the CFO and to partner directly with our executive leadership team. This is a high-visibility, super-strategic role designed for a heavy-hitter who thrives on complete autonomy and possesses exceptional financial and analytical capabilities.
This is a rare hybrid role: we need a high-level strategic thinker who is equally thrilled to roll up their sleeves, dive into the raw data, and build complex models from scratch (100% hands-on). You will act as an internal strategic consultant, embedded deeply with our commercial leaders to dissect funnels, optimize sales efficiency, and deliver actionable insights that shape our growth trajectory.
Responsibilities
· Executive & Board Partnership : Serve as the primary finance partner to the executive team. Lead the creation of high-impact financial narratives, investor relations materials, and strategic presentations for Board of Directors meetings and fundraising initiatives.
· Go-To-Market & Revenue Analytics : Partner closely with Marketing and RevOps to analyze full-funnel metrics, pipeline health, Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC) efficiency, and net dependency/churn trends.
· SaaS Unit Economics & Pricing: Own the financial analysis of SaaS unit economics, Lifetime Value (LTV), Lifetime Value to CAC ratios, and provide strategic deal-desk financial support to optimize contract margins and pricing structures.
· Next-Gen Financial Intelligence: Architect, own, and scale the company’s complex forecasting models, budget-vs-actual (BVA) frameworks, and rolling forecasts.
· AI & Automation Architecture: Lead the implementation of an AI-first approach to financial planning. Build and maintain advanced dashboards using BI and AI-powered platforms to maximize automated reporting and predictive analytics, eliminating traditional manual workflows.
· Operational Efficiency: Proactively identify margin expansion opportunities and cost-efficiency initiatives through rigorous benchmarking, gross margin analysis, and operational deep-dives.
Requirements
· Experience: 6+ years of progressive FP&A or corporate finance experience, with a proven track record in hyper-growth SaaS companies or leading tech ecosystems known for rigorous, data-driven cultures.
· Seniority & Executive Presence: Director-level business acumen with the confidence, articulation, and corporate storytelling skills required to influence senior executives, institutional investors, and the Chairman.
· GTM Expertise: Deep, hands-on experience working alongside Go-To-Market teams, sales funnels, and modern Revenue Operations frameworks.
· 100% Hands-On Autonomy: Proven capability to operate as a sole contributor—capable of executing complex projects and models independently without relying on a large team for execution.
· Tech & AI Native: Exceptional proficiency with advanced financial modeling and BI tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, Looker). Active mastery or deep eagerness to integrate generative AI and automation workflows into daily finance operations.
· Language: Complete fluency in English (both written and verbal) is an absolute requirement.
Education & Qualifications
· Bachelor’s degree in a highly quantitative or business field.
· MBA, CPA, or advanced analytical degree is a strong advantage, but proven "battle-tested" analytical brilliance in a top-tier tech company is valued above all.

At lakeFS, we’re closing the infrastructure gap in data and AI by enabling teams to manage data like code, unlocking new capabilities for AI and data engineers, building resilient pipelines for AI platforms, machine learning, business intelligence, and other advanced data use cases. lakeFS is used by AI/MLOps teams, data engineers, and data scientists at thousands of organizations worldwide, from nimble startups to Fortune 500 giants, including Arm, Bosch, Lockheed Martin, NASA, Volvo, and the U.S. Department of Energy. About the role We are looking for a Director of Product Management to lead product strategy and execution for lakeFS as we expand our role in the modern data, AI, and infrastructure ecosystem. You will help lakeFS focus on the highest-impact opportunities, sharpen the product’s value proposition, and deliver capabilities that make customers more successful with data and AI infrastructure. tailormed.description:
The Role
At TailorMed , we’re on a mission to eliminate barriers across the entire medication journey—from affordability to access and adherence. As a pioneering force in healthcare, we’re building a new category that transforms how patients, providers, pharmacies, life sciences, and payers collaborate to ensure every patient receives the treatment they need without delay.
TailorMed is the medication success platform removing every barrier across the patient journey, from access and affordability through adherence and ongoing care. Our connected network spans 945+ hospitals, 4,700+ clinics, 3,100+ pharmacies, 100+ life sciences programs with a reach of 75 million patients and has secured more than $7.4 billion in financial assistance since 2020 tapping into an asset of 6000+ support programs.
As Sourcing Partner, you’ll own the top of the funnel for TailorMed’s hiring in the US — building pipeline for sales, customer success, operations and marketing roles across all levels. This is a high-impact, high-visibility role with a direct line to leadership, where the people you bring in will shape the direction of the company.
You’ll work closely with our recruiters and hiring managers to understand exactly what ‘great’ looks like for each role, build targeted sourcing strategies, and consistently deliver qualified, engaged candidates into the pipeline..
What You’ll Do
• Build and execute targeted sourcing strategies for GTM and Ops roles
• Identify and engage passive candidates in order to impact top of funnel and candidate pipeline
• Partner closely with recruiters and hiring managers to understand role requirements, ideal candidate profiles, and what makes each role compelling
• Maintain a strong and organised pipeline in our ATS, ensuring accurate tracking and timely communication with candidates
• Contribute to employer branding efforts — helping TailorMed show up in the right communities and in front of the right talent
• Continuously refine sourcing approaches based on data — tracking outreach rates, response rates, and pipeline conversion
• Stay close to the talent market — understanding where great people are, what they care about, and how to reach them
What We’re Looking For
• 3–5 years of sourcing or recruiting experience, with a strong focus on GTM roles (sales, CS, marketing)
• Experience working in digital health B2B SaaS is required. Experiences working for companies in areas such as patient support services, specialty pharmacy, care coordination, or financial assistance platforms is a strong advantage.
• Proven track record of building pipeline for hard-to-fill roles through proactive, creative sourcing
• Strong written communication skills — you write outreach that people actually respond to
• Experience with LinkedIn Recruiter and ATS platforms;
• Data-driven mindset — you track what’s working, iterate quickly, and can speak to your pipeline metrics
• Genuinely curious about people — you enjoy the detective work of finding the right person and making a compelling case for why they should talk to us
• Comfortable working in a fast-moving, high-growth environment where things change and priorities shift
Why TailorMed
• Work that matters — every hire you make contributes to a platform that helps patients access care they couldn’t otherwise afford
• A talent function that has a real seat at the table — sourcing is treated as a strategic capability, not a support function
• A high-growth environment where your impact is visible and your scope can grow with you
• A team that is ambitious, collaborative, and genuinely invested in doing things well
• Competitive compensation, benefits, and the flexibility of a fully remote role
We’re not looking for people who want a job. We’re looking for the ones who can’t help but build. If you’re energised by the challenge of finding exceptional people and motivated by work that has real impact, we’d love to hear from you.
TailorMed is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. TailorMed prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type and affords equal employment opportunities to employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, age, national origin, disability status, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.
Due to the sensitive nature of the data that TailorMed handles, finalist candidates must complete a successful background and reference check.
Requirements
Apply for this position

vetric.description:
Description
What is Vetric?
Vetric builds large-scale public data infrastructure.
We provide data pipelines that collect, structure, and deliver high-volume public web data for mission-critical companies operating in cybersecurity, public safety and digital risk protection.
Our systems power platforms that detect bad actors, uncover impersonation and fraud, identify coordinated manipulation, and help public safety organizations respond faster to real-world risks.
We don’t build dashboards, and we don’t sell surface-level insights.
We build stable, production-grade data flows that become part of our customers’ core products, with the real impact of saving lives or huge known organizations from bad actors.
Operating globally, we serve industry leaders across more than 20 countries who rely on us for scale, reliability, and depth.
﻿
Why Vetric?
Vetric is profitable from day one (fully bootstrapped - we haven’t raised external funding), and we’re building foundational technology - not chasing trends. Because this is infrastructure that matters, we operate with engineering discipline, strong ownership, and long-term thinking.
We’re at a true inflection point: the team is now large enough to require real infrastructure, yet still small enough that what you build will define how things work for the next several years.
This is infrastructure that matters and so is how we operate internally. You’ll be working with a sharp, focused team that takes engineering discipline seriously and is intentionally building an organization that matches the quality of its product.
Position Overview
We’re looking for an Account Manager to own and grow relationships with Vetric’s existing customers and become a trusted partner in their long-term success.
As an Account Manager, you’ll be responsible for a portfolio of strategic accounts, building strong relationships with key stakeholders, understanding how our customers use Vetric’s data infrastructure, and identifying opportunities to deepen and expand our partnerships. You’ll combine strong relationship management with a commercial mindset - ensuring customers see continued value while driving retention, renewals, and account growth.
This role is ideal for someone who is proactive, customer-oriented, and commercially driven, with the ability to build trust, uncover opportunities, and navigate relationships across both business and technical stakeholders.
Key Responsibilities:
Own and manage a portfolio of existing customers, serving as their primary commercial point of contact throughout the relationship.
Build strong, trusted relationships with key stakeholders and develop a deep understanding of each customer’s business, needs, and strategic priorities.
Drive customer retention and renewals by proactively managing account health, identifying risks, and ensuring customers continue to see strong value from Vetric.
Identify and execute expansion opportunities within existing accounts, including upsell and cross-sell opportunities.
Develop account plans and growth strategies for key customers, identifying new use cases, teams, and opportunities to expand the partnership.
Lead commercial conversations, including renewals, pricing discussions, negotiations, and contract expansions.
Work closely with Customer Success, Solutions Engineering, Product, and other internal teams to ensure a seamless customer experience and address customer needs.
Maintain accurate account information, opportunities, forecasts, and activities in the CRM.
Consistently meet or exceed retention, renewal, and expansion targets and KPIs.
Requirements
3+ years of experience in Account Management, Customer Success with commercial ownership, or a similar customer-facing role within a SaaS company.
Proven experience managing and growing mid-size and enterprise accounts.
Strong commercial mindset with demonstrated experience in renewals, upselling, cross-selling, and account expansion.
Excellent relationship-building skills and the ability to develop trusted relationships with senior stakeholders.
Exceptional communication, negotiation, and presentation skills.
Ability to understand technical products and translate customer needs into meaningful business opportunities.
Highly proactive and organized, with a strong sense of ownership and the ability to manage multiple accounts and priorities independently.
Experience with CRM platforms and account management tools.
Fluent English, with native-level proficiency preferred.
We’d be lucky if you had:
Experience working with data infrastructure, APIs, cybersecurity, public safety, or digital risk protection solutions.
Experience managing global enterprise customers, particularly in the US market.
Experience working with technical stakeholders and complex, mission-critical products.
B.A. degree in a relevant field.
We hire people, not just skills. We encourage you to apply if you think this role is a great fit for you, even if you don’t meet 100% of the requirements.

Description
What is Vetric?
Vetric builds large-scale public data infrastructure.
We provide data pipelines that collect, structure, and deliver high-volume public web data for mission-critical companies operating in cybersecurity, public safety and digital risk protection.
Our systems power platforms that detect bad actors, uncover impersonation and fraud, identify coordinated manipulation, and help public safety organizations respond faster to real-world risks.
We don’t build dashboards, and we don’t sell surface-level insights.
We build stable, production-grade data flows that become part of our customers’ core products, with the real impact of saving lives or huge known organizations from bad actors.
Operating globally, we serve industry leaders across more than 20 countries who rely on us for scale, reliability, and depth.
﻿Why Vetric?
Vetric is profitable from day 1 (fully bootstrapped - means we didn’t raise any money), a fast-growing company building foundational technology - not chasing trends.
Because this is infrastructure that matters, it requires engineering discipline, ownership, and long-term thinking.
As part of our broader R&D expansion, we’re building Kraków into a key engineering hub that will own core systems and drive our next phase of innovation and growth.
﻿ The Role & The Challenge
We are seeking a DevOps Engineer, at the mid or senior level, to join our infrastructure team, reporting directly to our DevOps Team Leader. Depending on experience, this role will either contribute to or help drive advanced infrastructure initiatives — from system design through production hardening — as we raise the bar for operational excellence across the company.
The immediate challenge: Vetric operates a high-volume, multi-account AWS environment. You will help solve complex delivery, scaling, and operational problems along the way. Scope and ownership will be calibrated to your experience level.
Responsibilities
Contribute to Cloud & Migration Strategy: Work alongside our DevOps Team Leader to help plan and execute our migration from ECS Fargate to Kubernetes (EKS) without downtime, while maintaining our existing cloud estate.
Advance Infrastructure as Code: Design and implement modern, modular IaC frameworks utilizing Terraform and OpenTofu to ensure consistent, multi-environment deployments.
Improve Enterprise CI/CD: Evolve our delivery pipelines (GitHub Actions, OIDC federation) at scale, reducing developer friction and elevating deployment safety across dozens of services.
Support Data-Intensive Infrastructure: Help maintain the performance, capacity, and resilience of our high-volume data layer (ClickHouse, ScyllaDB, DynamoDB, RDS, Redis) and event-driven messaging pipelines.
Strengthen Reliability & Observability: Help maintain organization-wide reliability standards using open, modern telemetry stacks (OpenTelemetry, Coralogix, Grafana), ensuring on-call operations are driven by signal, not noise.
Balance Growth & Governance: Participate in technical tradeoff decisions that balance velocity, least-privilege security, zero-trust access (Tailscale), and FinOps cost efficiency.
Requirements
3+ years of hands-on DevOps, Infrastructure, or Cloud Engineering experience, with real production exposure in high-throughput, data-intensive environments.
Cloud Expertise: Solid working knowledge of AWS architectures, including compute, networking (VPC, DNS, segmentation), IAM, and scalability patterns.
Kubernetes Experience: Hands-on experience running and/or optimizing Kubernetes clusters (EKS) in production.
IaC & Automation Proficiency: Strong experience with Terraform and solid scripting/software engineering skills in Python, Go, or TypeScript, plus confident Bash.
Container & Pipeline Ownership: Familiarity with container workloads (ECS/Docker) and modern CI/CD systems (GitHub Actions) using safe rollout strategies.
Observability: Experience designing and/or operating observability and alerting stacks (metrics, logs, traces, SLOs).
Collaborative Communication: Pragmatic, clear communicator who thrives in a high-velocity, autonomous team environment and builds trust through sound technical judgment.
Note: We're hiring across mid to senior levels for this role. The depth of your experience across the above areas will determine the scope and seniority of the position offered.
Beneficial Experience
Direct experience leading an ECS-to-Kubernetes migration in a production environment.
Deep knowledge of EKS ecosystem tooling (Karpenter, ArgoCD/Flux, KEDA, VPC CNI).
Experience operating analytical or wide-column databases at scale (ClickHouse, ScyllaDB).

סביבת עבודה דינאמית ומאתגרת.
תיאור משרה:
שירות בנקאי פרונטלי וטלפוני וכן מכירת מוצרים בנקאיים ללקוחות פרטיים וללקוחות פרימיום
טיפול בכל הנכסים וההתחייבויות של הלקוח.
ייזום מול לקוחות, גיוס לקוחות חדשים, קידום מכירות, שימור והרחבת פעילות עם לקוחות קיימים, ליווי הלקוח לאורך זמן, פגישות עם לקוחות קיימים וחדשים.
מכירת מוצרים בנקאיים כדוגמת: אשראים, פיקדונות, כרטיסי אשראי, גלישה ישירה באינטרנט.
במסגרת התפקיד יוכשר הבנקאי במגוון תחומים: בנקאות, אשראי, קשרי לקוחות, שירות ושיווק.

5 ימים בשבוע ,שעות העבודה:
ענף מרכזי ייעוץ מורכב משמונה מרכזים בפריסה ארצית.
המרכזים נותנים שירותי ייעוץ בהשקעות למערך הייעוץ ולכל יועץ מקושרים כ-350 לקוחות.
תהליכי העבודה כוללים שיחות ייעוץ יזומות+נכנסות, טיפול בבקרות בעולם הייעוץ, עבודה תפעולית עוטפת ייעוץ וכן יעדים עסקיים בנושא גיוס פאסיב, לקוחות ועוד.
תיאור התפקיד:
אחריות למכלול הטיפול בפעילות ההשקעות של הלקוחות.
גיוס לקוחות חדשים והרחבת הפעילות אצל לקוחות קיימים.
גורם מקצועי סניפי בתחומי ההשקעות.
סקירה כלכלית שבועית/אד הוק, ניתוח מוצרים ועוד.
קליטה כעובדי בנק מהיום הראשון.

אחריות מקצועית על תכנון ושיפור שכבת האינטראקציה בין פתרונות ה- AI הארגוניים לבין מודלי השפה והידע הארגוני, במטרה להבטיח תשובות מדויקות, עקביות, רלוונטיות ומדידות. התפקיד יתמקד ב- Prompt Engineering , ניהול Context, RAG , תכנון תהליכי שיחה ו- Evaluation , לצד יכולת פיתוח Full Stack מעשית לצורך בניית רכיבי AI , כלי עבודה ויישומים תומכים, כחלק מצוות ה- AI ובכפיפות לראש הצוות.
איך יראה היום שלך?
תכנון, כתיבה, בדיקה ואופטימיזציה של Prompts ו- System Instructions עבור עוזרים ארגוניים וסוכני AI .
תכנון וניהול Context , זיכרון שיחה, מבנה השיחה והמידע המועבר למודל בכל שלב.
בניית ושיפור תהליכי RAG , כולל Chunking, Metadata, Embeddings, Retrieval ו- Reranking .
עבודה עם מאגרי Vector DB וניהול מקורות ידע ארגוניים לצורך שליפה מדויקת ורלוונטית.
איתור כשלים בתשובות המודלים, ניתוח Root Cause ושיפור Prompt, Context, Retrieval או מבנה ה- Agent בהתאם לממצאים.
עבודה משותפת עם ראש צוות ה- AI , מפתחים, אבטחת מידע ויחידות עסקיות לצורך תרגום צרכים עסקיים להתנהגות נכונה של פתרונות AI .
פיתוח Hands-on של רכיבי Backend ושירותי API עבור פתרונות AI , כולל חיבור למודלים, מאגרי מידע ושירותים ארגוניים.
פיתוח כלי UI וממשקים פנימיים לצורך בדיקה, תפעול, ניהול ידע, Evaluation וניתוח ביצועי פתרונות AI .
בניית POC ויישומים מקצה לקצה בשיתוף ראש הצוות והמפתחים, משלב אב-טיפוס ועד העברה לפיתוח Production .
תיעוד סטנדרטים, Best Practices ומתודולוגיות לעבודה עקבית עם LLMs , תוך התייחסות לאיכות, פרטיות, אבטחה ועלויות שימוש.
למי מתאימה המשרה?
ניסיון מעשי בעבודה עם LLMs וב- Prompt Engineering .
ניסיון בניהול Context , תכנון תהליכי שיחה ופתרונות מבוססי ידע ארגוני.
היכרות מעשית עם RAG, Embeddings ו- Vector DB .
ניסיון בהגדרת תהליכי Evaluation ובמדידה ושיפור של איכות תשובות מודלים.
ניסיון מעשי ב- Python ובאינטגרציות API .
ניסיון בפיתוח Full Stack , עם דגש על Backend ב- Python ופיתוח שירותי REST/API .
ניסיון בפיתוח Web בצד ה- Frontend באמצעות JavaScript/TypeScript ואחת מהטכנולוגיות המובילות כגון React – יתרון משמעותי.
ניסיון בעבודה עם Git , תהליכי CI/CD, Docker וסביבות פיתוח מודרניות – יתרון.
יכולת לתכנן ולממש פתרון מקצה לקצה: ממשק משתמש, Backend , בסיס נתונים ואינטגרציה למודל או Agent .
חשיבה אנליטית גבוהה, ירידה לפרטים ויכולת ניסוי שיטתית.
הבנה עסקית ויכולת לתרגם צורך עסקי להנחיות, Context ומדדי הצלחה.
יכולת עבודה בצוות ותקשורת טובה עם גורמים טכנולוגיים ועסקיים.
סקרנות מקצועית, למידה עצמית גבוהה ויכולת להתעדכן במהירות בעולם ה- Generative AI .
